    1|import { Refine, Authenticated } from '@refinedev/core';
    2|import { QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    3|import { queryClient } from './lib/query-client';
    4|import routerProvider, { UnsavedChangesNotifier, DocumentTitleHandler } from '@refinedev/react-router-v6';
    5|import { BrowserRouter, Routes, Route, Navigate } from 'react-router-dom';
    6|import { App as AntdApp, ConfigProvider, theme as antdTheme } from 'antd';
    7|import { shipEnterpriseTheme } from '@/providers/theme-provider';
    8|import { Fragment, Suspense, useEffect } from 'react';
    9|import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
   10|import { clearAuthToken } from '@/lib/auth-session';
   11|import { useAuthStore } from '@/stores/auth.store';
   12|import { antdUtils } from './utils/antdGlobal';
   13|import { authProvider } from './providers/authProvider';
   14|import { dataProvider } from './providers/dataProvider';
   15|import { resources } from './providers/resources';
   16|import { AppLayout } from './layouts/AppLayout';
   17|import { useAppStore } from './stores/app.store';
   18|import { ROUTES } from '@/routes';
   19|import { useAppNotificationProvider } from './providers/notificationProvider';
   20|import { ErrorBoundary } from './components/common/ErrorBoundary';
   21|import {
   22|  AppPages,
   23|  crudRoutes,
   24|  renderCrudElement,
   25|  renderSingleElement,
   26|  singleRoutes,
   27|} from './routes/appRouteConfig';
   28|
   29|function TenantGuard({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
   30|  const { isAuthenticated, currentTenantId, pendingTenants } = useAuthStore();
   31|
   32|  if (isAuthenticated && currentTenantId == null && pendingTenants.length > 0) {
   33|    return <Navigate to={ROUTES.selectTenant} replace />;
   34|  }
   35|
   36|  return <>{children}</>;
   37|}
   38|
   39|function AppContent() {
   40|  const navigate = useNavigate();
   41|  const { message, notification, modal } = AntdApp.useApp();
   42|  const notificationProvider = useAppNotificationProvider();
   43|
   44|  useEffect(() => {
   45|    const handler = () => {
   46|      // Ensure local cleanup and navigate to login when session force-logout occurs.
   47|      try {
   48|        clearAuthToken();
   49|      } catch (e) {
   50|        // ignore clear token error
   51|      }
   52|      try {
   53|        useAuthStore.getState().setUser(null);
   54|      } catch (e) {
   55|        // ignore store error
   56|      }
   57|      navigate(ROUTES.login);
   58|    };
   59|
   60|    window.addEventListener('auth:force-logout', handler);
   61|    return () => window.removeEventListener('auth:force-logout', handler);
   62|  }, [navigate]);
   63|
   64|  useEffect(() => {
   65|    antdUtils.setMessageInstance(message);
   66|    antdUtils.setNotificationInstance(notification);
   67|    antdUtils.setModalInstance(modal);
   68|  }, [message, notification, modal]);
   69|
   70|  return (
   71|    <ErrorBoundary>
   72|      <Refine
   73|        dataProvider={dataProvider}
   74|        authProvider={authProvider}
   75|        routerProvider={routerProvider}
   76|        resources={resources}
   77|        notificationProvider={notificationProvider}
   78|        options={{
   79|          syncWithLocation: true,
   80|          warnWhenUnsavedChanges: true,
   81|          useNewQueryKeys: true,
   82|          projectId: 'ship-erp-system',
   83|        }}
   84|      >
   85|        <TenantGuard>
   86|          <Suspense fallback={<div className="p-6 text-sm text-muted-foreground">Loading...</div>}>
   87|            <Routes>
   88|              <Route path={ROUTES.login} element={<AppPages.LoginForm />} />
   89|
   90|              <Route path={ROUTES.register} element={<AppPages.RegisterForm />} />
   91|              <Route path={ROUTES.forgotPassword} element={<AppPages.ForgotPasswordForm />} />
   92|              <Route path={ROUTES.forgotPasswordVerify} element={<AppPages.ForgotPasswordVerifyForm />} />
   93|              <Route path={ROUTES.selectTenant} element={<AppPages.TenantSelector />} />
   94|              <Route
   95|                element={
   96|                  <Authenticated key="authenticated-layout" fallback={<Navigate to={ROUTES.login} replace />}>
   97|                    <AppLayout />
   98|                  </Authenticated>
   99|                }
  100|              >
  101|                <Route path={ROUTES.root} element={<Navigate to={ROUTES.dashboard} replace />} />
  102|                <Route path={ROUTES.dashboard} element={<AppPages.Dashboard />} />
  103|
  104|                {crudRoutes.map((config) => (
  105|                  <Fragment key={config.key}>
  106|                    <Route path={config.routes.list} element={renderCrudElement(config, 'list')} />
  107|                    <Route path={config.routes.create} element={renderCrudElement(config, 'create')} />
  108|                    <Route path={config.routes.show} element={renderCrudElement(config, 'show')} />
  109|                    <Route path={config.routes.edit} element={renderCrudElement(config, 'edit')} />
  110|                  </Fragment>
  111|                ))}
  112|
  113|                {singleRoutes.map((config) => (
  114|                  <Route key={config.key} path={config.path} element={renderSingleElement(config)} />
  115|                ))}
  116|
  117|                <Route path="*" element={<AppPages.NotFound />} />
  118|              </Route>
  119|            </Routes>
  120|          </Suspense>
  121|          <UnsavedChangesNotifier />
  122|          <DocumentTitleHandler />
  123|        </TenantGuard>
  124|      </Refine>
  125|    </ErrorBoundary>
  126|  );
  127|}
  128|
  129|function App() {
  130|  const { theme } = useAppStore();
  131|
  132|  useEffect(() => {
  133|    document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark', theme === 'dark');
  134|  }, [theme]);
  135|
  136|  const { defaultAlgorithm, darkAlgorithm } = antdTheme;
  137|
  138|  return (
  139|    <BrowserRouter future={{ v7_startTransition: true, v7_relativeSplatPath: true }}>
  140|      <ConfigProvider
  141|        theme={{
  142|          ...shipEnterpriseTheme,
  143|          algorithm: theme === 'dark' ? darkAlgorithm : defaultAlgorithm,
  144|        }}
  145|      >
  146|        <AntdApp>
  147|          <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
  148|            <AppContent />
  149|          </QueryClientProvider>
  150|        </AntdApp>
  151|      </ConfigProvider>
  152|    </BrowserRouter>
  153|  );
  154|}
  155|
  156|export default App;
  157|

    1|import { Flex, Typography, theme } from 'antd';
    2|import { useTranslation } from '@/hooks/useTranslation';
    3|import { LottieTruckLoader } from '@/components/common/LottieTruckLoader';
    4|
    5|type AppLoadingSpinProps = {
    6|  /**
    7|   * `page` — full viewport (login, chunk độc lập);
    8|   * `outlet` — vùng main trong AppLayout khi lazy route;
    9|   * `section` — khối nhỏ (vd biểu đồ).
   10|   */
   11|  variant?: 'page' | 'outlet' | 'section';
   12|  className?: string;
   13|};
   14|
   15|/**
   16| * Lottie xe tải theo theme — dùng làm Suspense fallback hoặc vùng đang tải.
   17| */
   18|export function AppLoadingSpin({ variant = 'page', className }: AppLoadingSpinProps) {
   19|  const { t } = useTranslation();
   20|  const { token } = theme.useToken();
   21|  const isPage = variant === 'page';
   22|  const isOutlet = variant === 'outlet';
   23|  const isSection = variant === 'section';
   24|
   25|  const lottieSize = isPage ? 200 : isOutlet ? 160 : 120;
   26|
   27|  const containerStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
   28|    width: '100%',
   29|    minHeight: isPage ? '100vh' : isOutlet ? '50vh' : 320,
   30|    background: isSection ? token.colorFillAlter : token.colorBgLayout,
   31|    borderRadius: isSection || isOutlet ? token.borderRadiusLG : 0,
   32|    border: isSection || isOutlet ? `1px solid ${token.colorBorderSecondary}` : undefined,
   33|  };
   34|
   35|  return (
   36|    <Flex
   37|      vertical
   38|      align="center"
   39|      justify="center"
   40|      style={containerStyle}
   41|      className={className}
   42|      role="status"
   43|      aria-busy="true"
   44|      aria-live="polite"
   45|    >
   46|      <Flex vertical align="center" gap={isPage ? 'middle' : 'small'} style={{ padding: token.paddingXL }}>
   47|        <LottieTruckLoader size={lottieSize} />
   48|
   49|        {isPage && (
   50|          <Flex vertical align="center" gap="small" style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>
   51|            <Typography.Title level={4} style={{ margin: 0 }}>
   52|              {t('common.pageLoading')}
   53|            </Typography.Title>
   54|            <Typography.Text type="secondary">
   55|              {t('common.pageLoadingHint')}
   56|            </Typography.Text>
   57|          </Flex>
   58|        )}
   59|
   60|        {isOutlet && (
   61|          <Typography.Text type="secondary" strong>
   62|            {t('common.loading')}
   63|          </Typography.Text>
   64|        )}
   65|
   66|        {isSection && (
   67|          <Typography.Text type="secondary">
   68|            {t('common.chartLoading')}
   69|          </Typography.Text>
   70|        )}
   71|      </Flex>
   72|    </Flex>
   73|  );
   74|}

   43|function sessionStatusTagColor(status: AuthSessionStatus): string {
   44|  if (status === 'active') return 'success';
   45|  if (status === 'logged_out') return 'processing';
   46|  return 'warning';
   47|}
   48|
   49|function actionClassName(action: string): string {
   50|  const normalized = action.toLowerCase();
   51|  if (normalized.includes('delete') || normalized.includes('remove')) return 'action-delete';
   52|  if (normalized.includes('update') || normalized.includes('edit')) return 'action-update';
   53|  if (normalized.includes('create') || normalized.includes('add')) return 'action-create';
   54|  if (normalized.includes('login') || normalized.includes('logout') || normalized.includes('auth')) return 'action-auth';
   55|  return 'action-default';
   56|}

   58|export const AuthLogsAndSessionManagement = () => {

   62|

   64|  const [summary, setSummary] = useState({ activeSessions: 0, failedLogins: 0 });
   65|  const [sessions, setSessions] = useState<AuthSessionRow[]>([]);
   66|  const [totalSessions, setTotalSessions] = useState(0);
   67|  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
   68|  const [sessionsLoading, setSessionsLoading] = useState(false);
   69|  const [summaryLoading, setSummaryLoading] = useState(false);
   70|  const [logoutConfirmId, setLogoutConfirmId] = useState<string | null>(null);
   71|  const [lockConfirmId, setLockConfirmId] = useState<string | null>(null);
   72|
   73|  const [logDate, setLogDate] = useState(todayIso);
   74|  const [auditLogs, setAuditLogs] = useState<AuthLogAuditRow[]>([]);
   75|  const [auditLoading, setAuditLoading] = useState(false);
   76|  const [auditCurrentPage, setAuditCurrentPage] = useState(1);
   77|
   78|  const dateTimeFmt = useMemo(
   79|    () =>
   80|      new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, {
   81|        dateStyle: 'short',
   82|        timeStyle: 'short',
   83|      }),
   84|    [],
   85|  );
   86|
   87|  useEffect(() => {
   88|    tRef.current = t;
   89|  }, [t]);

   92|    (iso: string | null | undefined) => {
   93|      if (!iso) return '';
   94|      const d = new Date(iso);
   95|      return Number.isNaN(d.getTime()) ? iso : dateTimeFmt.format(d);
   96|    },

   98|  );

  114|    } finally {
  115|      setSummaryLoading(false);
  116|    }
  117|  }, [toast]);

  202|  const openLogoutConfirm = useCallback((sessionId: string) => setLogoutConfirmId(sessionId), []);

===== FILE: src/components/common/chat/chatUtils.ts =====
    1|export type ChatSource = { id: string; title: string; content?: string };
    2|
    3|export const extractChatSources = (payload: unknown): ChatSource[] | undefined => {
    4|  if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object') return undefined;
    5|  const p = payload as Record<string, unknown>;
    6|  const raw = p.sources ?? p.citations ?? p.knowledge_refs ?? p.references;
    7|  if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return undefined;
    8|  const out: ChatSource[] = [];
    9|  raw.forEach((item, i) => {
   10|    if (!item || typeof item !== 'object') return;
   11|    const o = item as Record<string, unknown>;
   12|    const id = String(o.id ?? o.article_id ?? o.slug ?? i);
   13|    const title = String(o.title ?? o.name ?? o.slug ?? `Ref ${i + 1}`);
   14|    const content = typeof o.content === 'string' ? o.content : typeof o.body === 'string' ? o.body : undefined;
   15|    out.push({ id, title, content });
   16|  });
   17|  return out.length ? out : undefined;
   18|};
   19|
   20|export const isPlainObject = (value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> =>
   21|  typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
   22|
   23|export const getFirstString = (value: unknown, keys: string[]): string => {
   24|  if (!isPlainObject(value)) return '';
   25|  for (const key of keys) {
   26|    const candidate = value[key];
   27|    if (typeof candidate === 'string' && candidate.trim()) {
   28|      return candidate;
   29|    }
   30|    if (typeof candidate === 'number' || typeof candidate === 'boolean') {
   31|      return String(candidate);
   32|    }
   33|  }
   34|  return '';
   35|};
   36|
   37|export const toStringId = (value: unknown): string => {
   38|  if (typeof value === 'string' && value.trim()) return value;
   39|  if (typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value)) return String(value);
   40|  return '';
   41|};
   42|
   43|export const stripHtmlTags = (text: string): string => {
   44|  if (!text) return '';
   45|  return text
   46|    .replace(/<script\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/script>)<[^<]*)*<\/script>/gi, ' ')
   47|    .replace(/<style\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/style>)<[^<]*)*<\/style>/gi, ' ')
   48|    .replace(/<[^>]+>/g, ' ');
   49|};
   50|
   51|export const normalizeText = (text: string): string => {
   52|  if (!text) return '';
   53|  return text
   54|    .normalize('NFKC')
   55|    .replace(/\r\n?/g, '\n')
   56|    .replace(/[\t\f\v]+/g, ' ')
   57|    .replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n')
   58|    .replace(/ {2,}/g, ' ')
   59|    .trim();
   60|};
   61|
   62|export const sanitizeUserText = (text: string): string => normalizeText(stripHtmlTags(text));
   63|
   64|export const isObviousSpam = (text: string): boolean => {
   65|  if (!text) return false;
   66|  if (/(.)\1{11,}/u.test(text)) return true;
   67|  const words = text.toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
   68|  if (words.length >= 8) {
   69|    const repeatedWordCount = words.reduce<Record<string, number>>((acc, word) => {
   70|      acc[word] = (acc[word] ?? 0) + 1;
   71|      return acc;
   72|    }, {});
   73|    const maxRepeat = Math.max(...Object.values(repeatedWordCount));
   74|    if (maxRepeat >= Math.ceil(words.length * 0.7)) return true;
   75|  }
   76|  if (text.length >= 80 && /^(.{1,20})\1{4,}$/u.test(text.replace(/\s+/g, ''))) return true;
   77|  return false;
   78|};
   79|
   80|export const sleep = (ms: number) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));

   30|  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return html;
   31|  return DOMPurify.sanitize(html, {
   32|    USE_PROFILES: { html: true },
   33|    FORBID_TAGS: ['script', 'style', 'iframe', 'object', 'embed'],
   34|    FORBID_ATTR: ['onerror', 'onload', 'style'],
   35|  });

   38|export function MessageRenderer({ content }: MessageRendererProps) {

   40|
   41|  const renderRichContent = (jsonStr: string) => {

   43|      const data = JSON.parse(jsonStr) as RichContent;
   44|      
   45|      if (data.type === 'table' && Array.isArray(data.rows)) {

   54|              bordered
   55|              style={{ background: token.colorBgContainer }}
   56|            />
   57|          </div>
   58|        );
   59|      }
   60|
   61|      if (data.type === 'chart') {
   62|        const chartData = data.data || [];
   63|        const config = data.config || { value: { label: 'Value', color: token.colorPrimary } };
   64|        
   65|        return (
   66|          <Card size="small" style={{ margin: '12px 0' }}>
   67|            <Typography.Text strong style={{ display: 'block', marginBottom: 12 }}>{data.title}</Typography.Text>
   68|            <div style={{ height: 240, width: '100%' }}>
   69|              <ChartContainer config={config}>
   70|                {data.chartType === 'bar' ? (
   71|                  <BarChart data={chartData}>
   72|                    <CartesianGrid vertical={false} strokeDasharray="3 3" />

   74|                    <ChartTooltip content={<ChartTooltipContent />} />
   75|                    <Bar dataKey={data.yAxisKey || 'value'} radius={4} fill="var(--color-value)" />
   76|                  </BarChart>
   77|                ) : data.chartType === 'line' ? (
   78|                  <LineChart data={chartData}>
   79|                    <CartesianGrid vertical={false} strokeDasharray="3 3" />
   80|                    <XAxis dataKey={data.xAxisKey || 'name'} tickLine={false} axisLine={false} />
   81|                    <ChartTooltip content={<ChartTooltipContent />} />
   82|                    <Line type="monotone" dataKey={data.yAxisKey || 'value'} stroke="var(--color-value)" strokeWidth={2} dot={false} />
   83|                  </LineChart>
   84|                ) : (
   85|                  <ResponsiveContainer>
   86|                    <PieChart>
   87|                      <Pie data={(chartData || []) as Record<string, unknown>[]} dataKey={data.yAxisKey || 'value'} nameKey={data.xAxisKey || 'name'} innerRadius={60} outerRadius={80}>
   88|                        {((chartData || []) as unknown[]).map((_, index: number) => (
   89|                          <Cell 
   90|                            key={`cell-${index}`}

   92|                          />
   93|                        ))}

  102|        );
  103|      }

  105|      console.error('Failed to parse rich content:', e);
  106|    }
  107|    return null;
  108|  };
  109|
  110|  const segments = useMemo(() => {
  111|    const regex = /`​``json\s*([\s\S]*?)\s*`​``/g;

  113|    let lastIndex = 0;
  114|    let match;
  115|
  116|    while ((match = regex.exec(content)) !== null) {
  117|      if (match.index > lastIndex) {
  118|        parts.push({ type: 'text', value: content.substring(lastIndex, match.index) });
  119|      }
  120|      parts.push({ type: 'rich', value: match[1] });
  121|      lastIndex = regex.lastIndex;
  122|    }
  123|
  124|    if (lastIndex < content.length) {
  125|      parts.push({ type: 'text', value: content.substring(lastIndex) });
  126|    }
  127|
  128|    return parts;
  129|  }, [content]);
  130|

  136|        }
  137|
  138|        const html = marked.parse(segment.value, { gfm: true, breaks: true }) as string;
  139|        const sanitized = sanitizeHtml(html);
  140|
  141|        return (
  142|          <div
  143|            key={idx}
  144|            className="max-w-none whitespace-normal break-words text-sm leading-6 [&_a]:text-primary [&_a]:underline [&_code]:rounded [&_code]:bg-muted/60 [&_code]:px-1 [&_pre]:overflow-x-auto [&_pre]:rounded-md [&_pre]:bg-muted/60 [&_pre]:p-3 [&_ul]:list-disc [&_ul]:pl-5 [&_ol]:list-decimal [&_ol]:pl-5 [&_blockquote]:border-l-2 [&_blockquote]:border-border [&_blockquote]:pl-3 [&_blockquote]:text-muted-foreground"
  145|            dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: sanitized }}
  146|          />
  147|        );

    1|import { Component, ErrorInfo, ReactNode } from 'react';
    2|import { Button, Result } from 'antd';
    3|import { ReloadOutlined } from '@ant-design/icons';
    4|
    5|interface Props {
    6|  children?: ReactNode;
    7|  fallback?: ReactNode;
    8|}
    9|
   10|interface State {
   11|  hasError: boolean;
   12|  error?: Error;
   13|}
   14|
   15|export class ErrorBoundary extends Component<Props, State> {
   16|  public state: State = {
   17|    hasError: false,
   18|  };
   19|
   20|  public static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error): State {
   21|    return { hasError: true, error };
   22|  }
   23|
   24|  public componentDidCatch(error: Error, errorInfo: ErrorInfo) {
   25|    console.error('Uncaught error:', error, errorInfo);
   26|  }
   27|
   28|  public render() {
   29|    if (this.state.hasError) {
   30|      if (this.fallback) return this.fallback;
   31|
   32|      return (
   33|        <div style={{ padding: '40px', height: '100vh', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }}>
   34|          <Result
   35|            status="error"
   36|            title="Đã xảy ra lỗi không mong muốn"
   37|            subTitle={this.state.error?.message || 'Hệ thống gặp sự cố khi xử lý dữ liệu. Vui lòng thử lại.'}

   43|                Về trang chủ

===== FILE: src/components/common/FileUploader.tsx =====
    1|import { useState } from 'react';
    2|import { Upload, Button, type UploadFile, type UploadProps } from 'antd';
    3|import { UploadOutlined } from '@ant-design/icons';
    4|import { useAppFeedback } from '@/hooks/useAppFeedback';
    5|import { useTranslation } from '@/hooks/useTranslation';
    6|import { getErrorMessage } from '@/utils/errorHandler';
    7|import { publicFileUploadToUrl } from '@/utils/publicFileUpload';
    8|
    9|interface FileUploaderProps {
   10|  value?: string[];
   11|  onChange?: (urls: string[]) => void;
   12|  maxCount?: number;
   13|  accept?: string;
   14|  listType?: UploadProps['listType'];
   15|  buttonText?: string;
   16|}
   17|
   18|export function FileUploader({
   19|  value = [],
   20|  onChange,
   21|  maxCount = 5,
   22|  accept = 'image/*,.pdf',
   23|  listType = 'picture',
   24|  buttonText,
   25|}: FileUploaderProps) {
   26|  const { t } = useTranslation();
   27|  const feedback = useAppFeedback();
   28|
   29|  // Convert string URLs to UploadFile objects for Ant Design
   30|  const [fileList, setFileList] = useState<UploadFile[]>(() =>
   31|    value.map((url, index) => ({
   32|      uid: `-existing-${index}`,
   33|      name: url.split('/').pop() || `File ${index + 1}`,
   34|      status: 'done',
   35|      url,
   36|    }))
   37|  );
   38|
   39|  const handleChange: UploadProps['onChange'] = (info) => {
   40|    setFileList(info.fileList);
   41|
   42|    // Extract all successfully uploaded URLs
   43|    const newUrls = info.fileList
   44|      .map((file) => file.url || file.response?.data?.url)
   45|      .filter(Boolean) as string[];
   46|
   47|    if (onChange) {
   48|      onChange(newUrls);
   49|    }
   50|  };
   51|
   52|  const customRequest: UploadProps['customRequest'] = (options) => {
   53|    void publicFileUploadToUrl({
   54|      ...options,
   55|      onSuccess: (body, xhr) => {
   56|        feedback.success(t('notifications.uploadSuccess'));
   57|        options.onSuccess?.(body, xhr);
   58|      },
   59|      onError: (err) => {
   60|        const msg = getErrorMessage(err);
   61|        feedback.error(msg === 'An error occurred' ? t('notifications.uploadError') : msg);
   62|        options.onError?.(err);
   63|      },
   64|    });
   65|  };
   66|
   67|  return (
   68|    <Upload
   69|      customRequest={customRequest}
   70|      fileList={fileList}
   71|      onChange={handleChange}
   72|      maxCount={maxCount}
   73|      accept={accept}
   74|      listType={listType}
   75|    >
   76|      {fileList.length < maxCount && (
   77|        <Button icon={<UploadOutlined />}>
   78|          {buttonText || t('common.upload') || 'Upload file'}
   79|        </Button>
   80|      )}
   81|    </Upload>
   82|  );
   83|}

===== FILE: src/components/common/FloatingChatAssistant.tsx =====
    1|import { type PointerEvent as ReactPointerEvent, useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
    2|import { MessageOutlined, CloseOutlined } from '@ant-design/icons';
    3|import { Button, Typography, theme } from 'antd';
    4|
    5|import { ChatAssistantPanel } from '@/components/common/ChatAssistantPanel';
    6|import { useTranslation } from '@/hooks/useTranslation';
    7|import { hasAuthToken } from '@/lib/auth-session';
    8|import { useAuthStore } from '@/stores/auth.store';
    9|
   10|export const FloatingChatAssistant = () => {
   11|  const { t } = useTranslation();
   12|  const { token } = theme.useToken();
   13|  const isAuthenticated = useAuthStore((s) => s.isAuthenticated);
   14|  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
   15|  const [viewport, setViewport] = useState({ width: 0, height: 0 });
   16|  const [anchor, setAnchor] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 });
   17|
   18|  const isChatVisible = isAuthenticated && hasAuthToken();
   19|
   20|  const dragStateRef = useRef({
   21|    dragging: false,
   22|    startX: 0,
   23|    startY: 0,
   24|    originX: 0,
   25|    originY: 0,
   26|    moved: false,
   27|  });
   28|
   29|  const BUBBLE_SIZE = 56;
   30|  const EDGE_GAP = 8;
   31|
   32|  const clampAnchor = useCallback((x: number, y: number) => {
   33|    const maxX = Math.max(EDGE_GAP, viewport.width - BUBBLE_SIZE - EDGE_GAP);
   34|    const maxY = Math.max(EDGE_GAP, viewport.height - BUBBLE_SIZE - EDGE_GAP);
   35|
   36|    return {
   37|      x: Math.min(Math.max(x, EDGE_GAP), maxX),
   38|      y: Math.min(Math.max(y, EDGE_GAP), maxY),
   39|    };
   40|  }, [viewport.height, viewport.width]);
   41|
   42|  const panelPosition = useMemo(() => {
   43|    if (!viewport.width || !viewport.height) {
   44|      return { left: EDGE_GAP, top: EDGE_GAP, width: 380, maxHeight: 640 };
   45|    }
   46|
   47|    const width = Math.min(420, Math.max(360, viewport.width - 24));
   48|    const maxHeight = Math.min(760, Math.max(420, viewport.height - 24));
   49|
   50|    let left = anchor.x + BUBBLE_SIZE + 10;
   51|    if (left + width > viewport.width - EDGE_GAP) {
   52|      left = anchor.x - width - 10;
   53|    }
   54|    left = Math.max(EDGE_GAP, Math.min(left, viewport.width - width - EDGE_GAP));
   55|
   56|    const desiredTop = anchor.y - 12;
   57|    const top = Math.max(EDGE_GAP, Math.min(desiredTop, viewport.height - maxHeight - EDGE_GAP));
   58|
   59|    return { left, top, width, maxHeight };
   60|  }, [anchor.x, anchor.y, viewport.height, viewport.width]);
   61|
   62|  useEffect(() => {
   63|    if (!isChatVisible) return;
   64|
   65|    const syncViewport = () => {
   66|      const width = window.innerWidth;
   67|      const height = window.innerHeight;
   68|      setViewport({ width, height });
   69|      setAnchor((prev) => {
   70|        const isNotInitialized = prev.x === 0 && prev.y === 0;
   71|        if (isNotInitialized) {
   72|          return {
   73|            x: Math.max(EDGE_GAP, width - BUBBLE_SIZE - 24),
   74|            y: Math.max(EDGE_GAP, height - BUBBLE_SIZE - 24),
   75|          };
   76|        }
   77|
   78|        const maxX = Math.max(EDGE_GAP, width - BUBBLE_SIZE - EDGE_GAP);
   79|        const maxY = Math.max(EDGE_GAP, height - BUBBLE_SIZE - EDGE_GAP);
   80|        return {
   81|          x: Math.min(Math.max(prev.x, EDGE_GAP), maxX),
   82|          y: Math.min(Math.max(prev.y, EDGE_GAP), maxY),
   83|        };
   84|      });
   85|    };
   86|
   87|    syncViewport();
   88|
   89|    let rafId: number | null = null;
   90|    const handlePointerMove = (event: PointerEvent) => {
   91|      const drag = dragStateRef.current;
   92|      if (!drag.dragging) return;
   93|
   94|      if (rafId) return;
   95|
   96|      rafId = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
   97|        const dx = event.clientX - drag.startX;
   98|        const dy = event.clientY - drag.startY;
   99|        if (Math.abs(dx) > 3 || Math.abs(dy) > 3) {
  100|          dragStateRef.current.moved = true;
  101|        }
  102|
  103|        setAnchor(clampAnchor(drag.originX + dx, drag.originY + dy));
  104|        rafId = null;
  105|      });
  106|    };
  107|
  108|    const handlePointerUp = () => {
  109|      dragStateRef.current.dragging = false;
  110|      if (rafId) {
  111|        cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
  112|        rafId = null;
  113|      }
  114|    };
  115|
  116|    window.addEventListener('resize', syncViewport);
  117|    window.addEventListener('pointermove', handlePointerMove);
  118|    window.addEventListener('pointerup', handlePointerUp);
  119|
  120|    return () => {
  121|      window.removeEventListener('resize', syncViewport);
  122|      window.removeEventListener('pointermove', handlePointerMove);
  123|      window.removeEventListener('pointerup', handlePointerUp);
  124|      if (rafId) cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
  125|    };
  126|  }, [clampAnchor, isChatVisible]);
  127|
  128|  if (!isChatVisible) {
  129|    return null;
  130|  }
  131|
  132|  const handleDragStart = (event: ReactPointerEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
  133|    if (event.pointerType === 'mouse' && event.button !== 0) return;
  134|
  135|    dragStateRef.current = {
  136|      dragging: true,
  137|      startX: event.clientX,
  138|      startY: event.clientY,
  139|      originX: anchor.x,
  140|      originY: anchor.y,
  141|      moved: false,
  142|    };
  143|  };
  144|
  145|  const handleBubblePointerUp = () => {
  146|    if (!dragStateRef.current.moved) {
  147|      setOpen((prev) => !prev);
  148|    }
  149|  };
  150|
  151|  return (
  152|    <>
  153|      <div className="fixed z-50" style={{ left: anchor.x, top: anchor.y }}>
  154|        <button
  155|          type="button"
  156|          onPointerDown={handleDragStart}
  157|          onPointerUp={handleBubblePointerUp}
  158|          style={{
  159|            touchAction: 'none',
  160|            width: 56,
  161|            height: 56,
  162|            borderRadius: '50%',
  163|            border: `1px solid ${token.colorPrimaryBorder}`,
  164|            cursor: 'pointer',
  165|            display: 'flex',
  166|            alignItems: 'center',
  167|            justifyContent: 'center',
  168|            background: token.colorPrimary,
  169|            color: token.colorTextLightSolid,
  170|            boxShadow: '0 10px 28px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)',
  171|          }}
  172|          aria-label={t('notificationCenter.chat.title')}
  173|        >
  174|          {open ? <CloseOutlined style={{ fontSize: 20 }} /> : <MessageOutlined style={{ fontSize: 20 }} />}
  175|        </button>
  176|        <Typography.Text type="secondary" style={{ display: 'block', marginTop: 4, textAlign: 'center', fontSize: 10 }}>
  177|          {t('notificationCenter.chat.title')}
  178|        </Typography.Text>
  179|      </div>
  180|
  181|      {open ? (
  182|        <div
  183|          style={{
  184|            position: 'fixed',
  185|            zIndex: 60,
  186|            overflow: 'hidden',
  187|            borderRadius: 16,
  188|            border: `1px solid ${token.colorBorderSecondary}`,
  189|            background: token.colorBgContainer,
  190|            boxShadow: '0 24px 64px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.2)',
  191|            left: panelPosition.left,
  192|            top: panelPosition.top,
  193|            width: panelPosition.width,
  194|            maxHeight: panelPosition.maxHeight,
  195|          }}
  196|        >
  197|          <div
  198|            style={{
  199|              display: 'flex',
  200|              alignItems: 'center',
  201|              justifyContent: 'space-between',
  202|              borderBottom: `1px solid ${token.colorSplit}`,
  203|              background: token.colorPrimaryBg,

  207|            }}
  208|            onPointerDown={handleDragStart}
  209|          >
  210|            <Typography.Text strong style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, color: token.colorPrimaryText }}>
  211|              <MessageOutlined />
  212|              {t('notificationCenter.chat.title')}
  213|            </Typography.Text>
  214|            <Button type="text" icon={<CloseOutlined />} onClick={() => setOpen(false)} aria-label="Close" />
  215|          </div>

  218|            <ChatAssistantPanel compact style={{ boxShadow: 'none', border: 'none' }} />

===== FILE: src/components/form/AddressAutocomplete.tsx =====
    1|import React, { useState } from 'react';
    2|import { Select, Spin } from 'antd';
    3|import axios from 'axios';
    4|import { useTranslation } from '@/hooks/useTranslation';
    5|
    6|interface AddressOption {
    7|  label: string;
    8|  value: string;
    9|  lat: number;
   10|  lng: number;
   11|}
   12|
   13|interface AddressAutocompleteProps {
   14|  placeholder?: string;
   15|  onSelect: (lat: number, lng: number, address: string) => void;
   16|  disabled?: boolean;
   17|}
   18|
   19|interface NominatimResult {
   20|  display_name: string;
   21|  lat: string;
   22|  lon: string;
   23|}
   24|
   25|export const AddressAutocomplete: React.FC<AddressAutocompleteProps> = ({
   26|  placeholder,
   27|  onSelect,
   28|  disabled = false,
   29|}) => {
   30|  const { t } = useTranslation();
   31|  const [options, setOptions] = useState<AddressOption[]>([]);
   32|  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
   33|
   34|  const handleSearch = async (query: string) => {
   35|    if (!query || query.length < 3) {
   36|      setOptions([]);
   37|      return;
   38|    }
   39|
   40|    setLoading(true);
   41|    try {
   42|      // NOTE: Using OpenStreetMap (Nominatim) as a free default.
   43|      // For production in Vietnam, you should switch to Goong Maps or Google Maps.
   44|      const response = await axios.get('https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search', {
   45|        params: {
   46|          q: query,
   47|          format: 'json',
   48|          addressdetails: 1,
   49|          limit: 5,
   50|          countrycodes: 'vn',
   51|        },
   52|      });
   53|
   54|      const formatted = response.data.map((item: NominatimResult) => ({
   55|        label: item.display_name,
   56|        value: item.display_name,
   57|        lat: parseFloat(item.lat),
   58|        lng: parseFloat(item.lon),
   59|      }));
   60|
   61|      setOptions(formatted);
   62|    } catch (error) {
   63|      console.error('Address search error:', error);
   64|    } finally {
   65|      setLoading(false);
   66|    }
   67|  };
   68|
   69|  return (
   70|    <Select
   71|      showSearch
   72|      placeholder={placeholder || t('vnAddress.streetPlaceholder')}
   73|      filterOption={false}
   74|      onSearch={handleSearch}
   75|      onChange={(_, option) => {
   76|        const addrOption = option as AddressOption | undefined;
   77|        if (addrOption) {
   78|          onSelect(addrOption.lat, addrOption.lng, addrOption.label);
   79|        }
   80|      }}
   81|      notFoundContent={loading ? <Spin size="small" /> : null}
   82|      options={options}
   83|      disabled={disabled}
   84|      className="w-full"
   85|      allowClear
   86|    />
   87|  );
   88|};
   89|

===== FILE: src/components/form/FormItemDatePicker.tsx =====
    1|import { DatePicker, Form, TimePicker, type GetProps } from 'antd';
    2|import dayjs from 'dayjs';
    3|import type { FormItemDatePickerProps } from './types';
    4|
    5|/**
    6| * FormItemDatePicker - Wrapper for Ant Design DatePicker/TimePicker with automatic dayjs conversion
    7| * 
    8| * Supports:
    9| * - date (default)
   10| * - datetime (showTime={true})
   11| * - time (picker="time")
   12| */
   13|export const FormItemDatePicker = ({
   14|  name,
   15|  label,
   16|  rules,
   17|  picker = 'date',
   18|  showTime,
   19|  format,
   20|  valueFormat,
   21|  placeholder,
   22|  required,
   23|  disabled,
   24|  hidden,
   25|  className,
   26|  style,
   27|  size,
   28|  pickerProps,
   29|  ...formItemProps
   30|}: FormItemDatePickerProps) => {
   31|  const normalizedRules = rules?.map((rule) => {
   32|    if (typeof rule === 'object' && rule && 'required' in rule && rule.required && !rule.message) {
   33|      return { ...rule, message: `${label || name} is required` };
   34|    }
   35|    return rule;
   36|  });
   37|
   38|  const getDefaultFormat = () => {
   39|    if (picker === 'time') return 'HH:mm:ss';
   40|    if (showTime) return 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss';
   41|    return 'YYYY-MM-DD';
   42|  };
   43|
   44|  const currentFormat = format || (picker === 'time' ? 'HH:mm' : (showTime ? 'DD/MM/YYYY HH:mm' : 'DD/MM/YYYY'));
   45|  const storageFormat = valueFormat || getDefaultFormat();
   46|
   47|
   48|
   49|  return (
   50|    <Form.Item
   51|      name={name}
   52|      label={label}
   53|      rules={normalizedRules}
   54|      required={required}
   55|      className={className}
   56|      style={style}
   57|      hidden={hidden}
   58|      getValueProps={(value) => ({
   59|        value: value ? dayjs(value, storageFormat) : undefined,
   60|      })}
   61|      normalize={(value) => (value ? (value as dayjs.Dayjs).format(storageFormat) : undefined)}
   62|      {...formItemProps}
   63|    >
   64|      {picker === 'time' ? (
   65|        <TimePicker
   66|          placeholder={placeholder}
   67|          format={currentFormat}
   68|          size={size}
   69|          disabled={disabled}
   70|          {...(pickerProps as GetProps<typeof TimePicker>)}
   71|          style={{ width: '100%', ...pickerProps?.style }}
   72|        />
   73|      ) : (
   74|        <DatePicker
   75|          placeholder={placeholder}
   76|          picker={picker as 'date' | 'week' | 'month' | 'quarter' | 'year'}
   77|          showTime={showTime}
   78|          format={currentFormat}
   79|          size={size}
   80|          disabled={disabled}
   81|          {...(pickerProps as GetProps<typeof DatePicker>)}
   82|          style={{ width: '100%', ...pickerProps?.style }}
   83|        />
   84|      )}
   85|    </Form.Item>
   86|  );
   87|};
   88|

   43|  label,

   46|  placeholder,

   51|  controls,
   52|  size,
   53|  prefix,

   63|  extra,
   64|  disabled,
   65|  hidden,
   66|  className,
   67|  style,

   69|}: FormItemNumberProps) => {
   70|  const normalizedRules = rules?.map((rule) => {
   71|    if (typeof rule === 'object' && rule && 'required' in rule && rule.required && !rule.message) {
   72|      return { ...rule, message: `${label || name} is required` };
   73|    }
   74|    return rule;
   75|  });
   76|
   77|  // Merge inputNumberProps with individual props (individual props take precedence)

   82|    precision: precision ?? inputNumberProps?.precision,

    1|import { DatePicker, Form, TimePicker } from 'antd';
    2|import dayjs from 'dayjs';

    4|
    5|const { RangePicker } = DatePicker;
    6|const { RangePicker: TimeRangePicker } = TimePicker;
    7|
    8|export const FormItemRangePicker = ({
    9|  name,
   10|  label,
   11|  rules,
   12|  picker = 'date',
   13|  showTime,
   14|  format,
   15|  valueFormat,
   16|  placeholder,
   17|  required,
   18|  disabled,
   19|  hidden,
   20|  className,
   21|  style,
   22|  size,
   23|  pickerProps,
   24|  onChange,
   25|  ...formItemProps
   26|}: FormItemRangePickerProps) => {
   27|  const normalizedRules = rules?.map((rule) => {
   28|    if (typeof rule === 'object' && rule && 'required' in rule && rule.required && !rule.message) {
   29|      return { ...rule, message: `${label || name} is required` };
   30|    }
   31|    return rule;
   32|  });
   33|
   34|  const getDefaultFormat = () => {
   35|    if (picker === 'time') return 'HH:mm:ss';
   36|    if (showTime) return 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss';
   37|    return 'YYYY-MM-DD';
   38|  };
   39|
   40|  const currentFormat = format || (picker === 'time' ? 'HH:mm' : (showTime ? 'DD/MM/YYYY HH:mm' : 'DD/MM/YYYY'));
   41|  const storageFormat = valueFormat || getDefaultFormat();
   42|
   43|  const RangePickerComponent = picker === 'time' ? TimeRangePicker : RangePicker;
   44|

   46|    <Form.Item

   48|      label={label}

   50|      required={required}

   52|      style={style}
   53|      hidden={hidden}
   54|      getValueProps={(value) => ({
   55|        value: Array.isArray(value) && value.length === 2 
   56|          ? [value[0] ? dayjs(value[0], storageFormat) : undefined, value[1] ? dayjs(value[1], storageFormat) : undefined] 
   57|          : undefined,
   58|      })}
   59|      normalize={(value) => 
   60|        Array.isArray(value) && value.length === 2 
   61|          ? [
   62|              value[0] ? (value[0] as dayjs.Dayjs).format(storageFormat) : undefined, 
   63|              value[1] ? (value[1] as dayjs.Dayjs).format(storageFormat) : undefined
   64|            ] 
   65|          : undefined
   66|      }
   67|      {...formItemProps}
   68|    >
   69|      <RangePickerComponent
   70|        placeholder={placeholder}
   71|        picker={picker === 'time' ? undefined : picker}
   72|        showTime={showTime}
   73|        format={currentFormat}
   74|        size={size}
   75|        disabled={disabled}
   76|        onChange={onChange as never}

   58| * />
   59| * `​``
   60| */
   61|export const FormItemSelect = ({
   62|  name,
   63|  label,
   64|  rules,
   65|  selectProps,
   66|  options,
   67|  placeholder,
   68|  allowClear,
   69|  showSearch,
   70|  mode,
   71|  size,
   72|  loading,
   73|  filterOption,
   74|  optionRender,
   75|  maxTagCount,
   76|  maxTagPlaceholder,
   77|  showArrow,
   78|  tagRender,
   79|  onChange,
   80|  prefix,
   81|  classNames,
   82|  onPopupScroll,
   83|  optionFilterProp: optionFilterPropProp,
   84|  required,
   85|  tooltip,
   86|  help,
   87|  extra,
   88|  disabled,
   89|  hidden,
   90|  className,
   91|  style,
   92|  ...formItemProps
   93|}: FormItemSelectProps) => {
   94|  const normalizedRules = rules?.map((rule) => {
   95|    if (typeof rule === 'object' && rule && 'required' in rule && rule.required && !rule.message) {
   96|      return { ...rule, message: `${label || name} is required` };
   97|    }
   98|    return rule;
   99|  });
  100|
  101|  const resolvedAllowClear = allowClear ?? selectProps?.allowClear ?? true;
  102|  const resolvedShowSearch = showSearch ?? selectProps?.showSearch ?? false;
  103|
  104|  // Default filter function if showSearch is true and no custom filter provided
  105|  const defaultFilterOption = resolvedShowSearch && !filterOption
  106|    ? (input: string, option: SelectOption) =>
  107|        String(option?.label ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(input.toLowerCase())
  108|    : filterOption === false
  109|    ? false
  110|    : filterOption;
  111|
  112|  const normalizedFilterOption: SelectProps['filterOption'] =
  113|    typeof defaultFilterOption === 'function'
  114|      ? (input, option) => defaultFilterOption(input, (option as SelectOption | undefined) ?? { label: '', value: '' })
  115|      : defaultFilterOption
  116|
  117|  // Merge selectProps with individual props (individual props take precedence)
  118|  // Note: options will be passed separately as transformedOptions, so exclude it from merged props
  119|  const selectPropsWithoutOptions = selectProps ? { ...selectProps } : {};
  120|  delete (selectPropsWithoutOptions as { options?: unknown }).options;
  121|  delete (selectPropsWithoutOptions as { maxTagPlaceholder?: unknown }).maxTagPlaceholder;
  122|  
  123|  const mergedSelectProps: SelectProps = {
  124|    ...selectPropsWithoutOptions,
  125|    allowClear: resolvedAllowClear,
  126|    showSearch: resolvedShowSearch,
  127|    prefix: prefix ?? selectPropsWithoutOptions.prefix,
  128|    classNames: classNames ?? selectPropsWithoutOptions.classNames,
  129|    onPopupScroll: onPopupScroll ?? selectPropsWithoutOptions.onPopupScroll,
  130|    optionFilterProp: optionFilterPropProp ?? selectProps?.optionFilterProp ?? 'label',
  131|    getPopupContainer:
  132|      selectProps?.getPopupContainer ??
  133|      ((triggerNode: HTMLElement) => triggerNode.parentElement ?? document.body),
  134|    mode: mode || selectProps?.mode,
  135|    size: size || selectProps?.size,
  136|    loading: loading ?? selectProps?.loading,
  137|    filterOption: normalizedFilterOption ?? selectProps?.filterOption,
  138|    maxTagCount: maxTagCount ?? selectProps?.maxTagCount,
  139|    tagRender: tagRender || selectProps?.tagRender,
  140|    onChange: onChange || selectProps?.onChange,
  141|    disabled: disabled ?? selectProps?.disabled,
  142|  };
  143|
  144|  const resolvedPopupRender =
  145|    (selectPropsWithoutOptions as SelectProps).popupRender ||
  146|    // Keep backward compatibility when callers still pass deprecated dropdownRender via selectProps.
  147|    (selectPropsWithoutOptions as unknown as { dropdownRender?: SelectProps['popupRender'] }).dropdownRender;
  148|
  149|  if (resolvedPopupRender) {
  150|    mergedSelectProps.popupRender = resolvedPopupRender;
  151|  }
  152|
  153|  if (showArrow != null) {
  154|    // Keep behavior for explicit overrides while avoiding deprecated prop warnings by default.
  155|    (mergedSelectProps as SelectProps).showArrow = showArrow;
  156|  }
  157|  
  158|  // Add maxTagPlaceholder separately if provided
  159|  if (maxTagPlaceholder != null) {
  160|    mergedSelectProps.maxTagPlaceholder =
  161|      typeof maxTagPlaceholder === 'function'
  162|        ? ((omittedValues) => maxTagPlaceholder(omittedValues as unknown as SelectOption[]))
  163|        : maxTagPlaceholder;
  164|  } else if (selectProps?.maxTagPlaceholder) {
  165|    mergedSelectProps.maxTagPlaceholder = selectProps.maxTagPlaceholder;
  166|  }
  167|
  168|  // Transform options if custom render is provided
  169|  const transformedOptions = optionRender
  170|    ? options.map((option) => ({
  171|        ...option,
  172|        label: optionRender(option),
  173|      }))
  174|    : options;
  175|
  176|  return (
  177|    <Form.Item
  178|      name={name}
  179|      label={label}
  180|      rules={normalizedRules}
  181|      required={required}
  182|      tooltip={tooltip}
  183|      help={help}
  184|      extra={extra}
  185|      className={className}
  186|      style={style}
  187|      hidden={hidden}
  188|      {...formItemProps}
  189|    >
  190|      <Select
  191|        placeholder={placeholder || `Select ${label?.toString().toLowerCase() || name?.toString()}`}
  192|        options={transformedOptions}
  193|        {...mergedSelectProps}
  194|      />
  195|    </Form.Item>
  196|  );
  197|};

   26|  maxCount = 1,
   27|  accept,
   28|  uploadProps,
   29|  children,
   30|  ...formItemProps
   31|}: FormItemUploadDraggerProps) => {
   32|  const mergedUpload: UploadProps = {
   33|    maxCount,
   34|    ...(accept ? { accept } : {}),
   35|    beforeUpload: () => false,
   36|    ...uploadProps,
   37|  };
   38|
   39|  const hasFormField =
   40|    name !== undefined && name !== '' && !(Array.isArray(name) && name.length === 0);
   41|
   42|  return (
   43|    <Form.Item
   44|      name={name}
   45|      label={label}
   46|      rules={rules}
   47|      required={required}
   48|      tooltip={tooltip}
   49|      help={help}
   50|      extra={extra}
   51|      className={cn(className)}
   52|      style={style}
   53|      hidden={hidden}
   54|      {...(hasFormField ? { valuePropName, ...(getValueFromEvent ? { getValueFromEvent } : {}) } : {})}
   55|      {...formItemProps}
   56|    >
   57|      <Upload.Dragger disabled={disabled ?? mergedUpload.disabled} {...mergedUpload}>
   58|        {children as ReactNode}
   59|      </Upload.Dragger>
   60|    </Form.Item>
   61|  );
   62|};

    1|import { useCallback, useMemo, type ReactNode } from 'react';
    2|import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    3|import { Alert, Form, Input, Row, Col } from 'antd';
    4|import type { FormInstance } from 'antd/es/form';
    5|import { FormItemSelect, AddressAutocomplete } from '@/components/form';
    6|import { useTranslation } from '@/hooks/useTranslation';
    7|import {
    8|  fetchVnDistrictWithWards,
    9|  fetchVnProvinceList,
   10|  fetchVnProvinceWithDistricts,
   11|} from '@/utils/vnProvincesOpenApi';
   12|
   13|export interface VnAdminAddressFieldsProps {
   14|  form: FormInstance;
   15|  /** `''` → `addr_province_code`; `'start_'` → `start_addr_province_code` */
   16|  fieldPrefix?: string;
   17|  /** When true, province/district/ward/street are required unless {@link relaxCascadeRequired}. */
   18|  cascadeRequired: boolean;
   19|  /** When true, cascade fields are optional (keep existing saved line without re-picking). */
   20|  relaxCascadeRequired?: boolean;
   21|  /** Shown as info when re-editing an existing saved address line. */
   22|  legacySavedAddress?: string;
   23|  /** Optional section title above fields (e.g. trip start vs end). */
   24|  heading?: ReactNode;
   25|  /** Disables all fields (e.g. terminal trip status). */
   26|  disabled?: boolean;
   27|  /** Callback when an address is selected from autocomplete, providing lat/lng and full label. */
   28|  onAddressSelected?: (lat: number, lng: number, label: string) => void;
   29|}
   30|
   31|export function VnAdminAddressFields(props: VnAdminAddressFieldsProps) {
   32|  const {
   33|    form,
   34|    fieldPrefix = '',
   35|    cascadeRequired,
   36|    relaxCascadeRequired = false,
   37|    legacySavedAddress,
   38|    heading,
   39|    disabled = false,
   40|    onAddressSelected,
   41|  } = props;
   42|  const { t } = useTranslation();
   43|  const key = useMemo(() => (name: string) => `${fieldPrefix}${name}`, [fieldPrefix]);
   44|
   45|  const provinceListQuery = useQuery({
   46|    queryKey: ['vn-open-api', 'provinces'],
   47|    queryFn: fetchVnProvinceList,
   48|    staleTime: 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000,
   49|  });
   50|
   51|  const provinceCodeWatch = Form.useWatch(key('addr_province_code'), form);
   52|  const districtCodeWatch = Form.useWatch(key('addr_district_code'), form);
   53|
   54|  const provinceDetailQuery = useQuery({
   55|    queryKey: ['vn-open-api', 'province', fieldPrefix, provinceCodeWatch],
   56|    queryFn: () => fetchVnProvinceWithDistricts(Number(provinceCodeWatch)),
   57|    enabled: typeof provinceCodeWatch === 'number' && !Number.isNaN(provinceCodeWatch),
   58|  });
   59|
   60|  const districtDetailQuery = useQuery({
   61|    queryKey: ['vn-open-api', 'district', fieldPrefix, districtCodeWatch],
   62|    queryFn: () => fetchVnDistrictWithWards(Number(districtCodeWatch)),
   63|    enabled: typeof districtCodeWatch === 'number' && !Number.isNaN(districtCodeWatch),
   64|  });
   65|
   66|  const provinceOptions = useMemo(() => {
   67|    const rows = provinceListQuery.data ?? [];
   68|    return [...rows]
   69|      .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name, 'vi'))
   70|      .map((row) => ({ label: row.name, value: row.code }));
   71|  }, [provinceListQuery.data]);
   72|
   73|  const districtOptions = useMemo(() => {
   74|    const rows = provinceDetailQuery.data?.districts ?? [];
   75|    return [...rows]
   76|      .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name, 'vi'))
   77|      .map((row) => ({ label: row.name, value: row.code }));
   78|  }, [provinceDetailQuery.data]);
   79|
   80|  const wardOptions = useMemo(() => {
   81|    const rows = districtDetailQuery.data?.wards ?? [];
   82|    return [...rows]
   83|      .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name, 'vi'))
   84|      .map((row) => ({ label: row.name, value: row.code }));
   85|  }, [districtDetailQuery.data]);
   86|
   87|  const onProvinceChange = useCallback(
   88|    (value: unknown) => {
   89|      const code = typeof value === 'number' ? value : Number(value);
   90|      const label = provinceOptions.find((o) => o.value === code)?.label as string | undefined;
   91|      form.setFieldsValue({
   92|        [key('addr_province_name')]: label,
   93|        [key('addr_district_code')]: undefined,
   94|        [key('addr_district_name')]: undefined,
   95|        [key('addr_ward_code')]: undefined,
   96|        [key('addr_ward_name')]: undefined,
   97|      });
   98|    },
   99|    [form, key, provinceOptions],
  100|  );
  101|
  102|  const onDistrictChange = useCallback(
  103|    (value: unknown) => {
  104|      const code = typeof value === 'number' ? value : Number(value);
  105|      const label = districtOptions.find((o) => o.value === code)?.label as string | undefined;
  106|      form.setFieldsValue({
  107|        [key('addr_district_name')]: label,
  108|        [key('addr_ward_code')]: undefined,
  109|        [key('addr_ward_name')]: undefined,
  110|      });
  111|    },
  112|    [districtOptions, form, key],
  113|  );
  114|
  115|  const onWardChange = useCallback(
  116|    (value: unknown) => {
  117|      const code = typeof value === 'number' ? value : Number(value);
  118|      const label = wardOptions.find((o) => o.value === code)?.label as string | undefined;
  119|      form.setFieldsValue({ [key('addr_ward_name')]: label });
  120|    },
  121|    [form, key, wardOptions],
  122|  );
  123|
  124|  const addrRequired = cascadeRequired && !relaxCascadeRequired;
  125|  const reqRule = (fieldKey: 'province' | 'district' | 'ward' | 'street') =>
  126|    addrRequired
  127|      ? [
  128|          {
  129|            required: true,
  130|            message: t('validation.required', { field: t(`vnAddress.${fieldKey}`) }),
  131|          },
  132|        ]
  133|      : [];
  134|
  135|  return (
  136|    <div className="space-y-0">
  137|      {heading ? <div className="mb-2 font-medium text-sm">{heading}</div> : null}
  138|      {legacySavedAddress?.trim() ? (
  139|        <Alert
  140|          type="info"
  141|          showIcon
  142|          className="mb-2"
  143|          message={t('vnAddress.legacyHintTitle')}
  144|          description={legacySavedAddress.trim()}
  145|        />
  146|      ) : null}
  147|      <Form.Item name={key('addr_province_name')} hidden>
  148|        <Input type="hidden" />
  149|      </Form.Item>
  150|      <Form.Item name={key('addr_district_name')} hidden>
  151|        <Input type="hidden" />
  152|      </Form.Item>
  153|      <Form.Item name={key('addr_ward_name')} hidden>
  154|        <Input type="hidden" />
  155|      </Form.Item>
  156|      
  157|      <Row gutter={16}>
  158|        <Col span={12}>
  159|          <FormItemSelect
  160|            name={key('addr_province_code')}
  161|            label={t('vnAddress.province')}
  162|            required={addrRequired}
  163|            disabled={disabled}
  164|            options={provinceOptions}
  165|            showSearch
  166|            loading={provinceListQuery.isPending}
  167|            help={provinceListQuery.isError ? t('vnAddress.catalogLoadError') : undefined}
  168|            validateStatus={provinceListQuery.isError ? 'warning' : undefined}
  169|            selectProps={{ optionFilterProp: 'label', listHeight: 280 }}
  170|            rules={reqRule('province')}
  171|            onChange={onProvinceChange}
  172|          />
  173|        </Col>
  174|        <Col span={12}>
  175|          <FormItemSelect
  176|            name={key('addr_district_code')}
  177|            label={t('vnAddress.district')}
  178|            required={addrRequired}
  179|            disabled={disabled || !provinceCodeWatch}
  180|            options={districtOptions}
  181|            showSearch
  182|            loading={provinceDetailQuery.isPending && !!provinceCodeWatch}
  183|            help={provinceDetailQuery.isError ? t('vnAddress.districtLoadError') : undefined}
  184|            validateStatus={provinceDetailQuery.isError ? 'warning' : undefined}
  185|            selectProps={{ optionFilterProp: 'label', listHeight: 280 }}
  186|            rules={reqRule('district')}
  187|            onChange={onDistrictChange}
  188|          />
  189|        </Col>
  190|      </Row>
  191|
  192|      <Row gutter={16}>
  193|        <Col span={12}>
  194|          <FormItemSelect
  195|            name={key('addr_ward_code')}
  196|            label={t('vnAddress.ward')}
  197|            required={addrRequired}
  198|            disabled={disabled || !districtCodeWatch}
  199|            options={wardOptions}
  200|            showSearch
  201|            loading={districtDetailQuery.isPending && !!districtCodeWatch}
  202|            help={districtDetailQuery.isError ? t('vnAddress.wardLoadError') : undefined}
  203|            validateStatus={districtDetailQuery.isError ? 'warning' : undefined}
  204|            selectProps={{ optionFilterProp: 'label', listHeight: 280 }}
  205|            rules={reqRule('ward')}
  206|            onChange={onWardChange}
  207|          />
  208|        </Col>
  209|        <Col span={12}>
  210|          <Form.Item
  211|            name={key('addr_street_detail')}
  212|            label={t('vnAddress.street')}
  213|            required={addrRequired}
  214|            rules={reqRule('street')}
  215|          >
  216|            <AddressAutocomplete
  217|              disabled={disabled}
  218|              placeholder={t('vnAddress.streetPlaceholder')}
  219|              onSelect={(lat, lng, label) => {
  220|                form.setFieldValue(key('addr_street_detail'), label);
  221|                if (onAddressSelected) {
  222|                  onAddressSelected(lat, lng, label);
  223|                }
  224|              }}
  225|            />
  226|          </Form.Item>
  227|        </Col>
  228|      </Row>
  229|    </div>
  230|  );

    1|import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
    2|import { Empty, Table } from 'antd';
    3|import type { TableColumnsType } from 'antd';
    4|
    5|type DataTableRecord = { id?: string | number };
    6|
    7|export type DataTableColumn<T extends DataTableRecord> = {
    8|  key: string;
    9|  header: ReactNode;
   10|  dataIndex?: keyof T | string;
   11|  render?: (record: T) => ReactNode;
   12|};
   13|
   14|type DataTablePagination = {
   15|  current: number;
   16|  total: number;
   17|  pageSize: number;
   18|  onPageChange: (page: number) => void;
   19|};
   20|
   21|type DataTableProps<T extends DataTableRecord> = {
   22|  data: T[];
   23|  columns: DataTableColumn<T>[];
   24|  onRowClick?: (record: T) => void;
   25|  emptyMessage?: ReactNode;
   26|  emptyDescription?: ReactNode;
   27|  emptyAction?: ReactNode;
   28|  pagination?: DataTablePagination;
   29|};
   30|
   31|export const DataTable = <T extends DataTableRecord>({
   32|  data,
   33|  columns,
   34|  onRowClick,
   35|  emptyMessage,
   36|  emptyDescription,
   37|  emptyAction,
   38|  pagination,
   39|}: DataTableProps<T>) => {
   40|  const tableColumns: TableColumnsType<T> = columns.map((column) => ({
   41|    key: column.key,
   42|    title: column.header,
   43|    dataIndex: column.dataIndex as string | undefined,
   44|    render: (_: unknown, record: T) => {
   45|      if (column.render) {
   46|        return column.render(record);
   47|      }
   48|      if (!column.dataIndex) {
   49|        return null;
   50|      }
   51|      return String((record as Record<string, unknown>)[column.dataIndex as string] ?? '');
   52|    },
   53|  }));
   54|
   55|  return (
   56|    <Table<T>
   57|      rowKey={(record, index) => {
   58|        const id = record.id;
   59|        if (typeof id === 'string' || typeof id === 'number') {
   60|          return id;
   61|        }
   62|        return String(index ?? 0);
   63|      }}
   64|      dataSource={data}
   65|      columns={tableColumns}
   66|      locale={{
   67|        emptyText: (
   68|          <Empty
   69|            description={emptyDescription ?? emptyMessage}
   70|            image={Empty.PRESENTED_IMAGE_SIMPLE}
   71|          >
   72|            {emptyAction}
   73|          </Empty>
   74|        ),
   75|      }}
   76|      onRow={
   77|        onRowClick
   78|          ? (record) => ({
   79|              onClick: () => onRowClick(record),
   80|              style: { cursor: 'pointer' },
   81|            })
   82|          : undefined
   83|      }
   84|      pagination={
   85|        pagination
   86|          ? {
   87|              current: pagination.current,
   88|              total: pagination.total,
   89|              pageSize: pagination.pageSize,
   90|              onChange: pagination.onPageChange,
   91|            }
   92|          : false
   93|      }
   94|      scroll={{ x: 'max-content' }}
   95|    />
   96|  );
   97|};

    4|type ButtonVariant = 'default' | 'outline' | 'ghost' | 'secondary' | 'destructive';

    6|
    7|export type ButtonProps = Omit<AntButtonProps, 'size' | 'type' | 'variant'> & {
    8|  variant?: ButtonVariant;
    9|  size?: ButtonSize;
   10|  type?: 'button' | 'submit' | 'reset';
   11|};
   12|
   13|const mapVariantToAntType = (variant: ButtonVariant | undefined): AntButtonProps['type'] => {
   14|  if (variant === 'outline' || variant === 'ghost') return 'default';
   15|  if (variant === 'destructive') return 'primary';
   16|  return 'primary';
   17|};
   18|
   19|const mapSizeToAntSize = (size: ButtonSize | undefined): AntButtonProps['size'] => {
   20|  if (size === 'sm') return 'small';
   21|  if (size === 'lg') return 'large';
   22|  return 'middle';
   23|};
   24|

   27|  ref

   29|  return (
   30|    <AntButton
   31|      ref={ref}
   32|      className={className}
   33|      type={mapVariantToAntType(variant)}
   34|      size={mapSizeToAntSize(size)}
   35|      htmlType={type}
   36|      danger={danger ?? variant === 'destructive'}

  117|const ChartTooltip = RechartsPrimitive.Tooltip
  118|
  119|function ChartTooltipContent({
  120|  active,
  121|  payload,
  122|  className,
  123|  indicator = "dot",
  124|  hideLabel = false,
  125|  hideIndicator = false,
  126|  label,
  127|  labelFormatter,
  128|  labelClassName,
  129|  formatter,
  130|  color,
  131|  nameKey,
  132|  labelKey,
  133|}: React.ComponentProps<typeof RechartsPrimitive.Tooltip> &
  134|  React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
  135|    hideLabel?: boolean
  136|    hideIndicator?: boolean
  137|    indicator?: "line" | "dot" | "dashed"
  138|    nameKey?: string
  139|    labelKey?: string
  140|  } & Omit<
  141|    RechartsPrimitive.DefaultTooltipContentProps<
  142|      TooltipValueType,
  143|      TooltipNameType
  144|    >,
  145|    "accessibilityLayer"
  146|  >) {
  147|  const { config } = useChart()
  148|
  149|  const tooltipLabel = React.useMemo(() => {
  150|    if (hideLabel || !payload?.length) {
  151|      return null
  152|    }
  153|
  154|    const [item] = payload
  155|    const key = `${labelKey ?? item?.dataKey ?? item?.name ?? "value"}`
  156|    const itemConfig = getPayloadConfigFromPayload(config, item, key)
  157|    const value =
  158|      !labelKey && typeof label === "string"
  159|        ? (config[label]?.label ?? label)
  160|        : itemConfig?.label
  161|
  162|    if (labelFormatter) {
  163|      return (
  164|        <div className={cn("font-medium", labelClassName)}>
  165|          {labelFormatter(value, payload)}
  166|        </div>
  167|      )
  168|    }
  169|
  170|    if (!value) {
  171|      return null
  172|    }
  173|
  174|    return <div className={cn("font-medium", labelClassName)}>{value}</div>
  175|  }, [
  176|    label,
  177|    labelFormatter,
  178|    payload,
  179|    hideLabel,
  180|    labelClassName,
  181|    config,
  182|    labelKey,
  183|  ])
  184|
  185|  if (!active || !payload?.length) {
  186|    return null
  187|  }
  188|
  189|  const nestLabel = payload.length === 1 && indicator !== "dot"
  190|
  191|  return (
  192|    <div
  193|      className={cn(
  194|        "grid min-w-32 items-start gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-border/50 bg-background px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs shadow-xl",
  195|        className
  196|      )}
  197|    >
  198|      {!nestLabel ? tooltipLabel : null}
  199|      <div className="grid gap-1.5">
  200|        {payload
  201|          .filter((item) => item.type !== "none")
  202|          .map((item, index) => {
  203|            const key = `${nameKey ?? item.name ?? item.dataKey ?? "value"}`
  204|            const itemConfig = getPayloadConfigFromPayload(config, item, key)
  205|            const indicatorColor = color ?? item.payload?.fill ?? item.color
  206|
  207|            return (
  208|              <div
  209|                key={index}
  210|                className={cn(
  211|                  "flex w-full flex-wrap items-stretch gap-2 [&>svg]:h-2.5 [&>svg]:w-2.5 [&>svg]:text-muted-foreground",
  212|                  indicator === "dot" && "items-center"
  213|                )}
  214|              >
  215|                {formatter && item?.value !== undefined && item.name ? (
  216|                  formatter(item.value, item.name, item, index, item.payload)
  217|                ) : (
  218|                  <>
  219|                    {itemConfig?.icon ? (
  220|                      <itemConfig.icon />
  221|                    ) : (
  222|                      !hideIndicator && (
  223|                        <div
  224|                          className={cn(
  225|                            "shrink-0 rounded-[2px] border-(--color-border) bg-(--color-bg)",
  226|                            {
  227|                              "h-2.5 w-2.5": indicator === "dot",
  228|                              "w-1": indicator === "line",
  229|                              "w-0 border-[1.5px] border-dashed bg-transparent":
  230|                                indicator === "dashed",
  231|                              "my-0.5": nestLabel && indicator === "dashed",
  232|                            }
  233|                          )}
  234|                          style={
  235|                            {
  236|                              "--color-bg": indicatorColor,
  237|                              "--color-border": indicatorColor,
  238|                            } as React.CSSProperties
  239|                          }
  240|                        />
  241|                      )
  242|                    )}
  243|                    <div
  244|                      className={cn(
  245|                        "flex flex-1 justify-between leading-none",
  246|                        nestLabel ? "items-end" : "items-center"
  247|                      )}
  248|                    >
  249|                      <div className="grid gap-1.5">
  250|                        {nestLabel ? tooltipLabel : null}
  251|                        <span className="text-muted-foreground">
  252|                          {itemConfig?.label ?? item.name}
  253|                        </span>
  254|                      </div>
  255|                      {item.value != null && (
  256|                        <span className="font-mono font-medium text-foreground tabular-nums">
  257|                          {typeof item.value === "number"
  258|                            ? item.value.toLocaleString()
  259|                            : String(item.value)}
  260|                        </span>
  261|                      )}
  262|                    </div>
  263|                  </>
  264|                )}
  265|              </div>
  266|            )
  267|          })}
  268|      </div>
  269|    </div>
  270|  )
  271|}
  272|
  273|const ChartLegend = RechartsPrimitive.Legend
  274|
  275|function ChartLegendContent({
  276|  className,
  277|  hideIcon = false,
  278|  payload,
  279|  verticalAlign = "bottom",
  280|  nameKey,
  281|}: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
  282|  hideIcon?: boolean
  283|  nameKey?: string
  284|} & RechartsPrimitive.DefaultLegendContentProps) {
  285|  const { config } = useChart()
  286|
  287|  if (!payload?.length) {
  288|    return null
  289|  }
  290|
  291|  return (
  292|    <div
  293|      className={cn(
  294|        "flex items-center justify-center gap-4",
  295|        verticalAlign === "top" ? "pb-3" : "pt-3",
  296|        className
  297|      )}
  298|    >
  299|      {payload
  300|        .filter((item) => item.type !== "none")
  301|        .map((item, index) => {
  302|          const key = `${nameKey ?? item.dataKey ?? "value"}`
  303|          const itemConfig = getPayloadConfigFromPayload(config, item, key)
  304|
  305|          return (
  306|            <div
  307|              key={index}
  308|              className={cn(
  309|                "flex items-center gap-1.5 [&>svg]:h-3 [&>svg]:w-3 [&>svg]:text-muted-foreground"
  310|              )}
  311|            >
  312|              {itemConfig?.icon && !hideIcon ? (
  313|                <itemConfig.icon />
  314|              ) : (
  315|                <div
  316|                  className="h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-[2px]"
  317|                  style={{
  318|                    backgroundColor: item.color,
  319|                  }}
  320|                />
  321|              )}
  322|              {itemConfig?.label}
  323|            </div>
  324|          )
  325|        })}
  326|    </div>
  327|  )
  328|}
  329|
  330|function getPayloadConfigFromPayload(
  331|  config: ChartConfig,
  332|  payload: unknown,
  333|  key: string
  334|) {
  335|  if (typeof payload !== "object" || payload === null) {
  336|    return undefined
  337|  }
  338|
  339|  const payloadPayload =
  340|    "payload" in payload &&
  341|    typeof payload.payload === "object" &&
  342|    payload.payload !== null
  343|      ? payload.payload
  344|      : undefined
  345|
  346|  let configLabelKey: string = key
  347|
  348|  if (
  349|    key in payload &&
  350|    typeof payload[key as keyof typeof payload] === "string"
  351|  ) {
  352|    configLabelKey = payload[key as keyof typeof payload] as string
  353|  } else if (
  354|    payloadPayload &&
  355|    key in payloadPayload &&
  356|    typeof payloadPayload[key as keyof typeof payloadPayload] === "string"
  357|  ) {
  358|    configLabelKey = payloadPayload[
  359|      key as keyof typeof payloadPayload
  360|    ] as string
  361|  }
  362|
  363|  return configLabelKey in config ? config[configLabelKey] : config[key]
  364|}

  369|  ChartTooltipContent,
  370|  ChartLegend,
  371|  ChartLegendContent,
  372|  ChartStyle,
  373|}

===== FILE: src/config/env.ts =====
    1|/**
    2| * Centralized environment configuration.
    3| * Consolidates import.meta.env values and provides derived API URLs.
    4| */
    5|
    6|const getEnv = (key: string, defaultValue = ''): string => {
    7|  const value = import.meta.env[key];
    8|  if (typeof value === 'string') {
    9|    return value.trim() || defaultValue;
   10|  }
   11|  return value != null ? String(value) : defaultValue;
   12|};
   13|
   14|const IS_DEV = import.meta.env.DEV;
   15|
   16|// Origin: scheme + host + port (e.g., http://localhost:8080)
   17|const API_ORIGIN = getEnv('VITE_API_ORIGIN', IS_DEV ? '' : 'http://localhost:8080');
   18|
   19|// Prefix: e.g., /api
   20|const API_PREFIX = getEnv('VITE_API_BASE_URL', '/api');
   21|
   22|// Derived URLs
   23|const API_BASE_URL = IS_DEV ? API_PREFIX : `${API_ORIGIN}${API_PREFIX}`;
   24|const API_ROOT_URL = IS_DEV ? '/' : API_ORIGIN || '/';
   25|
   26|export const ENV = {
   27|  IS_DEV,
   28|  API_ORIGIN,
   29|  API_PREFIX,
   30|  API_BASE_URL,
   31|  API_ROOT_URL,
   32|  GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID: getEnv('VITE_GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID'),
   33|};

===== FILE: src/features/dashboard/hooks/useDashboardAnalytics.ts =====
    1|import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    2|import { useState } from 'react';
    3|import dayjs from 'dayjs';
    4|import { dashboardService } from '../services/dashboard.service';
    5|import { DashboardFilters } from '../types';
    6|
    7|export function useDashboardAnalytics(initialCompanyId?: number) {
    8|  const [filters, setFilters] = useState<DashboardFilters>({
    9|    companyId: initialCompanyId,
   10|    dateRange: [
   11|      dayjs().subtract(30, 'day').toISOString(),
   12|      dayjs().toISOString(),
   13|    ],
   14|  });
   15|
   16|  const query = useQuery({
   17|    queryKey: ['dashboard', 'analytics', filters],
   18|    queryFn: () => dashboardService.getAnalytics(filters),
   19|    // Refresh every 5 minutes automatically
   20|    refetchInterval: 300000,
   21|  });
   22|
   23|  const setDateRange = (range: [dayjs.Dayjs, dayjs.Dayjs]) => {
   24|    setFilters((prev) => ({
   25|      ...prev,
   26|      dateRange: [range[0].toISOString(), range[1].toISOString()],
   27|    }));
   28|  };
   29|
   30|  const setCompanyId = (companyId?: number) => {
   31|    setFilters((prev) => ({ ...prev, companyId }));
   32|  };
   33|
   34|  return {
   35|    filters,
   36|    setFilters,
   37|    setDateRange,
   38|    setCompanyId,
   39|    analytics: query.data,
   40|    isLoading: query.isLoading || query.isFetching,
   41|    isError: query.isError,
   42|    refresh: () => query.refetch(),
   43|    query,
   44|  };
   45|}
   46|

   52|export function mergeCrudFilters(filters: CrudFilter[] = [], overrides: CrudFilter[] = []) {
   53|  const map = new Map<string, CrudFilter>()
   54|
   55|  for (const filter of [...filters, ...overrides]) {
   56|    if ('field' in filter) {
   57|      map.set(String(filter.field), filter)
   58|    }
   59|  }
   60|
   61|  return [...map.values()]
   62|}

   68|    if ('field' in sorter) {
   69|      map.set(String(sorter.field), sorter)
   70|    }
   71|  }
   72|
   73|  return [...map.values()]

   78|  if (typeof file.url === 'string' && file.url) return file.url
   79|
   80|  const responseUrl = file.response && typeof file.response === 'object'
   81|    ? (file.response as Record<string, unknown>).url
   82|    : undefined
   83|
   84|  return typeof responseUrl === 'string' ? responseUrl : null

   91|  return mimeMatches && extensionMatches

===== FILE: src/hooks/useAppFeedback.ts =====
    1|import { useMemo } from 'react';
    2|import { App } from 'antd';
    3|import type { MessageInstance } from 'antd/es/message/interface';
    4|import type { NotificationInstance } from 'antd/es/notification/interface';
    5|import type { HookAPI as ModalHookApi } from 'antd/es/modal/useModal';
    6|
    7|export type FeedbackPayload =
    8|  | string
    9|  | {
   10|      title?: string;
   11|      message?: string;
   12|      description?: string;
   13|      duration?: number;
   14|    };
   15|
   16|export interface FeedbackConfirmOptions {
   17|  title: string;
   18|  content?: string;
   19|  okText?: string;
   20|  cancelText?: string;
   21|  okType?: 'primary' | 'danger';
   22|  onOk: () => void | Promise<void>;
   23|  onCancel?: () => void;
   24|}
   25|
   26|export interface AppFeedback {
   27|  success: (payload: FeedbackPayload) => void;
   28|  error: (payload: FeedbackPayload) => void;
   29|  info: (payload: FeedbackPayload) => void;
   30|  warning: (payload: FeedbackPayload) => void;
   31|  loading: (payload: FeedbackPayload) => void;
   32|  confirm: (options: FeedbackConfirmOptions) => void;
   33|  message: MessageInstance;
   34|  notification: NotificationInstance;
   35|  modal: ModalHookApi;
   36|}
   37|
   38|const resolveContent = (payload: FeedbackPayload): { content: string; duration?: number } => {
   39|  if (typeof payload === 'string') {
   40|    return { content: payload };
   41|  }
   42|  const content = payload.message ?? payload.title ?? payload.description ?? '';
   43|  return { content, duration: payload.duration };
   44|};
   45|
   46|const resolveNotification = (payload: FeedbackPayload) => {
   47|  if (typeof payload === 'string') {
   48|    return { message: payload };
   49|  }
   50|  return {
   51|    message: payload.title ?? payload.message ?? '',
   52|    description: payload.description,
   53|    duration: payload.duration,
   54|  };
   55|};
   56|
   57|export function useAppFeedback(): AppFeedback {
   58|  const { message, notification, modal } = App.useApp();
   59|
   60|  return useMemo<AppFeedback>(() => {
   61|    const buildBasic = (kind: 'success' | 'error' | 'info' | 'warning' | 'loading') =>
   62|      (payload: FeedbackPayload) => {
   63|        if (typeof payload === 'string') {
   64|          message.open({ type: kind, content: payload });
   65|          return;
   66|        }
   67|        if (payload.description) {
   68|          const notiKind = kind === 'loading' ? 'info' : kind;
   69|          notification[notiKind](resolveNotification(payload));
   70|          return;
   71|        }
   72|        const { content, duration } = resolveContent(payload);
   73|        message.open({ type: kind, content, duration });
   74|      };
   75|
   76|    return {
   77|      success: buildBasic('success'),
   78|      error: buildBasic('error'),
   79|      info: buildBasic('info'),
   80|      warning: buildBasic('warning'),
   81|      loading: buildBasic('loading'),
   82|      confirm: ({ title, content, okText, cancelText, okType, onOk, onCancel }) => {
   83|        modal.confirm({
   84|          title,
   85|          content,
   86|          okText: okText ?? 'OK',
   87|          cancelText: cancelText ?? 'Huỷ',
   88|          okButtonProps: okType === 'danger' ? { danger: true } : undefined,
   89|          onOk,
   90|          onCancel,
   91|        });
   92|      },
   93|      message,
   94|      notification,
   95|      modal,
   96|    };
   97|  }, [message, notification, modal]);
   98|}
   99|

===== FILE: src/hooks/useAuth.ts =====
    1|import { useEffect } from 'react';
    2|import { useAuthStore } from '@/stores/auth.store';
    3|import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
    4|import { ROUTES } from '@/routes';
    5|import { userHasRole, userHasPermission } from '@/utils/authPermissions';
    6|
    7|export const useAuth = () => {
    8|  const { user, isAuthenticated, isLoading, checkAuth } = useAuthStore();
    9|  const navigate = useNavigate();
   10|
   11|  useEffect(() => {
   12|    if (!isAuthenticated && !isLoading) {
   13|      checkAuth();
   14|    }
   15|  }, [isAuthenticated, isLoading, checkAuth]);
   16|
   17|  const requireAuth = () => {
   18|    if (!isAuthenticated && !isLoading) {
   19|      navigate(ROUTES.login);
   20|      return false;
   21|    }
   22|    return true;
   23|  };
   24|
   25|  const hasRole = (role: string): boolean => userHasRole(user, role);
   26|  const hasPermission = (permission: string): boolean => userHasPermission(user, permission);
   27|
   28|  return {
   29|    user,
   30|    isAuthenticated,
   31|    isLoading,
   32|    requireAuth,
   33|    hasRole,
   34|    hasPermission,
   35|  };
   36|};

===== FILE: src/hooks/useBoolean.ts =====
    1|import { useCallback, useState } from 'react'
    2|
    3|export function useBoolean(initialValue = false) {
    4|  const [value, setValue] = useState(initialValue)
    5|
    6|  const setTrue = useCallback(() => setValue(true), [])
    7|  const setFalse = useCallback(() => setValue(false), [])
    8|  const toggle = useCallback(() => setValue((current) => !current), [])
    9|
   10|  return {
   11|    value,
   12|    setValue,
   13|    setTrue,
   14|    setFalse,
   15|    toggle,
   16|  }
