    4|import type { ChatTask } from '@/utils/chatPrompt';
    5|import { getErrorMessage, getErrorStatus } from '@/utils/errorHandler';
    6|import {
    7|  extractChatSources,
    8|  getFirstString,
    9|  normalizeText,
   10|  sleep,
   11|  toStringId,
   12|  type ChatSource,
   13|} from '@/components/common/chat/chatUtils';
   14|import type { ChatMessageView } from '@/components/common/chat/ChatMessageList';
   15|
   16|const DEFAULT_MODEL = 'gemini-2.0-flash';
   17|
   18|interface UseChatAssistantOptions {
   19|  model?: string;
   20|  task?: ChatTask;
   21|  contextJson?: string;
   22|  onSuccess?: () => void;
   23|  onError?: (error: unknown) => void;
   24|  toast: any;
   25|}
   26|
   27|export function useChatAssistant({
   28|  model = DEFAULT_MODEL,
   29|  task = 'chat',
   30|  contextJson = '',
   31|  onSuccess,
   32|  onError,
   33|  toast,
   34|}: UseChatAssistantOptions) {
   35|  const { t } = useTranslation();
   36|  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<ChatMessageView[]>([]);
   37|  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);
   38|  const [sessionId, setSessionId] = useState<string>('');
   39|  const abortControllerRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
   40|
   41|  const sendMessage = useCallback(async (content: string) => {
   42|    if (sending) return;
   43|
   44|    // Create new abort controller for this request
   45|    if (abortControllerRef.current) {
   46|      abortControllerRef.current.abort();
   47|    }
   48|    abortControllerRef.current = new AbortController();
   49|
   50|    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
   51|    const optimisticUserId = `tmp-user-${Date.now()}`;
   52|    const optimisticAssistantId = `tmp-assistant-${Date.now()}`;
   53|
   54|    setMessages((prev) => [
   55|      ...prev,
   56|      { id: optimisticUserId, role: 'user', content, createdAt: nowIso },
   57|      {
   58|        id: optimisticAssistantId,
   59|        role: 'assistant',
   60|        content: t('notificationCenter.chat.waitingResponse'),
   61|        createdAt: nowIso,
   62|        model: model.trim() || DEFAULT_MODEL,
   63|        isPending: true,
   64|      },
   65|    ]);
   66|
   67|    setSending(true);
   68|
   69|    let context: Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   70|    if (contextJson?.trim()) {
   71|      try {
   72|        const parsed = JSON.parse(contextJson);
   73|        context = parsed;
   74|      } catch {
   75|        // Fallback or ignore
   76|      }
   77|    }
   78|
   79|    try {
   80|      let donePayload;
   81|      let lastError: unknown;
   82|      let hadAnyStreamChunk = false;
   83|      let streamSessionId = '';
   84|      let streamMeta: { cached?: boolean; guarded?: boolean } = {};
   85|      let finalAssistantText = '';
   86|      let finalAssistantModel = '';
   87|      let finalSources: ChatSource[] | undefined;
   88|
   89|      for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 2; attempt += 1) {
   90|        if (abortControllerRef.current?.signal.aborted) break;
   91|        
   92|        let attemptHadChunk = false;
   93|        try {
   94|          donePayload = await chatService.sendMessageStream(
   95|            {
   96|              message: content,
   97|              session_id: sessionId || undefined,
   98|              task,
   99|              context,
  100|              model: model.trim() || DEFAULT_MODEL,
  101|            },
  102|            {
  103|              onMeta: (meta) => {
  104|                streamSessionId = toStringId(meta.session_id) || streamSessionId;
  105|                streamMeta = { cached: meta.cached, guarded: meta.guarded };
  106|              },
  107|              onChunk: (chunk) => {
  108|                if (!chunk.text) return;
  109|                attemptHadChunk = true;
  110|                hadAnyStreamChunk = true;
  111|                setMessages((prev) =>
  112|                  prev.map((item) =>
  113|                    item.id === optimisticAssistantId
  114|                      ? {
  115|                          ...item,
  116|                          content:
  117|                            item.content === t('notificationCenter.chat.waitingResponse')
  118|                              ? chunk.text ?? ''
  119|                              : `${item.content}${chunk.text ?? ''}`,
  120|                          isPending: true,
  121|                          isError: false,
  122|                        }
  123|                      : item
  124|                  )
  125|                );
  126|              },
  127|              onDone: (done) => {
  128|                streamSessionId =
  129|                  toStringId(done.session_id ?? done.session?.session_id ?? done.session?.id) ||
  130|                  streamSessionId;
  131|                streamMeta = { cached: done.cached, guarded: done.guarded };
  132|                const resolvedText = normalizeText(done.response_text ?? done.message?.response ?? '');
  133|                if (resolvedText) finalAssistantText = resolvedText;
  134|                const resolvedModel =
  135|                  getFirstString(done.message, ['model']) || getFirstString(done, ['model']);
  136|                if (resolvedModel) finalAssistantModel = resolvedModel;
  137|                const src = extractChatSources(done);
  138|                if (src?.length) finalSources = src;
  139|              },
  140|              onError: (streamError) => {
  141|                throw new Error(streamError.message || t('notificationCenter.chat.sendError'));
  142|              },
  143|            },
  144|            abortControllerRef.current?.signal
  145|          );
  146|
  147|          if (!donePayload && !attemptHadChunk) {
  148|            const fallbackResponse = await chatService.sendMessage({
  149|              message: content,
  150|              task,
  151|              context,
  152|              model: model.trim() || DEFAULT_MODEL,
  153|            });
  154|            if (!fallbackResponse.success)
  155|              throw new Error(fallbackResponse.message || t('notificationCenter.chat.sendError'));
  156|            donePayload = fallbackResponse.data;
  157|            streamSessionId =
  158|              toStringId(donePayload?.session_id ?? donePayload?.session?.session_id ?? donePayload?.session?.id) ||
  159|              streamSessionId;
  160|            streamMeta = { cached: donePayload?.cached, guarded: donePayload?.guarded };
  161|            const resolvedText = normalizeText(
  162|              donePayload?.response_text ?? donePayload?.message?.response ?? ''
  163|            );
  164|            if (resolvedText) finalAssistantText = resolvedText;
  165|            const resolvedModel =
  166|              getFirstString(donePayload?.message, ['model']) || getFirstString(donePayload, ['model']);
  167|            if (resolvedModel) finalAssistantModel = resolvedModel;
  168|            const srcFb = extractChatSources(donePayload);
  169|            if (srcFb?.length) finalSources = srcFb;
  170|          }
  171|
  172|          if (!donePayload && attemptHadChunk) {
  173|            donePayload = {
  174|              session_id: streamSessionId || undefined,
  175|              cached: streamMeta.cached,
  176|              guarded: streamMeta.guarded,
  177|            };
  178|          }
  179|          lastError = undefined;
  180|          break;
  181|        } catch (error: any) {
  182|          if (error.name === 'AbortError') return;
  183|          lastError = error;
  184|          if (attempt === 0 && !attemptHadChunk) {
  185|            toast.info(t('notificationCenter.chat.retrying'));
  186|            await sleep(700);
  187|            continue;
  188|          }
  189|          throw error;
  190|        }
  191|      }
  192|
  193|      if (abortControllerRef.current?.signal.aborted) return;
  194|
  195|      if (!donePayload && lastError) throw lastError;
  196|      if (!donePayload && !hadAnyStreamChunk) throw new Error(t('notificationCenter.chat.sendError'));
  197|
  198|      if (streamSessionId) setSessionId(streamSessionId);
  199|      setMessages((prev) =>
  200|        prev.map((item) =>
  201|          item.id === optimisticAssistantId
  202|            ? {
  203|                ...item,
  204|                content: finalAssistantText || item.content,
  205|                model: finalAssistantModel || item.model,
  206|                cached: streamMeta.cached ?? item.cached,
  207|                guarded: streamMeta.guarded ?? item.guarded,
  208|                isPending: false,
  209|                isError: false,
  210|                sources: finalSources ?? item.sources,
  211|              }
  212|            : item
  213|        )
  214|      );
  215|      
  216|      onSuccess?.();
  217|    } catch (error) {
  218|      if ((error as any).name === 'AbortError') return;
  219|      
  220|      const status = getErrorStatus(error);
  221|      setMessages((prev) =>
  222|        prev.map((item) =>
  223|          item.id === optimisticAssistantId
  224|            ? {
  225|                ...item,
  226|                isPending: false,
  227|                isError: true,
  228|                content:
  229|                  item.content === t('notificationCenter.chat.waitingResponse')
  230|                    ? t('notificationCenter.chat.sendError')
  231|                    : item.content,
  232|              }
  233|            : item
  234|        )
  235|      );
  236|      
  237|      if (status === 429) toast.error(t('notificationCenter.chat.rateLimited'));
  238|      else toast.error(getErrorMessage(error) || t('notificationCenter.chat.sendError'));
  239|      
  240|      onError?.(error);
  241|    } finally {
  242|      setSending(false);
  243|      abortControllerRef.current = null;
  244|    }
  245|  }, [sessionId, model, task, contextJson, t, toast, sending, onSuccess, onError]);
  246|
  247|  const clearMessages = useCallback(() => {
  248|    setMessages([]);
  249|    setSessionId('');
  250|    if (abortControllerRef.current) {
  251|      abortControllerRef.current.abort();
  252|      abortControllerRef.current = null;
  253|    }
  254|  }, []);
  255|
  256|  return {
  257|    messages,
  258|    setMessages,
  259|    sending,
  260|    sendMessage,
  261|    sessionId,
  262|    setSessionId,
  263|    clearMessages,
  264|  };
  265|}
  266|

===== FILE: src/hooks/useCostValidation.ts =====
    1|import { useMemo } from 'react';
    2|import type { CostCategory } from '@/types/domain/cost';
    3|
    4|export interface CostValidationState {
    5|  exceedsThreshold: boolean;
    6|  threshold: number | null;
    7|  requiresReceipt: boolean;
    8|  receiptMissing: boolean;
    9|  willRequireApproval: boolean;
   10|}
   11|
   12|function isTruthyReceiptFlag(v: number | boolean | undefined): boolean {
   13|  return v === true || v === 1;
   14|}
   15|
   16|/**
   17| * R06: so sánh amount với approval_threshold; requires_receipt bắt buộc chứng từ.
   18| */
   19|export function useCostValidation(
   20|  category: CostCategory | null | undefined,
   21|  amount: number | null | undefined,
   22|  hasReceipt: boolean,
   23|): CostValidationState {
   24|  return useMemo(() => {
   25|    const threshold = category?.approval_threshold ?? null;
   26|    const amt = amount != null && Number.isFinite(amount) ? amount : null;
   27|    const exceedsThreshold = threshold != null && amt != null && amt > threshold;
   28|    const requiresReceipt = isTruthyReceiptFlag(category?.requires_receipt);
   29|    const receiptMissing = requiresReceipt && !hasReceipt;
   30|    const willRequireApproval = exceedsThreshold;
   31|
   32|    return {
   33|      exceedsThreshold,
   34|      threshold,
   35|      requiresReceipt,
   36|      receiptMissing,
   37|      willRequireApproval,
   38|    };
   39|  }, [category, amount, hasReceipt]);
   40|}
   41|
   42|export function validateCostBeforeSubmit(state: CostValidationState): string | null {
   43|  if (state.receiptMissing) {
   44|    return 'costManagement.receiptRequired';
   45|  }
   46|  return null;
   47|}

===== FILE: src/hooks/useCreate.ts =====
    1|import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
    2|import type { BaseRecord, CreateParams } from '@refinedev/core'
    3|import { dataProvider } from '@/providers/dataProvider'
    4|import { createResourceQueryKeys } from '../shared/query/createResourceQueryKeys'
    5|import { showSuccess } from './_shared'
    6|
    7|type UseCreateParams = {
    8|  resource: string
    9|  successMessage?: string
   10|  onSuccess?: (data: unknown) => void | Promise<void>
   11|  onError?: (error: unknown) => void | Promise<void>
   12|}
   13|
   14|export function useCreate<TData extends BaseRecord = BaseRecord, TVariables = Record<string, never>>({
   15|  resource,
   16|  successMessage = 'Created successfully',
   17|  onSuccess,
   18|  onError,
   19|}: UseCreateParams) {
   20|  const queryClient = useQueryClient()
   21|  const keys = createResourceQueryKeys(resource)
   22|
   23|  return useMutation({
   24|    mutationFn: (variables: TVariables) => {
   25|      const params: CreateParams<TVariables> = { resource, variables }
   26|      return dataProvider.create<TData, TVariables>(params)
   27|    },
   28|    onSuccess: async (result) => {
   29|      await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: keys.all })
   30|      if (successMessage) showSuccess(successMessage)
   31|      await onSuccess?.(result)
   32|    },
   33|    onError: async (error) => {
   34|      await onError?.(error)
   35|    },
   36|  })
   37|}

===== FILE: src/hooks/useDashboardRevenueByOffice.ts =====
    1|import { useMemo } from 'react';
    2|import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    3|import api from '@/services/api';
    4|import type { Office, Trip } from '@/types';
    5|import { getErrorMessage } from '@/utils/errorHandler';
    6|
    7|export interface OfficeRevenueRow {
    8|  key: string;
    9|  officeId: number | '__UNASSIGNED__';
   10|  officeName: string;
   11|  completedTrips: number;
   12|  revenue: number;
   13|}
   14|
   15|export function useDashboardRevenueByOffice(options: {
   16|  offices: Office[];
   17|  companyId?: number;
   18|  officeId?: number;
   19|  month: number;
   20|  year: number;
   21|}) {
   22|  const { offices, companyId, officeId, month, year } = options;
   23|
   24|  const query = useQuery({
   25|    queryKey: ['dashboard-trips', { companyId, officeId, month, year, status: 'completed' }],
   26|    queryFn: async ({ signal }) => {
   27|      const res = await api.get('/trips', {
   28|        signal,
   29|        params: {
   30|          status: 'completed',
   31|          month,
   32|          year,
   33|          ...(companyId != null ? { company_id: companyId } : {}),
   34|          ...(officeId != null ? { office_id: officeId } : {}),
   35|          per_page: 1000,
   36|        },
   37|      });
   38|      return (res.data?.data?.data ?? []) as Trip[];
   39|    },
   40|    // Cache for 5 minutes as suggested in the report
   41|    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
   42|  });
   43|
   44|  const rows = useMemo(() => {
   45|    const trips = query.data ?? [];
   46|    const officeMap = new Map<number | '__UNASSIGNED__', OfficeRevenueRow>();
   47|
   48|    // Initialize with known offices if we have a company filter
   49|    if (companyId != null) {
   50|      offices
   51|        .filter((o) => o.company_id === companyId)
   52|        .forEach((o) => {
   53|          officeMap.set(o.id, {
   54|            key: String(o.id),
   55|            officeId: o.id,
   56|            officeName: o.name,
   57|            completedTrips: 0,
   58|            revenue: 0,
   59|          });
   60|        });
   61|    }
   62|
   63|    for (const trip of trips) {
   64|      const oid = trip.office_id || '__UNASSIGNED__';
   65|      const existing = officeMap.get(oid);
   66|      const price = typeof trip.price === 'number' ? trip.price : Number(trip.price) || 0;
   67|
   68|      if (existing) {
   69|        existing.completedTrips += 1;
   70|        existing.revenue += price;
   71|      } else {
   72|        officeMap.set(oid, {
   73|          key: String(oid),
   74|          officeId: oid,
   75|          officeName: oid === '__UNASSIGNED__' ? 'Unassigned' : `Office #${oid}`,
   76|          completedTrips: 1,
   77|          revenue: price,
   78|        });
   79|      }
   80|    }
   81|
   82|    // Sort by revenue descending
   83|    return Array.from(officeMap.values())
   84|      .filter((r) => r.completedTrips > 0 || r.officeId !== '__UNASSIGNED__')
   85|      .sort((a, b) => b.revenue - a.revenue);
   86|  }, [query.data, companyId, offices]);
   87|
   88|  return {
   89|    rows,
   90|    loading: query.isLoading || query.isFetching,
   91|    error: query.error ? getErrorMessage(query.error) : null,
   92|    refetch: query.refetch,
   93|  };
   94|}
   95|
   96|

===== FILE: src/hooks/useDashboardStats.ts =====
    1|import { useMemo } from 'react';
    2|import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    3|import dashboardService from '@/services/dashboard.service';
    4|import type { DashboardStats } from '@/types';
    5|import { getErrorMessage } from '@/utils/errorHandler';
    6|import { translations, type Locale } from '@/locales';
    7|import { useAppStore } from '@/stores/app.store';
    8|
    9|function statsLoadFailedMessage(locale: Locale): string {
   10|  const candidate = (translations[locale] as Record<string, unknown>)?.dashboard as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   11|  const message = candidate?.statsLoadFailed;
   12|  return typeof message === 'string' && message.trim() ? message : 'Failed to load dashboard stats';
   13|}
   14|
   15|interface UseDashboardStatsReturn {
   16|  stats: DashboardStats | undefined;
   17|  statsLoading: boolean;
   18|  statsError: string | null;
   19|  refetchStats: () => Promise<void>;
   20|}
   21|
   22|export const useDashboardStats = (options?: {
   23|  enablePolling?: boolean;
   24|  pollingInterval?: number;
   25|  companyId?: number;
   26|}): UseDashboardStatsReturn => {
   27|  const { enablePolling = true, pollingInterval = 60000, companyId } = options || {};
   28|  const query = useQuery({
   29|    queryKey: ['dashboard-stats', companyId ?? null],
   30|    queryFn: async () => {
   31|      const locale = useAppStore.getState().locale;
   32|      const fallback = statsLoadFailedMessage(locale);
   33|      const response = await dashboardService.getStats(undefined, undefined, companyId);
   34|      if (response.success && response.data) {
   35|        return response.data;
   36|      }
   37|      throw new Error(response.message || fallback);
   38|    },
   39|    refetchInterval: enablePolling ? pollingInterval : false,
   40|  });
   41|
   42|  const statsError = useMemo(() => {
   43|    if (!query.error) return null;
   44|    const locale = useAppStore.getState().locale;
   45|    const fallback = statsLoadFailedMessage(locale);
   46|    return getErrorMessage(query.error) || fallback;
   47|  }, [query.error]);
   48|
   49|  return {
   50|    stats: query.data as DashboardStats | undefined,
   51|    statsLoading: query.isLoading || query.isFetching,
   52|    statsError,
   53|    refetchStats: async () => {
   54|      await query.refetch();
   55|    },
   56|  };
   57|};

===== FILE: src/hooks/useDashboardTodayKpis.ts =====
    1|import { useMemo } from 'react';
    2|import { useList } from '@refinedev/core';
    3|import dayjs from 'dayjs';
    4|import type { Trip } from '@/types';
    5|import { normalizeTripStatusKey } from '@/utils/tripStatus';
    6|
    7|const RUNNING_KEYS = new Set([
    8|  'assigned',
    9|  'en_route_pickup',
   10|  'picked_up',
   11|  'in_transit',
   12|  'delayed',
   13|]);
   14|
   15|function tripRevenueAmount(row: Trip): number {
   16|  const raw = row.total_revenue ?? row.price;
   17|  const n = typeof raw === 'number' ? raw : Number(raw);
   18|  return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 0;
   19|}
   20|
   21|function isCreatedToday(row: Trip, todayKey: string): boolean {
   22|  const createdAt = row.created_at;
   23|  if (!createdAt) return false;
   24|  return dayjs(createdAt).format('YYYY-MM-DD') === todayKey;
   25|}
   26|
   27|export function useDashboardTodayKpis(companyId?: number) {
   28|  const today = dayjs().format('YYYY-MM-DD');
   29|
   30|  const { data, isLoading, isError, refetch } = useList<Trip>({
   31|    resource: 'trips',
   32|    pagination: { current: 1, pageSize: 500 },
   33|    filters: [
   34|      { field: 'scheduled_date', operator: 'eq', value: today },
   35|      ...(companyId != null ? [{ field: 'company_id', operator: 'eq' as const, value: companyId }] : []),
   36|    ],
   37|  });
   38|
   39|  const { data: createdTodayData } = useList<Trip>({
   40|    resource: 'trips',
   41|    pagination: { current: 1, pageSize: 500 },
   42|    filters: [
   43|      { field: 'date_from', operator: 'eq', value: today },
   44|      { field: 'date_to', operator: 'eq', value: today },
   45|      ...(companyId != null ? [{ field: 'company_id', operator: 'eq' as const, value: companyId }] : []),
   46|    ],
   47|  });
   48|
   49|  const rows = data?.data ?? [];
   50|  const createdRows = createdTodayData?.data ?? [];
   51|
   52|  const kpis = useMemo(() => {
   53|    let runningCount = 0;
   54|    let completedCount = 0;
   55|    let revenueToday = 0;
   56|
   57|    for (const row of rows) {
   58|      const key = normalizeTripStatusKey(row.status);
   59|      if (key === 'completed') {
   60|        completedCount += 1;
   61|        revenueToday += tripRevenueAmount(row);
   62|      } else if (key && RUNNING_KEYS.has(key)) {
   63|        runningCount += 1;
   64|      }
   65|    }
   66|
   67|    const newCount = createdRows.filter((row) => isCreatedToday(row, today)).length || rows.filter((r) => normalizeTripStatusKey(r.status) === 'pending').length;
   68|
   69|    return { newCount, runningCount, completedCount, revenueToday, sampleSize: rows.length };
   70|  }, [rows, createdRows, today]);
   71|
   72|  return {
   73|    today,
   74|    loading: isLoading,
   75|    isError,
   76|    refetch,
   77|    ...kpis,
   78|  };
   79|}
   80|

===== FILE: src/hooks/useDateTime.ts =====
    1|import { useCallback } from 'react'
    2|import dayjs from 'dayjs'
    3|
    4|type UseDateTimeOptions = {
    5|  dateFormat?: string
    6|  dateTimeFormat?: string
    7|}
    8|
    9|export function useDateTime(options: UseDateTimeOptions = {}) {
   10|  const dateFormat = options.dateFormat ?? 'DD/MM/YYYY'
   11|  const dateTimeFormat = options.dateTimeFormat ?? 'DD/MM/YYYY HH:mm'
   12|
   13|  const parse = useCallback((value: dayjs.ConfigType) => dayjs(value), [])
   14|
   15|  const formatDate = useCallback(
   16|    (value: dayjs.ConfigType) => {
   17|      const parsed = parse(value)
   18|      return parsed.isValid() ? parsed.format(dateFormat) : '—'
   19|    },
   20|    [dateFormat, parse],
   21|  )
   22|
   23|  const formatDateTime = useCallback(
   24|    (value: dayjs.ConfigType) => {
   25|      const parsed = parse(value)
   26|      return parsed.isValid() ? parsed.format(dateTimeFormat) : '—'
   27|    },
   28|    [dateTimeFormat, parse],
   29|  )
   30|
   31|  const diff = useCallback((from: dayjs.ConfigType, to: dayjs.ConfigType, unit: string = 'day') => {
   32|    const start = parse(from)
   33|    const end = parse(to)
   34|    if (!start.isValid() || !end.isValid()) return 0
   35|    return end.diff(start, unit as never)
   36|  }, [parse])
   37|
   38|  const isBefore = useCallback((value: dayjs.ConfigType, other: dayjs.ConfigType) => {
   39|    const current = parse(value)
   40|    const compare = parse(other)
   41|    return current.isValid() && compare.isValid() ? current.isBefore(compare) : false
   42|  }, [parse])
   43|
   44|  const isAfter = useCallback((value: dayjs.ConfigType, other: dayjs.ConfigType) => {
   45|    const current = parse(value)
   46|    const compare = parse(other)
   47|    return current.isValid() && compare.isValid() ? current.isAfter(compare) : false
   48|  }, [parse])
   49|
   50|  return {
   51|    parse,
   52|    formatDate,
   53|    formatDateTime,
   54|    diff,
   55|    isBefore,
   56|    isAfter,
   57|    dayjs,
   58|  }

===== FILE: src/hooks/useDebounce.ts =====
    1|import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
    2|
    3|export function useDebounce<T>(value: T, delay = 300) {
    4|  const [debouncedValue, setDebouncedValue] = useState(value)
    5|
    6|  useEffect(() => {
    7|    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
    8|      setDebouncedValue(value)
    9|    }, delay)
   10|
   11|    return () => {
   12|      window.clearTimeout(timer)
   13|    }
   14|  }, [delay, value])
   15|
   16|  return debouncedValue
   17|}

===== FILE: src/hooks/useDriverDayMap.ts =====
    1|import { useMemo } from 'react';
    2|import dayjs from 'dayjs';
    3|import type { AbsenceRecord, DayKind, DriverSchedule, LeaveRequest, PublicHoliday } from '@/types';
    4|
    5|/** Lấy YYYY-MM-DD từ chuỗi API; ưu tiên phần ngày đầu chuỗi để tránh lệch ngày khi có Zulu ISO. */
    6|function calendarDateKey(value: string | null | undefined): string {
    7|  if (value == null || value === '') return '';
    8|  const s = String(value).trim();
    9|  const m = /^(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})/.exec(s);
   10|  if (m) return m[1];
   11|  return dayjs(s).format('YYYY-MM-DD');
   12|}
   13|
   14|export interface DayInfo {
   15|  kind: DayKind;
   16|  schedule?: DriverSchedule;
   17|  leave?: LeaveRequest;
   18|  absence?: AbsenceRecord;
   19|  holiday?: PublicHoliday;
   20|}
   21|
   22|interface Params {
   23|  schedules: DriverSchedule[];
   24|  leaveRequests: LeaveRequest[];
   25|  absences: AbsenceRecord[];
   26|  publicHolidays: PublicHoliday[];
   27|}
   28|
   29|export function useDriverDayMap({ schedules, leaveRequests, absences, publicHolidays }: Params) {
   30|  return useMemo(() => {
   31|    const map = new Map<string, DayInfo>();
   32|
   33|    publicHolidays.forEach((holiday) => {
   34|      const key = calendarDateKey(holiday.date);
   35|      if (key) map.set(key, { kind: 'holiday', holiday });
   36|    });
   37|
   38|    leaveRequests
   39|      .filter((leaveRequest) => leaveRequest.status === 'approved')
   40|      .forEach((leaveRequest) => {
   41|        let cursor = dayjs(calendarDateKey(leaveRequest.from_date));
   42|        const end = dayjs(calendarDateKey(leaveRequest.to_date));
   43|        if (!cursor.isValid() || !end.isValid()) return;
   44|        while (!cursor.isAfter(end)) {
   45|          const key = cursor.format('YYYY-MM-DD');
   46|          if (!map.has(key)) {
   47|            map.set(key, { kind: 'leave', leave: leaveRequest });
   48|          }
   49|          cursor = cursor.add(1, 'day');
   50|        }
   51|      });
   52|
   53|    absences.forEach((absence) => {
   54|      const key = calendarDateKey(absence.date);
   55|      if (key && !map.has(key)) {
   56|        map.set(key, { kind: 'noleave', absence });
   57|      }
   58|    });
   59|
   60|    schedules.forEach((schedule) => {
   61|      const key = calendarDateKey(schedule.work_date);
   62|      if (!key) return;
   63|      map.set(key, { kind: 'working', schedule });
   64|    });
   65|
   66|    return map;
   67|  }, [schedules, leaveRequests, absences, publicHolidays]);
   68|}
   69|

===== FILE: src/hooks/useExport.ts =====
    1|import { useCallback, useState } from 'react'
    2|import api from '@/services/api'
    3|
    4|type UseExportParams = {
    5|  url: string
    6|  params?: Record<string, unknown>
    7|  filename?: string
    8|  method?: 'GET'
    9|  useApiRoot?: boolean
   10|  autoDownload?: boolean
   11|}
   12|
   13|const filenameFromContentDisposition = (contentDisposition?: string) => {
   14|  if (!contentDisposition) return null
   15|
   16|  const utf8Match = contentDisposition.match(/filename\*=UTF-8''([^;]+)/i)
   17|  if (utf8Match?.[1]) {
   18|    return decodeURIComponent(utf8Match[1])
   19|  }
   20|
   21|  const asciiMatch = contentDisposition.match(/filename=([^;]+)/i)
   22|  if (asciiMatch?.[1]) {
   23|    return asciiMatch[1].replace(/["']/g, '').trim()
   24|  }
   25|
   26|  return null
   27|}
   28|
   29|const triggerDownload = (blob: Blob, filename: string) => {
   30|  const objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob)
   31|  const anchor = document.createElement('a')
   32|  anchor.href = objectUrl
   33|  anchor.download = filename
   34|  document.body.appendChild(anchor)
   35|  anchor.click()
   36|  anchor.remove()
   37|  URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl)
   38|}
   39|
   40|export function useExport({
   41|  url,
   42|  params,
   43|  filename,
   44|  method = 'GET',
   45|  useApiRoot,
   46|  autoDownload = true,
   47|}: UseExportParams) {
   48|  const [isExporting, setIsExporting] = useState(false)
   49|
   50|  const exportFile = useCallback(async () => {
   51|    setIsExporting(true)
   52|    try {
   53|      const response = await api.request<Blob>({
   54|        url,
   55|        method,
   56|        params,
   57|        responseType: 'blob',
   58|        useApiRoot,
   59|      })
   60|
   61|      const blob = response.data
   62|      const nextFilename =
   63|        filename ??
   64|        filenameFromContentDisposition(response.headers?.['content-disposition']) ??
   65|        'export.bin'
   66|
   67|      if (autoDownload) {
   68|        triggerDownload(blob, nextFilename)
   69|      }
   70|
   71|      return { blob, filename: nextFilename }
   72|    } finally {
   73|      setIsExporting(false)
   74|    }
   75|  }, [autoDownload, filename, method, params, useApiRoot, url])
   76|
   77|  return {
   78|    exportFile,
   79|    isExporting,
   80|  }
   81|}

    1|import { useCallback, useMemo, useState } from 'react'
    2|import type { FormInstance } from 'antd'

    4|type FormValues<T extends object> = Parameters<FormInstance<T>['setFieldsValue']>[0]
    5|
    6|type UseFormModalOptions<T extends object> = {
    7|  form?: FormInstance<T>
    8|  initialValues?: FormValues<T>

   10|
   11|export function useFormModal<T extends object>({ form, initialValues }: UseFormModalOptions<T> = {}) {
   12|  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
   13|  const [record, setRecord] = useState<T | null>(null)
   14|
   15|  const isEditMode = record !== null
   16|
   17|  const applyInitialValues = useCallback(() => {
   18|    if (!form) return
   19|    form.setFieldsValue((initialValues ?? {}) as FormValues<T>)
   20|  }, [form, initialValues])
   21|
   22|  const openCreate = useCallback(() => {
   23|    setRecord(null)
   24|    setOpen(true)
   25|    form?.resetFields()
   26|    applyInitialValues()
   27|  }, [applyInitialValues, form])
   28|
   29|  const openEdit = useCallback(
   30|    (nextRecord: T) => {
   31|      setRecord(nextRecord)
   32|      setOpen(true)
   33|      form?.setFieldsValue(nextRecord)
   34|    },
   35|    [form],
   36|  )
   37|
   38|  const close = useCallback(() => {
   39|    setOpen(false)
   40|    setRecord(null)
   41|    form?.resetFields()
   42|  }, [form])
   43|
   44|  const setFormValues = useCallback(
   45|    (values: FormValues<T>) => {
   46|      form?.setFieldsValue(values)
   47|    },
   48|    [form],
   49|  )
   50|
   51|  return useMemo(
   52|    () => ({
   53|      open,
   54|      setOpen,
   55|      record,
   56|      isEditMode,
   57|      mode: isEditMode ? ('edit' as const) : ('create' as const),
   58|      openCreate,
   59|      openEdit,
   60|      close,
   61|      setFormValues,
   62|      resetForm: close,
   63|    }),

   65|  )

===== FILE: src/hooks/useGuardedAsync.ts =====
    1|import { useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
    2|
    3|type GuardOptions = {
    4|  cooldownMs?: number;
    5|  force?: boolean;
    6|};
    7|
    8|type GuardState = {
    9|  inFlight: boolean;
   10|  lastAt: number;
   11|};
   12|
   13|export function useGuardedAsync(defaultCooldownMs = 1000) {
   14|  const stateRef = useRef<Record<string, GuardState>>({});
   15|
   16|  const run = useCallback(
   17|    async <T>(key: string, task: () => Promise<T>, options?: GuardOptions): Promise<T | undefined> => {
   18|      const cooldownMs = options?.cooldownMs ?? defaultCooldownMs;
   19|      const force = options?.force ?? false;
   20|      const guard = stateRef.current[key] ?? { inFlight: false, lastAt: 0 };
   21|      const now = Date.now();
   22|
   23|      if (!force) {
   24|        if (guard.inFlight) return undefined;
   25|        if (now - guard.lastAt < cooldownMs) return undefined;
   26|      }
   27|
   28|      stateRef.current[key] = { ...guard, inFlight: true };
   29|      try {
   30|        const result = await task();
   31|        return result;
   32|      } finally {
   33|        stateRef.current[key] = { inFlight: false, lastAt: Date.now() };
   34|      }
   35|    },
   36|    [defaultCooldownMs]
   37|  );
   38|
   39|  return { run };
   40|}
   41|

   32|    (file: File) => {
   33|      if (!isAcceptedImageFile(file, acceptedMimeTypes, acceptedExtensions)) {
   34|        return { valid: false, reason: 'Invalid image format' }
   35|      }
   36|
   37|      const sizeInMB = file.size / (1024 * 1024)
   38|      if (sizeInMB > maxSizeMB) {
   39|        return { valid: false, reason: `Image must be smaller than ${maxSizeMB}MB` }
   40|      }
   41|
   42|      return { valid: true as const }
   43|    },
   44|    [acceptedExtensions, acceptedMimeTypes, maxSizeMB],
   45|  )
   46|
   47|  const beforeUpload = useCallback(
   48|    (file: File) => {
   49|      const result = validateFile(file)
   50|      return result.valid ? true : imageUploadListIgnore()
   51|    },
   52|    [validateFile],
   53|  )
   54|
   55|  const createPreviewUrl = useCallback((file: File | UploadFile) => {
   56|    const rawFile = file instanceof File ? file : (file.originFileObj ?? null)
   57|    if (!rawFile) return null
   58|
   59|    const nextPreviewUrl = URL.createObjectURL(rawFile)
   60|    setPreviewUrl((current) => {
   61|      if (current) URL.revokeObjectURL(current)
   62|      return nextPreviewUrl
   63|    })
   64|    return nextPreviewUrl
   65|  }, [])
   66|
   67|  const clearPreview = useCallback(() => {
   68|    setPreviewUrl((current) => {
   69|      if (current) URL.revokeObjectURL(current)
   70|      return null
   71|    })
   72|  }, [])
   73|
   74|  return {
   75|    previewUrl,
   76|    validateFile,
   77|    beforeUpload,
   78|    createPreviewUrl,
   79|    clearPreview,
   80|  }
   81|}

===== FILE: src/hooks/useListFilters.ts =====
    1|import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';
    2|
    3|type FilterShape = Record<string, unknown>;
    4|
    5|interface UseListFiltersReturn<T extends FilterShape> {
    6|  /** Draft values — what the user is currently editing in the filter bar */
    7|  inputs: T;
    8|  /** Committed values — what the query actually uses */
    9|  applied: T;
   10|  /** Update a single input field without committing to the query */
   11|  setInput: <K extends keyof T>(key: K, value: T[K]) => void;
   12|  /** Commit current inputs → applied, triggering a refetch */
   13|  apply: () => void;
   14|  /** Reset both inputs and applied back to initial values */
   15|  clear: () => void;
   16|}
   17|
   18|/**
   19| * Manages the two-phase filter state used by every List Page:
   20| * draft inputs (what user edits) and applied filters (what the query uses).
   21| *
   22| * Eliminates the repeated [inputValue, appliedValue] useState pairs
   23| * and the copy-paste apply/clear handlers across list pages.
   24| *
   25| * @example
   26| * const { inputs, applied, setInput, apply, clear } = useListFilters({
   27| *   plate: '',
   28| *   status: undefined as string | undefined,
   29| *   type: undefined as string | undefined,
   30| * });
   31| */
   32|export function useListFilters<T extends FilterShape>(initialValues: T): UseListFiltersReturn<T> {
   33|  // Freeze initial values on first render so clear() stays stable
   34|  const initialRef = useRef<T>(initialValues);
   35|
   36|  const [inputs, setInputs] = useState<T>(() => ({ ...initialRef.current }));
   37|  const [applied, setApplied] = useState<T>(() => ({ ...initialRef.current }));
   38|
   39|  const setInput = useCallback(<K extends keyof T>(key: K, value: T[K]) => {
   40|    setInputs((prev) => ({ ...prev, [key]: value }));
   41|  }, []);
   42|
   43|  // Read current inputs inside the setState callback to avoid stale closure.
   44|  // apply() is stable — safe to put in dependency arrays.
   45|  const apply = useCallback(() => {
   46|    setInputs((current) => {
   47|      setApplied({ ...current });
   48|      return current;
   49|    });
   50|  }, []);
   51|
   52|  const clear = useCallback(() => {
   53|    const initial = { ...initialRef.current };
   54|    setInputs(initial);
   55|    setApplied(initial);
   56|  }, []);
   57|
   58|  return { inputs, applied, setInput, apply, clear };
   59|}
   60|

===== FILE: src/hooks/usePaginatedResourceSelectOptions.ts =====
    1|import { useCallback, useMemo, type UIEvent } from 'react';
    2|import { useInfiniteQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    3|import type { BaseRecord, CrudFilter, CrudSort } from '@refinedev/core';
    4|
    5|import type { SelectOption } from '@/components/form';
    6|import { dataProvider } from '@/providers/dataProvider';
    7|import { createResourceQueryKeys } from '../shared/query/createResourceQueryKeys'
    8|
    9|const PAGE_SIZE = 10;
   10|
   11|type UsePaginatedResourceSelectOptionsParams<T extends BaseRecord> = {
   12|  resource: string;
   13|  filters?: CrudFilter[];
   14|  sorters?: CrudSort[];
   15|  mapOption: (row: T) => SelectOption;
   16|  enabled?: boolean;
   17|};
   18|
   19|/**
   20| * Options for Ant `Select` / {@link FormItemSelect} with infinite scroll in the dropdown (10 rows per API page).
   21| */
   22|export function usePaginatedResourceSelectOptions<T extends BaseRecord>({
   23|  resource,
   24|  filters = [],
   25|  sorters = [],
   26|  mapOption,
   27|  enabled = true,
   28|}: UsePaginatedResourceSelectOptionsParams<T>) {
   29|  const keys = createResourceQueryKeys(resource);
   30|
   31|  const infinite = useInfiniteQuery({
   32|    queryKey: [...keys.lists(), 'select-infinite', PAGE_SIZE, resource, filters, sorters] as const,
   33|    initialPageParam: 1,
   34|    enabled,
   35|    queryFn: async ({ pageParam }) => {
   36|      const res = await dataProvider.getList<T>({
   37|        resource,
   38|        pagination: { current: pageParam as number, pageSize: PAGE_SIZE },
   39|        filters,
   40|        sorters,
   41|      });
   42|      return { rows: res.data ?? [], total: res.total ?? 0 };
   43|    },
   44|    getNextPageParam: (lastPage, allPages) => {
   45|      const loaded = allPages.reduce((acc, p) => acc + p.rows.length, 0);
   46|      if (loaded >= lastPage.total) return undefined;
   47|      return allPages.length + 1;
   48|    },
   49|  });
   50|
   51|  const options = useMemo(
   52|    () => infinite.data?.pages.flatMap((p) => p.rows.map((row) => mapOption(row))) ?? [],
   53|    [infinite.data, mapOption],
   54|  );
   55|
   56|  const onPopupScroll = useCallback(
   57|    (e: UIEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
   58|      const { target } = e;
   59|      if (!(target instanceof HTMLElement)) return;
   60|      const { scrollTop, scrollHeight, clientHeight } = target;
   61|      if (scrollHeight - scrollTop <= clientHeight + 32) {
   62|        if (infinite.hasNextPage && !infinite.isFetchingNextPage) {
   63|          void infinite.fetchNextPage();
   64|        }
   65|      }
   66|    },
   67|    [infinite],
   68|  );
   69|
   70|  return {
   71|    options,
   72|    isLoading: infinite.isLoading,
   73|    isFetchingNextPage: infinite.isFetchingNextPage,
   74|    onPopupScroll,
   75|    hasNextPage: infinite.hasNextPage,
   76|  };
   77|}

    1|import { useMemo } from 'react';
    2|import { useAuth } from './useAuth';
    3|
    4|type PermissionInput = string | string[];
    5|
    6|function toArray(value?: PermissionInput): string[] {
    7|  if (!value) return [];
    8|  return Array.isArray(value) ? value : [value];
    9|}
   10|
   11|export function usePermission() {
   12|  const { hasPermission, hasRole, isAuthenticated } = useAuth();
   13|
   14|  return useMemo(
   15|    () => ({
   16|      can: (permission: string) => isAuthenticated && hasPermission(permission),
   17|      cannot: (permission: string) => !isAuthenticated || !hasPermission(permission),
   18|      canAny: (permissions: PermissionInput) => toArray(permissions).some((p) => hasPermission(p)),
   19|      canAll: (permissions: PermissionInput) => toArray(permissions).every((p) => hasPermission(p)),
   20|      hasRole,
   21|    }),
   22|    [hasPermission, hasRole, isAuthenticated],
   23|  );

===== FILE: src/hooks/useRequest.ts =====
    1|import { useQuery, type QueryKey, type UseQueryOptions, type UseQueryResult } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    2|import { isAxiosError } from 'axios';
    3|import api from '@/services/api';
    4|import type { ApiResponse } from '@/types';
    5|
    6|// Track consecutive 401 occurrences globally to trigger forced logout after N failures.
    7|const AUTH_401_COUNTER_KEY = '__app_auth_401_count';
    8|
    9|interface CustomWindow extends Window {
   10|  [AUTH_401_COUNTER_KEY]?: number;
   11|}
   12|
   13|const increment401Count = (): number => {
   14|  const w = window as unknown as CustomWindow;
   15|  w[AUTH_401_COUNTER_KEY] = (w[AUTH_401_COUNTER_KEY] || 0) + 1;
   16|  return w[AUTH_401_COUNTER_KEY];
   17|};
   18|const reset401Count = (): void => {
   19|  (window as unknown as CustomWindow)[AUTH_401_COUNTER_KEY] = 0;
   20|};
   21|
   22|type UseRequestConfig<TData> = {
   23|  queryKey: QueryKey;
   24|  url: string;
   25|  params?: Record<string, unknown>;
   26|  enabled?: boolean;
   27|  staleTime?: number;
   28|  gcTime?: number;
   29|  refetchInterval?: number | false;
   30|  useApiRoot?: boolean;
   31|  skipErrorToast?: boolean;
   32|  errorMode?: 'global' | 'local' | 'silent';
   33|  select?: (data: TData | undefined) => TData;
   34|};
   35|
   36|export function useRequest<TData>(config: UseRequestConfig<TData>): UseQueryResult<TData | undefined, Error> {
   37|  const {
   38|    queryKey,
   39|    url,
   40|    params,
   41|    enabled = true,
   42|    staleTime,
   43|    gcTime,
   44|    refetchInterval,
   45|    useApiRoot,
   46|    skipErrorToast,
   47|    errorMode,
   48|    select,
   49|  } = config;
   50|
   51|  return useQuery<TData | undefined, Error>({
   52|    queryKey,
   53|    enabled,
   54|    staleTime,
   55|    gcTime,
   56|    refetchInterval,
   57|    // Retry at most 3 times with react-query default backoff
   58|    retry: (failureCount: number, error: unknown) => {
   59|      const respStatus = isAxiosError(error) ? error.response?.status : undefined;
   60|      if (respStatus === 401) {
   61|        const count = increment401Count();
   62|        // If we've seen 3 or more 401s globally, trigger force-logout event (session expired)
   63|        if (count >= 3) {
   64|          window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('auth:force-logout'));
   65|        }
   66|      }
   67|      return failureCount < 3;
   68|    },
   69|    queryFn: async () => {
   70|      const response = await api.get<ApiResponse<TData>>(url, {
   71|        params,
   72|        useApiRoot,
   73|        skipErrorToast,
   74|        errorMode,
   75|      });
   76|      const body = response.data;
   77|      if (!body.success) {
   78|        throw new Error(body.message || 'Request failed');
   79|      }
   80|      // reset 401 counter on success
   81|      reset401Count();
   82|      return body.data;
   83|    },
   84|    select,
   85|  });
   86|}
   87|
   88|type UseCustomRequestConfig<TData> = {
   89|  queryKey: QueryKey;
   90|  queryFn: () => Promise<TData>;
   91|} & Pick<UseQueryOptions<TData>, 'enabled' | 'staleTime' | 'gcTime' | 'refetchInterval' | 'retry' | 'select'>;
   92|
   93|export function useCustomRequest<TData>(config: UseCustomRequestConfig<TData>): UseQueryResult<TData, Error> {
   94|  const { queryKey, queryFn, enabled, staleTime, gcTime, refetchInterval, retry, select } = config;
   95|  return useQuery<TData, Error>({
   96|    queryKey,
   97|    queryFn,
   98|    enabled,
   99|    staleTime,
  100|    gcTime,
  101|    refetchInterval,
  102|    retry: retry ?? ((failureCount: number) => failureCount < 3),
  103|    select,
  104|  });
  105|}
  106|

    1|import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'

    3|import { dataProvider } from '@/providers/dataProvider'
    4|import { createResourceQueryKeys } from '../shared/query/createResourceQueryKeys'
    5|
    6|interface UseResourceListQueryParams {
    7|  resource: string
    8|  current: number
    9|  pageSize?: number
   10|  filters?: CrudFilter[]
   11|  sorters?: CrudSort[]
   12|  enabled?: boolean
   13|}
   14|
   15|export function useResourceListQuery<TData extends BaseRecord = BaseRecord>({
   16|  resource,
   17|  current,
   18|  pageSize = 15,
   19|  filters = [],
   20|  sorters = [],
   21|  enabled = true,
   22|}: UseResourceListQueryParams) {
   23|  const keys = createResourceQueryKeys(resource)
   24|  const listParams: GetListParams = {
   25|    resource,
   26|    pagination: { current, pageSize },
   27|    filters,
   28|    sorters,
   29|  }
   30|
   31|  return useQuery({
   32|    queryKey: keys.list({
   33|      current,
   34|      pageSize,
   35|      filters,
   36|      sorters,
   37|    }),
   38|    queryFn: () => dataProvider.getList<TData>(listParams),
   39|    enabled,
   40|  })

===== FILE: src/hooks/useSafeRefetch.ts =====
    1|import { useCallback } from 'react';
    2|import { useGuardedAsync } from '@/hooks/useGuardedAsync';
    3|
    4|type RefetchFn = () => Promise<unknown> | unknown;
    5|
    6|export function useSafeRefetch(key: string, refetch: RefetchFn, cooldownMs = 800) {
    7|  const { run } = useGuardedAsync(cooldownMs);
    8|
    9|  const safeRefetch = useCallback(
   10|    async (force = false) => {
   11|      await run(
   12|        `refetch:${key}`,
   13|        async () => {
   14|          await Promise.resolve(refetch());
   15|        },
   16|        { cooldownMs, force }
   17|      );
   18|    },
   19|    [cooldownMs, key, refetch, run]
   20|  );
   21|
   22|  return safeRefetch;
   23|}

===== FILE: src/hooks/useSelection.ts =====
    1|import { useCallback, useMemo, useState } from 'react'
    2|import type { Key } from 'react'
    3|import type { TableRowSelection } from 'antd/es/table/interface'
    4|
    5|export function useSelection<T extends object>() {
    6|  const [selectedRowKeys, setSelectedRowKeys] = useState<Key[]>([])
    7|  const [selectedRows, setSelectedRows] = useState<T[]>([])
    8|
    9|  const clearSelection = useCallback(() => {
   10|    setSelectedRowKeys([])
   11|    setSelectedRows([])
   12|  }, [])
   13|
   14|  const rowSelection = useMemo<TableRowSelection<T>>(
   15|    () => ({
   16|      selectedRowKeys,
   17|      onChange: (keys, rows) => {
   18|        setSelectedRowKeys(keys)
   19|        setSelectedRows(rows)
   20|      },
   21|    }),
   22|    [selectedRowKeys],
   23|  )
   24|
   25|  return {
   26|    selectedRowKeys,
   27|    selectedRows,
   28|    setSelectedRowKeys,
   29|    setSelectedRows,
   30|    clearSelection,
   31|    rowSelection,
   32|  }

===== FILE: src/hooks/useTopDrivers.ts =====
    1|import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
    2|import api from '@/services/api';
    3|import { getErrorMessage } from '@/utils/errorHandler';
    4|import type { Trip } from '@/types';
    5|
    6|export interface TopDriverRow {
    7|  driverId: number | string;
    8|  driverName: string;
    9|  trips: number;
   10|  revenue: number;
   11|}
   12|
   13|/**
   14| * Fetch recent completed trips for the period and aggregate top drivers.
   15| * This hook intentionally limits pages to avoid heavy load on the dashboard.
   16| */
   17|export function useTopDrivers(options: { companyId?: number; month: number; year: number; limit?: number }) {
   18|  const { companyId, month, year, limit = 6 } = options;
   19|  const [rows, setRows] = useState<TopDriverRow[]>([]);
   20|  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
   21|  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
   22|
   23|  const fetch = useCallback(async () => {
   24|    setLoading(true);
   25|    setError(null);
   26|    try {
   27|      const res = await api.get('/trips', {
   28|        params: {
   29|          status: 'completed',
   30|          month,
   31|          year,
   32|          ...(companyId != null ? { company_id: companyId } : {}),
   33|          per_page: 200,
   34|          page: 1,
   35|        },
   36|      });
   37|
   38|      const trips = (res.data?.data?.data ?? []) as Trip[];
   39|
   40|      const map = new Map<number | string, TopDriverRow>();
   41|      for (const trip of trips) {
   42|        const driverId = trip.driver_id ?? trip.driver?.id ?? '__unknown__';
   43|        const driverName = trip.driver?.name ?? `#${driverId}`;
   44|        const price = typeof trip.price === 'number' ? trip.price : Number(trip.price) || 0;
   45|        const existing = map.get(driverId) ?? { driverId, driverName, trips: 0, revenue: 0 } as TopDriverRow;
   46|        existing.trips += 1;
   47|        existing.revenue += price;
   48|        map.set(driverId, existing);
   49|      }
   50|
   51|      const out = Array.from(map.values()).sort((a, b) => b.revenue - a.revenue).slice(0, limit);
   52|      setRows(out);
   53|    } catch (e) {
   54|      setError(getErrorMessage(e));
   55|      setRows([]);
   56|    } finally {
   57|      setLoading(false);
   58|    }
   59|  }, [companyId, month, year, limit]);
   60|
   61|  useEffect(() => {
   62|    void fetch();
   63|  }, [fetch]);
   64|
   65|  return { rows, loading, error, refetch: fetch };
   66|}
   67|

===== FILE: src/hooks/useTranslation.ts =====
    1|import { useCallback } from 'react';
    2|import { useAppStore } from '@/stores/app.store';
    3|import { translations, type TranslationKeys } from '@/locales';
    4|
    5|type NestedKeyOf<ObjectType extends object> = {
    6|  [Key in keyof ObjectType & (string | number)]: ObjectType[Key] extends object
    7|    ? `${Key}` | `${Key}.${NestedKeyOf<ObjectType[Key]>}`
    8|    : `${Key}`;
    9|}[keyof ObjectType & (string | number)];
   10|
   11|export type TranslationPath = NestedKeyOf<TranslationKeys>;
   12|
   13|export type Translate = (key: string, params?: Record<string, string | number>) => string;
   14|
   15|const getNestedTranslationValue = (source: unknown, key: string): unknown => {
   16|  const keys = key.split('.');
   17|  let value: unknown = source;
   18|
   19|  for (const part of keys) {
   20|    if (value && typeof value === 'object' && part in value) {
   21|      value = (value as Record<string, unknown>)[part];
   22|    } else {
   23|      return undefined;
   24|    }
   25|  }
   26|
   27|  return value;
   28|};
   29|
   30|/**
   31| * Hook to use translations
   32| * 
   33| * @example
   34| * `​``tsx
   35| * const t = useTranslation();
   36| * 
   37| * <Button>{t('common.save')}</Button>
   38| * <Text>{t('companies.title')}</Text>
   39| * `​``
   40| * 
   41| * @example With parameters
   42| * `​``tsx
   43| * const t = useTranslation();
   44| * 
   45| * // In translation: "Minimum {min} characters"
   46| * <Text>{t('validation.minLength', { min: 5 })}</Text>
   47| * `​``
   48| */
   49|export const useTranslation = () => {
   50|  const locale = useAppStore((state) => state.locale);
   51|
   52|  const t = useCallback((key: string, params?: Record<string, string | number>): string => {
   53|    const translationsObj = translations[locale];
   54|    const directValue = getNestedTranslationValue(translationsObj, key);
   55|    const englishValue = getNestedTranslationValue(translations.en, key);
   56|
   57|    let value = typeof directValue === 'string'
   58|      ? directValue
   59|      : typeof englishValue === 'string'
   60|        ? englishValue
   61|        : undefined;
   62|
   63|    if (!value) {
   64|      const localeLoadError = getNestedTranslationValue(translationsObj, 'common.loadError');
   65|      const englishLoadError = getNestedTranslationValue(translations.en, 'common.loadError');
   66|      value = typeof localeLoadError === 'string'
   67|        ? localeLoadError
   68|        : typeof englishLoadError === 'string'
   69|          ? englishLoadError
   70|          : 'Unavailable';
   71|
   72|      if (import.meta.env.DEV) {
   73|        // Keep missing-key visibility for development while avoiding raw key leakage in production UI.
   74|        console.warn(`[i18n] Missing translation key: "${key}" for locale "${locale}"`);
   75|      }
   76|    }
   77|
   78|    // Replace parameters in translation string
   79|    if (params) {
   80|      return value.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (match, paramKey) => {
   81|        return params[paramKey]?.toString() || match;
   82|      });
   83|    }
   84|
   85|    return value;
   86|  }, [locale]);
   87|
   88|  return {
   89|    t,
   90|    locale,
   91|    setLocale: useAppStore((state) => state.setLocale),
   92|  };
   93|};
   94|

   31|// ─── Types ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   32|
   33|type AntMenuItem = NonNullable<MenuProps['items']>[number];
   34|
   35|// ─── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   36|
   37|function leaf(key: string, label: string, icon?: React.ReactNode): AntMenuItem {
   38|  return { key, icon, label };
   39|}
   40|
   41|/** Group item (SubMenu). Children are leaf items. */
   42|function group(
   43|  key: string,
   44|  icon: React.ReactNode,
   45|  label: string,
   46|  children: AntMenuItem[],
   47|): AntMenuItem {
   48|  return { key, icon, label, children };
   49|}
   50|
   51|function section(key: string, label: string, children: AntMenuItem[]): AntMenuItem {
   52|  return { key, type: 'group', label, children } as AntMenuItem;
   53|}
   54|
   55|
   56|/**
   57| * Walk all items (including group children) and return the key of the first
   58| * one whose key is a prefix of the current pathname, longest-match wins.
   59| */
   60|function resolveSelectedKey(pathname: string, items: AntMenuItem[]): string | undefined {
   61|  let best: { key: string; len: number } | undefined;
   62|
   63|  const walk = (list: AntMenuItem[]) => {
   64|    for (const item of list) {
   65|      if (!item || typeof item !== 'object') continue;
   66|      const i = item as unknown as Record<string, unknown>;
   67|
   68|      if (Array.isArray(i.children)) {
   69|        walk(i.children as AntMenuItem[]);
   70|      } else {
   71|        const key = typeof i.key === 'string' ? i.key : '';
   72|        if (key && (pathname === key || pathname.startsWith(`${key}/`))) {
   73|          if (!best || key.length > best.len) best = { key, len: key.length };
   74|        }
   75|      }
   76|    }
   77|  };
   78|
   79|  walk(items);
   80|  return best?.key;
   81|}
   82|
   83|/**
   84| * Return keys of all groups that contain the active leaf, so the SubMenu is
   85| * open when navigating directly to a child route.
   86| */
   87|
   88|
   89|
   90|
   91|function resolveOpenGroupKeys(activeKey: string | undefined, items: AntMenuItem[]): string[] {
   92|  if (!activeKey) return [];
   93|  const open: string[] = [];
   94|
   95|  const walk = (list: AntMenuItem[]) => {
   96|    for (const item of list) {
   97|      if (!item || typeof item !== 'object') continue;
   98|      const i = item as unknown as Record<string, unknown>;
   99|      if (Array.isArray(i.children)) {
  100|        const found = (i.children as AntMenuItem[]).some((c) => {
  101|          const ci = c as unknown as Record<string, unknown>;
  102|          return ci.key === activeKey;
  103|        });
  104|        if (found) open.push(String(i.key));
  105|        walk(i.children as AntMenuItem[]);
  106|      }
  107|    }
  108|  };
  109|
  110|  walk(items);
  111|  return open;
  112|}
  113|
  114|/** Flatten menu tree for O(1) lookup */
  115|function flattenMenuItems(items: AntMenuItem[]): Record<string, AntMenuItem> {
  116|  const map: Record<string, AntMenuItem> = {};
  117|  const walk = (list: AntMenuItem[]) => {
  118|    for (const item of list) {
  119|      if (!item || typeof item !== 'object') continue;
  120|      const i = item as unknown as Record<string, any>;
  121|      if (typeof i.key === 'string') {
  122|        map[i.key] = item;
  123|      }
  124|      if (Array.isArray(i.children)) {
  125|        walk(i.children as AntMenuItem[]);
  126|      }
  127|    }
  128|  };
  129|  walk(items);
  130|  return map;
  131|}

    3|export const getAuthToken = (): string | null => {
    4|  // Rely on HttpOnly cookies for security. 
    5|  // Returning null here forces Axios to not send the Authorization header,
    6|  // allowing the browser to send the session cookie instead.
    7|  return null;
    8|};
    9|

   11|  return null;
   12|};
   13|
   14|export const hasAuthToken = (): boolean => {
   15|  // We can't check HttpOnly cookies from JS. 
   16|  // We'll rely on the auth store's isAuthenticated state instead.
   17|  return false; 
   18|};
   19|
   20|/** persistent=true (default) → localStorage. persistent=false → sessionStorage. */
   21|export const setAuthToken = (_token: string, _persistent = true): void => {
   22|  // No-op: Token is now handled by HttpOnly cookies from the backend.
   23|};
   24|
   25|/** persistent=true (default) → localStorage. persistent=false → sessionStorage. */
   26|export const setRefreshToken = (_token: string, _persistent = true): void => {
   27|  // No-op
   28|};
   29|
   30|export const clearAuthToken = (): void => {
   31|  localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEYS.AUTH_TOKEN);
   32|  localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEYS.REFRESH_TOKEN);
   33|  localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEYS.TENANT_ID);
   34|  sessionStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEYS.AUTH_TOKEN);
   35|  sessionStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEYS.REFRESH_TOKEN);
   36|};

    1|import { QueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';

    4| * Singleton QueryClient shared between App.tsx (QueryClientProvider)
    5| * and auth.store.ts (cache invalidation on tenant switch).
    6| *

    8| * in the store actually clears the cache that React components see.

   11|  defaultOptions: {
   12|    queries: {
   13|      refetchOnWindowFocus: false,

   17|  },

===== FILE: src/lib/safe-storage.ts =====
    1|import { createJSONStorage } from 'zustand/middleware';
    2|
    3|/**
    4| * Creates a safe localStorage wrapper that gracefully handles
    5| * errors from quota exceeded, incognito mode, or SSR environments.
    6| */
    7|export const createSafeStorage = () =>
    8|  createJSONStorage(() => ({
    9|    getItem: (name: string) => {
   10|      try {
   11|        return localStorage.getItem(name);
   12|      } catch {
   13|        return null;
   14|      }
   15|    },
   16|    setItem: (name: string, value: string) => {
   17|      try {
   18|        localStorage.setItem(name, value);
   19|      } catch {
   20|        // Quota exceeded or incognito mode
   21|      }
   22|    },
   23|    removeItem: (name: string) => {
   24|      try {
   25|        localStorage.removeItem(name);
   26|      } catch {
   27|        // Ignore
   28|      }
   29|    },
   30|  }));
   31|

===== FILE: src/lib/storage-migration.ts =====
    1|import { STORAGE_KEYS } from '@/utils/constants';
    2|
    3|type MigrationRule = {
    4|  target: string;
    5|  sources: string[];
    6|};
    7|
    8|const LEGACY_STORAGE_MIGRATIONS: MigrationRule[] = [
    9|  {
   10|    target: STORAGE_KEYS.APP_STORAGE,
   11|    sources: ['app-storage', 'app-storage:v1a'],
   12|  },
   13|  {
   14|    target: STORAGE_KEYS.AUTH_STORAGE,
   15|    sources: ['uth-storage:v1', 'auth-storage'],
   16|  },
   17|];
   18|
   19|export function cleanupLegacyStorageKeys(): void {
   20|  try {
   21|    for (const rule of LEGACY_STORAGE_MIGRATIONS) {
   22|      const hasTarget = localStorage.getItem(rule.target) !== null;
   23|
   24|      // Preserve existing data by promoting the first available legacy key.
   25|      if (!hasTarget) {
   26|        for (const source of rule.sources) {
   27|          const legacyValue = localStorage.getItem(source);
   28|          if (legacyValue !== null) {
   29|            localStorage.setItem(rule.target, legacyValue);
   30|            break;
   31|          }
   32|        }
   33|      }
   34|
   35|      for (const source of rule.sources) {
   36|        localStorage.removeItem(source);
   37|      }
   38|    }
   39|  } catch {
   40|    // Ignore localStorage access issues (private mode/quota/SSR-like contexts).
   41|  }
   42|}
   43|

===== FILE: src/pages/accounting/CostApprovalsPage.tsx =====
    1|import { useState } from 'react';
    2|import { App, Button, Image, Input, Modal, Space, Table, Typography } from 'antd';
    3|import { useInvalidate } from '@refinedev/core';
    4|import { useTable } from '@refinedev/antd';
    5|import type { ColumnsType } from 'antd/es/table';
    6|import type { CostApprovalRequest } from '@/types/domain/cost';
    7|import { TripCostStatuses } from '@/types/domain/cost';
    8|import { PageHeader } from '@/components/common/PageHeader';
    9|import { useTranslation } from '@/hooks/useTranslation';
   10|import { ROUTES } from '@/routes';
   11|import { formatCurrencyVND } from '@/utils/format';
   12|import costService from '@/services/cost.service';
   13|import { getErrorMessage, shouldShowLocalErrorToast } from '@/utils/errorHandler';
   14|import { notifyErrorOnce } from '@/utils/errorToast';
   15|import { TableSkeleton } from '@/components/common/TableSkeleton';
   16|
   17|export function CostApprovalsPage() {
   18|  const { t } = useTranslation();
   19|  const { message, modal } = App.useApp();
   20|  const invalidate = useInvalidate();
   21|  const [rejectingId, setRejectingId] = useState<number | null>(null);
   22|  const [rejectNote, setRejectNote] = useState('');
   23|  const [busyId, setBusyId] = useState<number | null>(null);
   24|
   25|  const { tableProps, tableQuery } = useTable<CostApprovalRequest>({
   26|    resource: 'cost-approvals',
   27|    filters: {
   28|      permanent: [{ field: 'status', operator: 'eq', value: TripCostStatuses.pending }],
   29|    },
   30|    pagination: { pageSize: 15 },
   31|    syncWithLocation: true,
   32|  });
   33|
   34|  const handleApprove = async (id: number) => {
   35|    setBusyId(id);
   36|    try {
   37|      await costService.approveCostApproval(id);
   38|      message.success(t('costManagement.approveSuccess'));
   39|      await invalidate({ resource: 'cost-approvals', invalidates: ['list'] });
   40|    } catch (error) {
   41|      if (shouldShowLocalErrorToast(error)) {
   42|        notifyErrorOnce(`cost-approve-${id}`, error, {
   43|          fallbackMessage: getErrorMessage(error) || t('costManagement.approveError'),
   44|        });
   45|      }
   46|    } finally {
   47|      setBusyId(null);
   48|    }
   49|  };
   50|
   51|  const openReject = (id: number) => {
   52|    setRejectingId(id);
   53|    setRejectNote('');
   54|  };
   55|
   56|  const submitReject = async () => {
   57|    if (rejectingId == null) return;
   58|    const note = rejectNote.trim();
   59|    if (!note) {
   60|      message.warning(t('costManagement.rejectNoteRequired'));
   61|      return;
   62|    }
   63|    setBusyId(rejectingId);
   64|    try {
   65|      await costService.rejectCostApproval(rejectingId, note);
   66|      message.success(t('costManagement.rejectSuccess'));
   67|      setRejectingId(null);
   68|      await invalidate({ resource: 'cost-approvals', invalidates: ['list'] });
   69|    } catch (error) {
   70|      if (shouldShowLocalErrorToast(error)) {
   71|        notifyErrorOnce(`cost-reject-${rejectingId}`, error, {
   72|          fallbackMessage: getErrorMessage(error) || t('costManagement.rejectError'),
   73|        });
   74|      }
   75|    } finally {
   76|      setBusyId(null);
   77|    }
   78|  };
   79|
   80|  const columns: ColumnsType<CostApprovalRequest> = [
   81|    {
   82|      title: t('costManagement.colExpenseName'),
   83|      key: 'name',
   84|      ellipsis: true,
   85|      render: (_: unknown, row) =>
   86|        row.trip_cost?.description?.trim() || row.reason || row.trip?.code || `—`,
   87|    },
   88|    {
   89|      title: t('costManagement.colCategory'),
   90|      key: 'category',
   91|      render: (_: unknown, row) =>
   92|        row.trip_cost?.cost_category?.name ?? row.cost_category?.name ?? '—',
   93|    },
   94|    {
   95|      title: t('costManagement.colAmount'),
   96|      key: 'amount',
   97|      align: 'right',
   98|      render: (_: unknown, row) => formatCurrencyVND(row.trip_cost?.amount ?? row.total_amount),
   99|    },
  100|    {
  101|      title: t('costManagement.colNorm'),
  102|      key: 'norm',
  103|      align: 'right',
  104|      render: (_: unknown, row) => formatCurrencyVND(row.trip_cost?.norm_amount),
  105|    },
  106|    {
  107|      title: t('costManagement.colRequester'),
  108|      key: 'requester',
  109|      render: (_: unknown, row) =>
  110|        row.requester?.name || row.requester?.username || `#${row.requested_by}`,
  111|    },
  112|    {
  113|      title: t('costManagement.colReceipt'),
  114|      key: 'receipt',
  115|      width: 96,
  116|      render: (_: unknown, row) => {
  117|        const url = row.trip_cost?.receipt_file_url;
  118|        return url ? (
  119|          <Image src={url} alt="" width={56} height={56} style={{ objectFit: 'cover' }} />
  120|        ) : (
  121|          '—'
  122|        );
  123|      },
  124|    },
  125|    {
  126|      title: t('common.actions'),
  127|      key: 'actions',
  128|      fixed: 'right',
  129|      width: 200,
  130|      render: (_: unknown, row) => (
  131|        <Space>
  132|          <Button
  133|            type="primary"
  134|            className="!bg-green-600 hover:!bg-green-700"
  135|            size="small"
  136|            loading={busyId === row.id}
  137|            disabled={busyId !== null && busyId !== row.id}
  138|            onClick={() => {
  139|              modal.confirm({
  140|                title: t('costManagement.confirmApproveTitle'),
  141|                content: t('costManagement.confirmApproveBody'),
  142|                okText: t('common.approve'),
  143|                cancelText: t('common.cancel'),
  144|                onOk: () => handleApprove(row.id),
  145|              });
  146|            }}
  147|          >
  148|            {t('common.approve')}
  149|          </Button>
  150|          <Button
  151|            danger
  152|            size="small"
  153|            loading={busyId === row.id}
  154|            disabled={busyId !== null && busyId !== row.id}
  155|            onClick={() => openReject(row.id)}
  156|          >
  157|            {t('common.reject')}
  158|          </Button>
  159|        </Space>
  160|      ),
  161|    },
  162|  ];
  163|
  164|  if (tableQuery.isError) {
  165|    return (
  166|      <Typography.Paragraph type="danger">
  167|        {t('common.loadError')}
  168|      </Typography.Paragraph>
  169|    );
  170|  }
  171|
  172|  return (
  173|    <>
  174|      <PageHeader
  175|        title={t('costManagement.approvalsTitle')}
  176|        description={t('costManagement.approvalsDescription')}
  177|        breadcrumb={[
  178|          { label: t('dashboard.title'), path: ROUTES.dashboard },
  179|          { label: t('sidebar.accounting'), path: ROUTES.admin.accounting.revenue },
  180|          { label: t('costManagement.approvalsTitle') },
  181|        ]}
  182|      />
  183|
  184|      {tableQuery.isLoading ? (
  185|        <TableSkeleton rows={10} columns={6} />
  186|      ) : (
  187|        <Table<CostApprovalRequest>
  188|          {...tableProps}
  189|          rowKey="id"
  190|          columns={columns}
  191|          scroll={{ x: 1100 }}
  192|        />
  193|      )}
  194|
  195|      <Modal
  196|        open={rejectingId !== null}
  197|        title={t('costManagement.rejectModalTitle')}
  198|        okText={t('common.reject')}
  199|        okButtonProps={{ danger: true, loading: busyId === rejectingId }}
  200|        onCancel={() => setRejectingId(null)}
  201|        onOk={submitReject}
  202|        destroyOnHidden
  203|      >
  204|        <Typography.Paragraph type="secondary" className="mb-2">
  205|          {t('costManagement.rejectModalHint')}
  206|        </Typography.Paragraph>
  207|        <Input.TextArea
  208|          rows={4}
  209|          value={rejectNote}
  210|          onChange={(e) => setRejectNote(e.target.value)}
  211|          placeholder={t('costManagement.rejectNotePlaceholder')}
  212|        />
  213|      </Modal>
  214|    </>
  215|  );
  216|}

   21|function expenseTypeLabel(type: string, t: Translate): string {
   22|  const map: Record<string, string> = {
   23|    fuel: 'accountingPages.expenseTypeFuel',
   24|    toll: 'accountingPages.expenseTypeToll',
   25|    maintenance: 'accountingPages.expenseTypeMaintenance',

   27|    other: 'accountingPages.expenseTypeOther',
   28|  };

   31|}
   32|
   33|export function CostsPage() {

===== FILE: src/pages/auth/forgot-password-form.tsx =====
    1|import { useState } from 'react';
    2|import { Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
    3|import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
    4|import { Alert, Button, Card, Flex, Input, Space, Steps, Typography, theme } from 'antd';
    5|import { ArrowLeftOutlined } from '@ant-design/icons';
    6|import authService from '@/services/auth.service';
    7|import { ROUTES } from '@/routes';
    8|import { notifyErrorOnce } from '@/utils/errorToast';
    9|import { useTranslation } from '@/hooks/useTranslation';
   10|import { FORGOT_PASSWORD_EMAIL_STORAGE_KEY } from '@/lib/forgot-password-flow';
   11|
   12|export function ForgotPasswordForm() {
   13|  const navigate = useNavigate();
   14|  const { t } = useTranslation();
   15|  const { token } = theme.useToken();
   16|  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
   17|  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
   18|  const sendEnabled = authService.isForgotPasswordSendEnabled();
   19|
   20|  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
   21|    e.preventDefault();
   22|    if (!sendEnabled) {
   23|      toast.error(t('auth.forgotPasswordSendUnavailable'));
   24|      return;
   25|    }
   26|    if (isSubmitting) return;
   27|    const trimmed = email.trim();
   28|    if (!trimmed) {
   29|      toast.error(t('validation.required', { field: t('auth.email') }));
   30|      return;
   31|    }
   32|    try {
   33|      setIsSubmitting(true);
   34|      const response = await authService.forgotPassword(trimmed);
   35|      if (response.success) {
   36|        sessionStorage.setItem(FORGOT_PASSWORD_EMAIL_STORAGE_KEY, trimmed);
   37|        toast.success(t('auth.forgotPasswordSuccessToast'));
   38|        navigate(ROUTES.forgotPasswordVerify, { replace: true, state: { email: trimmed } });
   39|        return;
   40|      }
   41|      toast.error(response.message || t('auth.forgotPasswordFailed'));
   42|    } catch (error) {
   43|      notifyErrorOnce('auth-forgot-password', error, { fallbackMessage: t('auth.forgotPasswordFailed') });
   44|    } finally {
   45|      setIsSubmitting(false);
   46|    }
   47|  };
   48|
   49|  return (
   50|    <div
   51|      style={{
   52|        minHeight: '100vh',
   53|        display: 'flex',
   54|        alignItems: 'center',
   55|        justifyContent: 'center',
   56|        padding: 16,
   57|        background: token.colorFillAlter,
   58|      }}
   59|    >
   60|      <div style={{ width: '100%', maxWidth: 448 }}>
   61|        <Card style={{ boxShadow: token.boxShadowSecondary }}>
   62|          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
   63|            <Flex vertical gap={16} align="stretch">
   64|              <div style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>
   65|                <Typography.Title level={2} style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}>
   66|                  {t('auth.forgotPasswordTitle')}
   67|                </Typography.Title>
   68|                <Typography.Text type="secondary">{t('auth.forgotPasswordSubtitle')}</Typography.Text>
   69|              </div>
   70|
   71|              <Steps
   72|                size="small"
   73|                current={0}
   74|                items={[
   75|                  { title: t('auth.forgotPasswordStepEmail') },
   76|                  { title: t('auth.forgotPasswordStepOtp') },
   77|                  { title: t('auth.forgotPasswordStepNewPassword') },
   78|                ]}
   79|              />
   80|
   81|              <div>
   82|                <Typography.Text strong>{t('auth.email')}</Typography.Text>
   83|                <Input
   84|                  id="forgot-email"
   85|                  type="email"
   86|                  name="email"
   87|                  autoComplete="email"
   88|                  size="large"
   89|                  style={{ marginTop: 8 }}
   90|                  placeholder={t('auth.emailPlaceholder')}
   91|                  value={email}
   92|                  onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
   93|                  disabled={!sendEnabled}
   94|                  required
   95|                />
   96|              </div>
   97|
   98|              {!sendEnabled && <Alert type="info" message={t('auth.forgotPasswordSendUnavailable')} showIcon />}
   99|
  100|              <Button type="primary" htmlType="submit" block size="large" loading={isSubmitting} disabled={!sendEnabled}>
  101|                {t('auth.forgotPasswordSubmit')}
  102|              </Button>
  103|
  104|              <Space style={{ width: '100%', justifyContent: 'center' }}>
  105|                <Link to={ROUTES.login}>
  106|                  <Button type="link" icon={<ArrowLeftOutlined />} style={{ padding: 0, height: 'auto' }}>
  107|                    {t('auth.forgotPasswordBackToLogin')}
  108|                  </Button>
  109|                </Link>
  110|              </Space>
  111|            </Flex>
  112|          </form>
  113|        </Card>
  114|      </div>
  115|    </div>
  116|  );

   14|const extractResetToken = (body: ApiResponse<unknown>): string | null => {
   15|  const payload = body.data;
   16|  if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object') return null;
   17|  const o = payload as Record<string, unknown>;
   18|  const nested = o.data && typeof o.data === 'object' ? (o.data as Record<string, unknown>) : o;
   19|  const t = nested.token ?? nested.reset_token ?? nested.password_reset_token;
   20|  return typeof t === 'string' && t.trim() ? t.trim() : null;
   21|};
   22|
