   40|  const sendEnabled = authService.isForgotPasswordSendEnabled();
   41|
   42|  useEffect(() => {
   43|    let timer: NodeJS.Timeout;
   44|    if (countdown > 0) {
   45|      timer = setTimeout(() => setCountdown(countdown - 1), 1000);
   46|    }
   47|    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
   48|  }, [countdown]);
   49|
   50|
   51|  useEffect(() => {
   52|    const fromState = (location.state as { email?: string } | null)?.email?.trim();
   53|    const fromStorage = sessionStorage.getItem(FORGOT_PASSWORD_EMAIL_STORAGE_KEY)?.trim();
   54|    const resolved = fromState || fromStorage || '';
   55|    if (!resolved) {
   56|      navigate(ROUTES.forgotPassword, { replace: true });
   57|      return;
   58|    }
   59|    setEmail(resolved);
   60|  }, [location.state, navigate]);
   61|
   62|  const handleVerifyOtp = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
   63|    e.preventDefault();
   64|    if (!resetEnabled || isSubmitting || !email) return;
   65|    const code = otp.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 6);
   66|    if (code.length !== 6) {
   67|      toast.error(t('auth.forgotPasswordOtpLength'));
   68|      return;
   69|    }
   70|    try {
   71|      setIsSubmitting(true);
   72|      const response = await authService.checkOtp({ email, otp: code });
   73|      if (!response.success) {
   74|        setAttempts((prev) => prev + 1);
   75|        const remaining = MAX_ATTEMPTS - (attempts + 1);
   76|        if (remaining <= 0) {
   77|          toast.error(t('auth.forgotPasswordTooManyAttempts'));
   78|        } else {
   79|          toast.error(`${response.message || t('auth.forgotPasswordOtpInvalid')} (${remaining} ${t('auth.attemptsLeft')})`);
   80|        }
   81|        return;
   82|      }
   83|
   84|      const tok = extractResetToken(response as ApiResponse<unknown>);
   85|      if (tok) {
   86|        setResetToken(tok);
   87|      } else {
   88|        // Fallback: backend did not return a dedicated reset token in the check-otp response,
   89|        // so we use the OTP code itself as the token passed to reset-password.
   90|        // TODO: confirm with Laravel whether the reset endpoint expects the OTP string or a
   91|        // separate token field; remove this branch once the contract is settled.
   92|        setResetToken(code);
   93|      }
   94|      setPhase('password');
   95|      toast.success(t('auth.forgotPasswordOtpVerified'));
   96|    } catch (error) {
   97|      notifyErrorOnce('auth-check-otp', error, { fallbackMessage: t('auth.forgotPasswordOtpInvalid') });
   98|    } finally {
   99|      setIsSubmitting(false);
  100|    }
  101|  };
  102|
  103|  const handleResetPassword = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
  104|    e.preventDefault();
  105|    if (!resetEnabled || isSubmitting || !email || !resetToken) return;
  106|    const parsed = forgotPasswordConfirmSchema.safeParse({
  107|      password,
  108|      password_confirmation: passwordConfirmation,
  109|    });
  110|    if (!parsed.success) {
  111|      const msg = parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? t('auth.forgotPasswordResetFailed');
  112|      toast.error(msg);
  113|      return;
  114|    }
  115|    try {
  116|      setIsSubmitting(true);
  117|      const response = await authService.resetForgotPassword({
  118|        email,
  119|        token: resetToken,
  120|        password: parsed.data.password,
  121|        password_confirmation: parsed.data.password_confirmation,
  122|      });
  123|      if (response.success) {
  124|        sessionStorage.removeItem(FORGOT_PASSWORD_EMAIL_STORAGE_KEY);
  125|        toast.success(t('auth.forgotPasswordResetSuccess'));
  126|        window.setTimeout(() => {
  127|          navigate(ROUTES.login, { replace: true });
  128|        }, 3000);
  129|        return;
  130|      }
  131|      toast.error(response.message || t('auth.forgotPasswordResetFailed'));
  132|    } catch (error) {
  133|      notifyErrorOnce('auth-forgot-reset', error, { fallbackMessage: t('auth.forgotPasswordResetFailed') });
  134|    } finally {
  135|      setIsSubmitting(false);
  136|    }
  137|  };
  138|
  139|  const handleResend = async () => {
  140|    if (!email || isResending) return;
  141|    if (!sendEnabled) {
  142|      toast.error(t('auth.forgotPasswordSendUnavailable'));
  143|      return;
  144|    }
  145|    try {
  146|      setIsResending(true);
  147|      const response = await authService.forgotPassword(email);
  148|      if (response.success) {
  149|        toast.success(t('auth.forgotPasswordResendSuccess'));
  150|        setCountdown(60); // 1 minute cooldown
  151|        return;
  152|      }
  153|

  155|    } catch (error) {
  156|      notifyErrorOnce('auth-forgot-resend', error, { fallbackMessage: t('auth.forgotPasswordFailed') });
  157|    } finally {
  158|      setIsResending(false);
  159|    }
  160|  };
  161|
  162|  const goChangeEmail = () => {
  163|    sessionStorage.removeItem(FORGOT_PASSWORD_EMAIL_STORAGE_KEY);
  164|    navigate(ROUTES.forgotPassword, { replace: true });
  165|  };
  166|
  167|  if (!email) {
  168|    return null;
  169|  }
  170|
  171|  const stepIndex = phase === 'otp' ? 1 : 2;
  172|
  173|  return (

  187|            <div style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>

  189|              <Typography.Title level={2} style={{ marginTop: 16, marginBottom: 8 }}>

  194|

  227|          onRow={(row) => ({

  231|        />
  232|      </Card>
  233|
  234|      <DeleteConfirmDialog

  237|        onConfirm={confirmDelete}

  239|      />

  247|    </div>

===== FILE: src/pages/companies/CompanyFormDialog.tsx =====
    1|import { useEffect } from 'react';
    2|import { Alert, Button, Form, Space } from 'antd';
    3|import { ArrowLeftOutlined } from '@ant-design/icons';
    4|import { useCreate, useUpdate, useOne } from '@refinedev/core';
    5|import { TableSkeleton } from '@/components/common/TableSkeleton';
    6|import { ResourceFormModal } from '@/components/common/ResourceFormModal';
    7|import { UnsavedChangesWarningDialog } from '@/components/common/UnsavedChangesWarningDialog';
    8|import { CompanyForm } from './CompanyForm';
    9|import { useTranslation } from '@/hooks/useTranslation';
   10|import { useFormDialogBase } from '@/hooks/useFormDialogBase';
   11|import { useFormDialogCloseGuard } from '@/hooks/useFormDialogCloseGuard';
   12|import { useAppFeedback } from '@/hooks/useAppFeedback';
   13|import type { Company } from '@/types';
   14|import { getErrorMessage, shouldShowLocalErrorToast } from '@/utils/errorHandler';
   15|
   16|interface CompanyFormDialogProps {
   17|  open?: boolean;
   18|  mode?: 'create' | 'edit' | 'show';
   19|  recordId?: number;
   20|  onClose?: () => void;
   21|  onSuccess?: () => void;
   22|}
   23|
   24|export function CompanyFormDialog({ open, mode, recordId, onClose, onSuccess }: CompanyFormDialogProps = {}) {
   25|  const { t } = useTranslation();
   26|  const toast = useAppFeedback();
   27|  const { form, resolvedId, hasRecordId, isViewMode, isEdit, dialogOpen, handleClose } = useFormDialogBase({
   28|    open, mode, recordId, resource: 'companies', onClose,
   29|  });
   30|
   31|  const { data, isLoading: isLoadingData } = useOne<Company>({
   32|    resource: 'companies',
   33|    id: resolvedId || '',
   34|    queryOptions: { enabled: hasRecordId },
   35|  });
   36|
   37|  const { mutate: createItem, isLoading: isCreating } = useCreate<Company>();
   38|  const { mutate: updateItem, isLoading: isUpdating } = useUpdate<Company>();
   39|  const isLoading = isCreating || isUpdating || (hasRecordId && isLoadingData);
   40|
   41|  const { requestClose, handleDialogOpenChange, unsavedChangesWarningProps } = useFormDialogCloseGuard({
   42|    form,
   43|    isViewMode,
   44|    isSubmitting: isLoading,
   45|    onClose: handleClose,
   46|  });
   47|
   48|  const handleSubmit = (values: Partial<Company> & Record<string, unknown>) => {
   49|    const payload = { ...values };
   50|    
   51|    // Gộp các trường địa chỉ từ VnAdminAddressFields thành chuỗi address
   52|    if (payload.addr_province_name) {
   53|      const parts = [
   54|        payload.addr_street_detail,
   55|        payload.addr_ward_name,
   56|        payload.addr_district_name,
   57|        payload.addr_province_name,
   58|      ].filter((p): p is string => typeof p === 'string' && p.trim() !== '').map((p) => p.trim());
   59|      
   60|      if (parts.length > 0) {
   61|        payload.address = parts.join(', ');
   62|      }
   63|    }
   64|
   65|    // Xoá các trường tạm thời để payload sạch sẽ
   66|    delete payload.addr_province_code;
   67|    delete payload.addr_district_code;
   68|    delete payload.addr_ward_code;
   69|    delete payload.addr_province_name;
   70|    delete payload.addr_district_name;
   71|    delete payload.addr_ward_name;
   72|    delete payload.addr_street_detail;
   73|
   74|    if (isEdit && resolvedId) {
   75|      updateItem(
   76|        { resource: 'companies', id: resolvedId, values: payload },
   77|        {
   78|          onSuccess: () => {
   79|            toast.success(t('notifications.updateSuccess', { item: t('companies.title') }));
   80|            onSuccess?.();
   81|            handleClose();
   82|          },
   83|          onError: (error) => {
   84|            if (!shouldShowLocalErrorToast(error)) return;
   85|            toast.error(getErrorMessage(error) || t('notifications.updateError', { item: t('companies.title') }));
   86|          },
   87|        }
   88|      );
   89|    } else {
   90|      createItem(
   91|        { resource: 'companies', values: payload },
   92|        {
   93|          onSuccess: () => {
   94|            toast.success(t('notifications.createSuccess', { item: t('companies.title') }));
   95|            onSuccess?.();
   96|            handleClose();
   97|          },
   98|          onError: (error) => {
   99|            if (!shouldShowLocalErrorToast(error)) return;
  100|            toast.error(getErrorMessage(error) || t('notifications.createError', { item: t('companies.title') }));
  101|          },
  102|        }
  103|      );
  104|    }
  105|  };
  106|
  107|  useEffect(() => {
  108|    if (hasRecordId && data?.data) {
  109|      form.setFieldsValue(data.data);
  110|    }
  111|  }, [hasRecordId, data?.data, form]);
  112|
  113|  const title = isViewMode ? t('common.view') : isEdit ? t('companies.editCompany') : t('companies.createCompany');
  114|  const description = isViewMode
  115|    ? t('companies.editDescription')
  116|    : isEdit
  117|      ? t('companies.editDescription')
  118|      : t('companies.createDescription');
  119|
  120|  const footer = (
  121|    <Space style={{ width: '100%', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
  122|      <Button icon={<ArrowLeftOutlined />} onClick={requestClose}>
  123|        {t('common.back')}
  124|      </Button>
  125|      {!isViewMode ? (
  126|        <Button type="primary" onClick={() => form.submit()} loading={isLoading}>
  127|          {isEdit ? t('common.update') : t('common.create')}
  128|        </Button>
  129|      ) : (
  130|        <span />
  131|      )}
  132|    </Space>
  133|  );
  134|
  135|  const body =
  136|    hasRecordId && isLoadingData ? (
  137|      <TableSkeleton rows={8} columns={1} />
  138|    ) : (
  139|      <>
  140|        <Alert
  141|          type="info"
  142|          message={t('formGuides.title')}
  143|          description={t('formGuides.company')}
  144|          showIcon
  145|          style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}
  146|        />
  147|        <Form
  148|          form={form}
  149|          name="company-form"
  150|          onFinish={handleSubmit}
  151|          layout="vertical"
  152|          validateTrigger={['onBlur', 'onSubmit']}
  153|          disabled={isViewMode}
  154|        >
  155|          <CompanyForm form={form} initialValues={data?.data} />
  156|        </Form>
  157|      </>
  158|    );
  159|
  160|  return (
  161|    <>
  162|      <ResourceFormModal
  163|        open={dialogOpen}
  164|        onOpenChange={handleDialogOpenChange}
  165|        title={title}
  166|        description={description}
  167|        footer={footer}
  168|        width="min(56rem, calc(100vw - 2rem))"
  169|      >
  170|        {body}
  171|      </ResourceFormModal>
  172|      <UnsavedChangesWarningDialog {...unsavedChangesWarningProps} />
  173|    </>
  174|  );
  175|}

    1|import { DatePicker, Form } from 'antd';
    2|import dayjs from 'dayjs';

    4|import { useTranslation } from '@/hooks/useTranslation';
    5|import type { Customer, CustomerGroup } from '@/types';
    6|import { FormItemNumber } from '@/components/form/FormItemNumber';
    7|import api from '@/services/api';
    8|import { ENDPOINTS } from '@/services/endpoints';
    9|
   10|interface CustomerFormProps {
   11|  form: ReturnType<typeof Form.useForm>[0];
   12|  initialValues?: Partial<Customer>;
   13|  groups?: CustomerGroup[];
   14|  isEdit?: boolean;
   15|  customerId?: number;
   16|}
   17|
   18|const PHONE_PATTERN = /^[0-9+()\-\s]{8,15}$/;
   19|const TAX_CODE_PATTERN = /^\d{10}(-\d{3})?$/;
   20|
   21|import React from 'react';
   22|const useCustomerUniqueCheck = () => {
   23|  const codeTimer = React.useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
   24|  const taxTimer = React.useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
   25|  React.useEffect(() => () => {
   26|    if (codeTimer.current) clearTimeout(codeTimer.current);
   27|    if (taxTimer.current) clearTimeout(taxTimer.current);
   28|  }, []);
   29|  return (field: 'code' | 'tax_code', value: string, currentId?: number) =>
   30|    new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => {
   31|      const timerRef = field === 'code' ? codeTimer : taxTimer;
   32|      if (timerRef.current) clearTimeout(timerRef.current);
   33|      timerRef.current = setTimeout(async () => {
   34|        try {
   35|          const res = await api.get(ENDPOINTS.customers.base, {
   36|            params: { [field]: value, per_page: 5 },
   37|            skipErrorToast: true,
   38|          } as Parameters<typeof api.get>[1]);
   39|          const list = (res.data as { data?: { data?: Array<{ id: number; code?: string; tax_code?: string }> } }).data?.data ?? [];
   40|          const dup = list.find((row) => {
   41|            const v = (row as Record<string, unknown>)[field];
   42|            return typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().toLowerCase() === value.trim().toLowerCase() && row.id !== currentId;
   43|          });
   44|          resolve(!dup);
   45|        } catch {
   46|          resolve(true);
   47|        }
   48|      }, 350);
   49|    });
   50|};

   58|  const typeOptions = [
   59|    { label: t('customers.typeCompany'), value: 'company' },
   60|    { label: t('customers.typeIndividual'), value: 'individual' },
   61|  ];
   62|
   63|  return (
   64|    <FormAccordionSections
   65|      defaultOpen="basic"
   66|      sections={[
   67|        {
   68|          value: 'basic',
   69|          titleKey: 'basic',

   71|            <>
   72|              <FormItemText
   73|                name="code"

   75|                disabled
   76|                placeholder="Tự sinh khi lưu"
   77|              />

   79|              <FormItemSelect name="type" label={t('customers.type')} required options={typeOptions} rules={[{ required: true, message: t('validation.required', { field: t('customers.type') }) }]} />
   80|              <FormItemSelect
   81|                name="group_id"

   83|                options={groups.map((group) => ({ label: group.name, value: group.id }))}
   84|              />

   86|              <FormItemNumber name="payment_terms_days" label={t('customers.paymentTermsDays')} min={0} />
   87|              <FormItemText

   99|                      if (!TAX_CODE_PATTERN.test(value.trim())) {

  101|                      }
  102|                      const ok = await checkCustomerUnique('tax_code', value.trim(), customerId);
  103|                      if (!ok) throw new Error('Mã số thuế đã tồn tại');
  104|                    },
  105|                  },
  106|                ]}
  107|              />
  108|              <FormItemSelect
  109|                name="is_active"

  159|                normalize={(value: dayjs.Dayjs | null) => (value ? value.format('YYYY-MM-DD') : null)}
  160|              >
  161|                <DatePicker style={{ width: '100%' }} format="DD/MM/YYYY" />

  165|                name="contract_end_date"
  166|                dependencies={['contract_start_date']}
  167|                getValueProps={(value: string | null | undefined) => ({ value: value ? dayjs(value) : null })}
  168|                normalize={(value: dayjs.Dayjs | null) => (value ? value.format('YYYY-MM-DD') : null)}
  169|                rules={[
  170|                  ({ getFieldValue }) => ({
  171|                    validator(_: unknown, value: string | null) {
  172|                      const start = getFieldValue('contract_start_date');

  174|                        return Promise.reject(new Error('Vui lòng nhập ngày bắt đầu hợp đồng trước'));
  175|                      }
  176|                      if (!value || !start) return Promise.resolve();
  177|                      if (dayjs(value).isBefore(dayjs(start), 'day')) {
  178|                        return Promise.reject(new Error('Ngày kết thúc phải sau ngày bắt đầu'));
  179|                      }
  180|                      return Promise.resolve();
  181|                    },
  182|                  }),

   10|import { useFormDialogCloseGuard } from '@/hooks/useFormDialogCloseGuard';
   11|import { UnsavedChangesWarningDialog } from '@/components/common/UnsavedChangesWarningDialog';
   12|import toast from 'react-hot-toast';

   15|import { useCreateCustomer, useCustomerDetail, useUpdateCustomer } from '@/hooks/useCustomers';
   16|
   17|interface CustomerFormDialogProps {
   18|  open?: boolean;
   19|  mode?: 'create' | 'edit' | 'show';
   20|  recordId?: number;
   21|  onClose?: () => void;
   22|  onSuccess?: () => void;
   23|}
   24|
   25|export function CustomerFormDialog({ open, mode, recordId, onClose, onSuccess }: CustomerFormDialogProps = {}) {
   26|  const { t } = useTranslation();
   27|  const { id } = useParams<{ id?: string }>();
   28|  const location = useLocation();
   29|  const { list } = useNavigation();
   30|  const [form] = Form.useForm();
   31|  const isControlled = typeof open === 'boolean';
   32|  const resolvedId = recordId ?? (id ? Number(id) : undefined);
   33|  const hasRecordId = !!resolvedId;
   34|  const isViewMode = mode ? mode === 'show' : location.pathname.includes('/show/');
   35|  const isEdit = hasRecordId && !isViewMode;
   36|  const dialogOpen = isControlled ? open : true;
   37|
   38|  const { customer, loading: isLoadingData } = useCustomerDetail(resolvedId, hasRecordId);
   39|  const { mutate: createCustomer, isPending: isCreating } = useCreateCustomer();
   40|  const { mutate: updateCustomer, isPending: isUpdating } = useUpdateCustomer();
   41|  const isLoading = isCreating || isUpdating || (hasRecordId && isLoadingData);
   42|
   43|  const handleClose = () => {
   44|    onClose?.();
   45|    if (!isControlled) {
   46|      list('customers');
   47|    }
   48|  };
   49|
   50|  const { requestClose, handleDialogOpenChange, unsavedChangesWarningProps } = useFormDialogCloseGuard({
   51|    form,
   52|    isViewMode,
   53|    isSubmitting: isLoading,
   54|    onClose: handleClose,
   55|  });
   56|
   57|  const handleSubmit = (values: Partial<Customer>) => {
   58|    if (isEdit && resolvedId) {
   59|      updateCustomer(
   60|        { id: resolvedId, values },
   61|        {
   62|          onSuccess: () => {
   63|            toast.success(t('notifications.updateSuccess', { item: t('customers.title') }));
   64|            onSuccess?.();
   65|            handleClose();
   66|          },
   67|          onError: (error) => {
   68|            if (!shouldShowLocalErrorToast(error)) return;
   69|            toast.error(getErrorMessage(error) || t('notifications.updateError', { item: t('customers.title') }));
   70|          },
   71|        }
   72|      );
   73|    } else {
   74|      createCustomer(
   75|        values as Parameters<typeof createCustomer>[0],
   76|        {
   77|          onSuccess: () => {
   78|            toast.success(t('notifications.createSuccess', { item: t('customers.title') }));
   79|            onSuccess?.();
   80|            handleClose();
   81|          },
   82|          onError: (error) => {
   83|            if (!shouldShowLocalErrorToast(error)) return;
   84|            toast.error(getErrorMessage(error) || t('notifications.createError', { item: t('customers.title') }));
   85|          },
   86|        }
   87|      );
   88|    }
   89|  };
   90|
   91|  useEffect(() => {
   92|    if (hasRecordId && customer) {
   93|      form.setFieldsValue(customer);
   94|    }
   95|  }, [hasRecordId, customer, form]);
   96|
   97|  const title = isViewMode ? t('common.view') : isEdit ? t('customers.editCustomer') : t('customers.createCustomer');
   98|  const description = isViewMode
   99|    ? t('customers.editDescription')
  100|    : isEdit
  101|      ? t('customers.editDescription')
  102|      : t('customers.createDescription');
  103|
  104|  const footer = (
  105|    <Space style={{ width: '100%', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
  106|      <Button icon={<ArrowLeftOutlined />} onClick={requestClose}>
  107|        {t('common.back')}
  108|      </Button>
  109|      {!isViewMode ? (
  110|        <Button type="primary" onClick={() => form.submit()} loading={isLoading}>
  111|          {isEdit ? t('common.update') : t('common.create')}
  112|        </Button>
  113|      ) : (
  114|        <span />
  115|      )}
  116|    </Space>
  117|  );
  118|
  119|  const body =
  120|    hasRecordId && isLoadingData ? (
  121|      <TableSkeleton rows={6} columns={1} />
  122|    ) : (
  123|      <>
  124|        <Alert
  125|          type="info"
  126|          message={t('formGuides.title')}
  127|          description={t('formGuides.customer')}
  128|          showIcon
  129|          style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}
  130|        />
  131|        <Form
  132|          form={form}
  133|          onFinish={handleSubmit}
  134|          layout="vertical"
  135|          validateTrigger={['onBlur', 'onSubmit']}
  136|          disabled={isViewMode}
  137|        >
  138|          <CustomerForm form={form} initialValues={customer ?? undefined} />
  139|        </Form>
  140|      </>
  141|    );
  142|
  143|  return (
  144|    <>
  145|      <ResourceFormModal
  146|        open={dialogOpen}
  147|        onOpenChange={handleDialogOpenChange}
  148|        title={title}
  149|        description={description}
  150|        footer={footer}
  151|        width={896}
  152|      >
  153|        {body}

   24|export function CustomersList() {

   26|  const { show } = useNavigation();
   27|  const [formOpen, setFormOpen] = useState(false);
   28|  const [formMode, setFormMode] = useState<'create' | 'edit'>('create');
   29|  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState<number | undefined>(undefined);
   30|  const [deleteDialogOpen, setDeleteDialogOpen] = useState(false);
   31|  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<Customer | null>(null);
   32|  const [current, setCurrent] = useState(1);
   33|  const [searchKeyword, setSearchKeyword] = useState('');
   34|  const [selectedType, setSelectedType] = useState<string | undefined>(undefined);
   35|  const [appliedKeyword, setAppliedKeyword] = useState('');
   36|  const [appliedType, setAppliedType] = useState<string | undefined>(undefined);
   37|
   38|  const { data, total, loading, error, refetch } = useCustomerList({
   39|    current,
   40|    pageSize: 15,
   41|    search: appliedKeyword,
   42|    type: appliedType as 'company' | 'individual' | undefined,
   43|  });
   44|  const { mutateAsync: deleteCustomer } = useDeleteCustomer();
   45|
   46|  const handleSearchFilters = () => {
   47|    setAppliedKeyword(searchKeyword.trim());
   48|    setAppliedType(selectedType);
   49|    setCurrent(1);
   50|  };
   51|
   52|  const handleClearFilters = () => {
   53|    setSearchKeyword('');
   54|    setSelectedType(undefined);
   55|    setAppliedKeyword('');
   56|    setAppliedType(undefined);
   57|    setCurrent(1);
   58|  };
   59|
   60|  const handleCreate = () => {
   61|    setFormMode('create');
   62|    setEditingId(undefined);
   63|    setFormOpen(true);
   64|  };
   65|
   66|  const handleEdit = (id: number) => {
   67|    setFormMode('edit');
   68|    setEditingId(id);
   69|    setFormOpen(true);
   70|  };
   71|
   72|  const confirmDelete = () => {
   73|    if (!selected) return;
   74|    void deleteCustomer(selected.id)

   77|        setDeleteDialogOpen(false);
   78|        setSelected(null);
   79|        refetch();

   84|      });
   85|  };
   86|

  103|            <EyeIcon className="h-4 w-4" />
  104|          </Button>

  107|          </Button>

  109|            <Trash2Icon className="h-4 w-4" />
  110|          </Button>
  111|        </div>
  112|      ),
  113|    },
  114|  ];
  115|

  117|  const pageSize = 15;
  118|
  119|  return (

  125|        actions={
  126|          <Button onClick={handleCreate} className="gap-2">
  127|            <PlusIcon className="h-4 w-4" />

  134|        <div className="mb-4 grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 md:grid-cols-4">

  148|              { label: t('customers.typeIndividual'), value: 'individual' },

===== FILE: src/pages/dashboard/components/ChartAreaInteractive.tsx =====
    1|import { useMemo } from 'react';
    2|import { Alert, Button, Card, Flex, Progress, Space, Spin, Typography, theme, Empty } from 'antd';
    3|import { ReloadOutlined } from '@ant-design/icons';
    4|import { useTranslation } from '@/hooks/useTranslation';
    5|import { useTopDrivers } from '@/hooks/useTopDrivers';
    6|
    7|function formatVnd(value: number): string {
    8|  return new Intl.NumberFormat('vi-VN', { style: 'currency', currency: 'VND' }).format(value);
    9|}
   10|
   11|export function ChartAreaInteractive({
   12|  companyId,
   13|  month,
   14|  year,
   15|}: {
   16|  companyId?: number
   17|  month: number
   18|  year: number
   19|}) {
   20|  const { t } = useTranslation();
   21|  const { token } = theme.useToken();
   22|  const { rows, loading, error, refetch } = useTopDrivers({ companyId, month, year, limit: 8 });
   23|
   24|  const enrichedRows = useMemo(() => {
   25|    const maxTrips = Math.max(1, ...rows.map((row) => row.trips));
   26|    const maxRevenue = Math.max(1, ...rows.map((row) => row.revenue));
   27|    return rows.map((row, index) => ({
   28|      ...row,
   29|      rank: index + 1,
   30|      tripPercent: Math.max(8, Math.round((row.trips / maxTrips) * 100)),
   31|      revenuePercent: Math.max(8, Math.round((row.revenue / maxRevenue) * 100)),
   32|    }));
   33|  }, [rows]);
   34|
   35|  return (
   36|    <Card
   37|      title={t('dashboard.topDrivers')}
   38|      extra={
   39|        <Button size="small" icon={<ReloadOutlined />} onClick={() => void refetch()}>
   40|          {t('common.refresh')}
   41|        </Button>
   42|      }
   43|    >
   44|      <Space direction="vertical" size="middle" style={{ width: '100%' }}>
   45|        <Typography.Text type="secondary">
   46|          {month}/{year} · {t('dashboard.cards.completedTrips')} và {t('dashboard.cards.totalRevenue')}
   47|        </Typography.Text>
   48|
   49|        {loading ? (
   50|          <Flex justify="center" align="center" style={{ padding: token.paddingXL, width: '100%' }}>
   51|            <Spin />
   52|          </Flex>
   53|        ) : error ? (
   54|          <Alert type="error" showIcon message={t('common.loadError')} description={error} />
   55|        ) : enrichedRows.length === 0 ? (
   56|          <Empty description={t('common.noData')} />
   57|        ) : (
   58|          <Space direction="vertical" size="middle" style={{ width: '100%' }}>
   59|            {enrichedRows.map((row) => (
   60|              <Card key={String(row.driverId)} size="small" style={{ width: '100%' }}>
   61|                <Flex vertical gap="small">
   62|                  <Flex justify="space-between" align="center" gap="middle">
   63|                    <Flex vertical>
   64|                      <Typography.Text strong>
   65|                        {row.rank}. {row.driverName}
   66|                      </Typography.Text>
   67|                      <Typography.Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: token.fontSizeSM }}>
   68|                        {row.trips} chuyến · {formatVnd(row.revenue)}
   69|                      </Typography.Text>
   70|                    </Flex>
   71|                    <Typography.Text type="secondary" style={{ fontSize: token.fontSizeSM }}>
   72|                      {row.tripPercent}%
   73|                    </Typography.Text>
   74|                  </Flex>
   75|                  <Flex vertical gap={token.marginXXS}>
   76|                    <Progress percent={row.tripPercent} showInfo={false} strokeColor={token.colorPrimary} />
   77|                    <Progress percent={row.revenuePercent} showInfo={false} strokeColor={token.colorInfo} />
   78|                  </Flex>
   79|                </Flex>
   80|              </Card>
   81|            ))}
   82|          </Space>
   83|        )}
   84|      </Space>
   85|    </Card>
   86|  );

   13|function getDocumentLabel(docType: string, fallbackLabel?: string): string {
   14|  if (fallbackLabel) return fallbackLabel;
   15|  const map: Record<string, string> = {
   16|    GPLX: 'GPLX',
   17|    gplx: 'GPLX',
   18|    license: 'GPLX',

   29|    registration: 'Đăng kiểm',

   31|  };

   35|function severityColor(days: number): string {
   36|  if (days <= 0) return 'red';
   37|  if (days < 7) return 'red';
   38|  return 'orange';

   40|
   41|function normalizeArray<T>(value: unknown): T[] {
   42|  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value as T[];
   43|  if (value && typeof value === 'object') {
   44|    const nested = (value as { data?: unknown }).data;
   45|    if (Array.isArray(nested)) return nested as T[];
   46|  }
   47|  return [];

===== FILE: src/pages/dispatch/components/QuickAssignModal.tsx =====
    1|import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
    2|import { Alert, Form, Modal, Select, Spin } from 'antd';
    3|import type { BaseRecord } from '@refinedev/core';
    4|import { useCustom } from '@refinedev/core';
    5|import dayjs from 'dayjs';
    6|import { ENDPOINTS } from '@/services/endpoints';
    7|import tripService from '@/services/trip.service';
    8|import type { Driver, Vehicle } from '@/types';
    9|import type { DispatchTrip } from '@/types/api/dispatch';
   10|import { vehicleHasInTransitOverlap } from '@/pages/dispatch/dispatch-utils';
   11|import { useAppFeedback } from '@/hooks/useAppFeedback';
   12|import { getErrorMessage, shouldShowLocalErrorToast } from '@/utils/errorHandler';
   13|
   14|function normalizeResourceList<T>(raw: unknown): T[] {
   15|  if (raw == null) return [];
   16|  if (Array.isArray(raw)) return raw as T[];
   17|  if (typeof raw === 'object' && raw !== null && 'data' in raw) {
   18|    const inner = (raw as { data: unknown }).data;
   19|    if (Array.isArray(inner)) return inner as T[];
   20|    if (inner && typeof inner === 'object' && 'data' in inner && Array.isArray((inner as { data: unknown }).data)) {
   21|      return (inner as { data: T[] }).data;
   22|    }
   23|  }
   24|  return [];
   25|}
   26|
   27|export interface QuickAssignModalProps {
   28|  open: boolean;
   29|  trip: DispatchTrip | null;
   30|  dateStr: string;
   31|  boardTrips: DispatchTrip[];
   32|  excludedDriverIds: Set<number>;
   33|  onClose: () => void;
   34|  onSuccess: () => void;
   35|}
   36|
   37|export function QuickAssignModal({
   38|  open,
   39|  trip,
   40|  dateStr,
   41|  boardTrips,
   42|  excludedDriverIds,
   43|  onClose,
   44|  onSuccess,
   45|}: QuickAssignModalProps) {
   46|  const [form] = Form.useForm<{ driver_id: number; vehicle_id: number }>();
   47|  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
   48|  const feedback = useAppFeedback();
   49|
   50|  const { data: driversPayload, isFetching: loadingDrivers } = useCustom<BaseRecord>({
   51|    url: ENDPOINTS.drivers.available,
   52|    method: 'get',
   53|    config: { query: { date: dateStr } },
   54|    queryOptions: { enabled: open, staleTime: 30_000 },
   55|  });
   56|
   57|  const { data: vehiclesPayload, isFetching: loadingVehicles } = useCustom<BaseRecord>({
   58|    url: ENDPOINTS.vehicles.available,
   59|    method: 'get',
   60|    config: { query: { date: dateStr } },
   61|    queryOptions: { enabled: open, staleTime: 30_000 },
   62|  });
   63|
   64|  const driversRaw = useMemo(() => normalizeResourceList<Driver>(driversPayload?.data), [driversPayload?.data]);
   65|  const vehiclesRaw = useMemo(() => normalizeResourceList<Vehicle>(vehiclesPayload?.data), [vehiclesPayload?.data]);
   66|
   67|  const { driverOptions, vehicleOptions } = useMemo(() => {
   68|    if (!trip) {
   69|      return { driverOptions: [] as { label: string; value: number; driver: Driver }[], vehicleOptions: [] as { label: string; value: number }[] };
   70|    }
   71|
   72|    const dOpts = driversRaw
   73|      .filter((d) => !excludedDriverIds.has(d.id))
   74|      .map((d) => {
   75|        const expired =
   76|          d.expired_date != null &&
   77|          d.expired_date !== '' &&
   78|          dayjs(d.expired_date).isBefore(dayjs(), 'day');
   79|        const base = d.name ?? d.code ?? `Tài xế #${d.id}`;
   80|        const label = expired ? `${base} (GPLX hết hạn — vẫn gán được)` : base;
   81|        return { label, value: d.id, driver: d };
   82|      });
   83|
   84|    const vOpts = vehiclesRaw
   85|      .filter((v) => v.status !== 'maintenance' && v.status !== 'broken')
   86|      .filter((v) => !vehicleHasInTransitOverlap(v.id, trip, boardTrips))
   87|      .map((v) => ({
   88|        label: `${v.plate_number}${v.type ? ` · ${v.type}` : ''}`,
   89|        value: v.id,
   90|      }));
   91|
   92|    return { driverOptions: dOpts, vehicleOptions: vOpts };
   93|  }, [boardTrips, driversRaw, excludedDriverIds, trip, vehiclesRaw]);
   94|
   95|  useEffect(() => {
   96|    if (open) {
   97|      form.resetFields();
   98|    }
   99|  }, [open, trip?.id, form]);
  100|
  101|  const handleOk = async () => {
  102|    if (!trip) return;
  103|    try {
  104|      const values = await form.validateFields();
  105|      setSubmitting(true);
  106|      const assignRes = await tripService.assign(trip.id, { driver_id: values.driver_id, vehicle_id: values.vehicle_id });
  107|      if (!assignRes.success) {
  108|        feedback.error(assignRes.message || 'Phân công thất bại');
  109|        return;
  110|      }
  111|      const metaWarnings = assignRes.meta?.warnings ?? [];
  112|      const d = driversRaw.find((x) => x.id === values.driver_id);
  113|      if (d?.expired_date && dayjs(d.expired_date).isBefore(dayjs(), 'day')) {
  114|        console.warn('[dispatch] Assigned trip with expired license', { tripId: trip.id, driverId: d.id, expired_date: d.expired_date });
  115|      }
  116|      if (metaWarnings.length > 0) {
  117|        feedback.warning(metaWarnings.join('\n'));
  118|      }
  119|      feedback.success('Đã phân công chuyến');
  120|      onSuccess();
  121|      onClose();
  122|    } catch (e) {
  123|      if (!shouldShowLocalErrorToast(e)) return;
  124|      feedback.error(getErrorMessage(e) ?? 'Phân công thất bại');
  125|    } finally {
  126|      setSubmitting(false);
  127|    }
  128|  };
  129|
  130|  return (
  131|    <Modal
  132|      title="Phân công nhanh"
  133|      open={open}
  134|      onCancel={onClose}
  135|      onOk={() => void handleOk()}
  136|      confirmLoading={submitting}
  137|      okText="Gán"
  138|      cancelText="Hủy"
  139|      destroyOnHidden
  140|    >
  141|      {trip ? (
  142|        <div className="mb-3 text-sm text-slate-600">
  143|          <strong>{trip.code}</strong>
  144|          <div className="text-xs">
  145|            {trip.start_point ?? '—'} → {trip.end_point ?? '—'}
  146|          </div>
  147|        </div>
  148|      ) : null}
  149|
  150|      <Alert
  151|        type="info"
  152|        showIcon
  153|        className="mb-3"
  154|        message="Danh sách gợi ý đã lọc theo quy tắc: không xe bảo dưỡng/hỏng; không xe đang in_transit trùng giờ; tài xế nghỉ phép đã duyệt trong ngày được loại ở bước trước."
  155|      />
  156|
  157|      <Spin spinning={loadingDrivers || loadingVehicles}>
  158|        <Form name="quick-assign-form" form={form} layout="vertical">
  159|          <Form.Item
  160|            name="driver_id"
  161|            label="Tài xế"
  162|            rules={[{ required: true, message: 'Chọn tài xế' }]}
  163|          >
  164|            <Select
  165|              showSearch
  166|              optionFilterProp="label"
  167|              placeholder="Chọn tài xế"
  168|              options={driverOptions.map((o) => ({ label: o.label, value: o.value }))}
  169|            />
  170|          </Form.Item>
  171|          <Form.Item
  172|            name="vehicle_id"
  173|            label="Xe"
  174|            rules={[{ required: true, message: 'Chọn xe' }]}
  175|          >
  176|            <Select
  177|              showSearch
  178|              optionFilterProp="label"
  179|              placeholder="Chọn xe"
  180|              options={vehicleOptions}
  181|            />
  182|          </Form.Item>
  183|        </Form>
  184|      </Spin>
  185|    </Modal>
  186|  );
  187|}
  188|

   83|function groupByBucket<T extends { bucket: ResourceBucket }>(items: T[]): Record<ResourceBucket, T[]> {
   84|  const out: Record<ResourceBucket, T[]> = { available: [], busy: [], offline: [] };
   85|  for (const it of items) {
   86|    out[it.bucket].push(it);
   87|  }
   88|  return out;

   14|function formatCustomer(trip: DispatchTrip): string {

   17|  const code = c.code ? `${c.code} — ` : '';
   18|  return `${code}${c.name ?? ''}`.trim() || '—';

   21|function formatAppointment(trip: DispatchTrip): string {
   22|  const from = trip.scheduled_time_from ? String(trip.scheduled_time_from).slice(0, 5) : '';
   23|  const to = trip.scheduled_time_to ? String(trip.scheduled_time_to).slice(0, 5) : '';
   24|  if (from && to) return `${from} – ${to}`;
   25|  if (from) return from;
   26|  return '—';

   30|
   31|const tripCoversHour = (trip: DispatchTrip, hour: number): boolean => {
   32|  const from = trip.scheduled_time_from ?? null;
   33|  const to = trip.scheduled_time_to ?? null;
   34|  if (!from && !to) return false;
   35|  const startHour = from ? dayjs(from).hour() : hour;
   36|  const endHour = to ? dayjs(to).hour() : startHour;
   37|  if (Number.isNaN(startHour) || Number.isNaN(endHour)) return false;
   38|  if (endHour < startHour) return hour >= startHour;
   39|  return hour >= startHour && hour <= endHour;
   40|};

===== FILE: src/pages/dispatch/dispatch-utils.ts =====
    1|import type { DispatchTrip } from '@/types/api/dispatch';
    2|import { ACTIVE_TRIP_STATUSES } from '@/utils/tripStatus';
    3|
    4|export function parseTimeToMinutes(value?: string | null): number | null {
    5|  if (value == null || value === '') return null;
    6|  const matched = String(value).match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})/);
    7|  if (matched) {
    8|    const h = Number(matched[1]);
    9|    const m = Number(matched[2]);
   10|    if (Number.isFinite(h) && Number.isFinite(m)) return h * 60 + m;
   11|  }
   12|  return null;
   13|}
   14|
   15|export function tripTimeWindowMinutes(trip: {
   16|  scheduled_time_from?: string | null;
   17|  scheduled_time_to?: string | null;
   18|}): { start: number; end: number } | null {
   19|  const start = parseTimeToMinutes(trip.scheduled_time_from);
   20|  if (start == null) return null;
   21|  let end = parseTimeToMinutes(trip.scheduled_time_to);
   22|  if (end == null) end = start + 120;
   23|  if (end <= start) end = start + 60;
   24|  return { start, end };
   25|}
   26|
   27|export function rangesOverlap(
   28|  a: { start: number; end: number },
   29|  b: { start: number; end: number },
   30|): boolean {
   31|  return a.start < b.end && b.start < a.end;
   32|}
   33|
   34|export function vehicleHasInTransitOverlap(
   35|  vehicleId: number,
   36|  candidateTrip: DispatchTrip,
   37|  allTrips: DispatchTrip[],
   38|): boolean {
   39|  const win = tripTimeWindowMinutes(candidateTrip);
   40|  if (!win) return false;
   41|  for (const t of allTrips) {
   42|    if (t.id === candidateTrip.id) continue;
   43|    if (t.vehicle_id !== vehicleId) continue;
   44|    if (t.status !== 'in_transit') continue;
   45|    const other = tripTimeWindowMinutes(t);
   46|    if (!other) continue;
   47|    if (rangesOverlap(win, other)) return true;
   48|  }
   49|  return false;
   50|}
   51|
   52|const ACTIVE = ACTIVE_TRIP_STATUSES as readonly string[];
   53|
   54|export function isDriverBusyFromTrips(driverId: number, trips: DispatchTrip[]): boolean {
   55|  return trips.some(
   56|    (t) => t.driver_id === driverId && t.status != null && ACTIVE.includes(t.status),
   57|  );
   58|}
   59|
   60|export function isVehicleBusyFromTrips(vehicleId: number, trips: DispatchTrip[]): boolean {
   61|  return trips.some(
   62|    (t) => t.vehicle_id === vehicleId && t.status != null && ACTIVE.includes(t.status),
   63|  );
   64|}

   70|function getInitials(value?: string): string {
   71|  const parts = (value ?? '').trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
   72|  if (parts.length === 0) return 'D';
   73|  if (parts.length === 1) return parts[0].slice(0, 1).toUpperCase();

   76|
   77|function parseHourMinute(value?: string | null): number | null {
   78|  if (!value) return null;
   79|  const matched = String(value).match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})/);
   80|  if (matched) {
   81|    const hour = Number(matched[1]);
   82|    const minute = Number(matched[2]);
   83|    return Number.isFinite(hour) && Number.isFinite(minute) ? hour + minute / 60 : null;
   84|  }
   85|
   86|  const parsed = dayjs(value);
   87|  if (!parsed.isValid()) return null;
   88|  return parsed.hour() + parsed.minute() / 60;
   89|}
   90|
   91|function getTripWindow(trip: DispatchTrip, index: number) {
   92|  const fallbackStart = START_HOUR + index * 0.85;
   93|  const start = parseHourMinute(trip.scheduled_time_from) ?? fallbackStart;
   94|  const end = parseHourMinute(trip.scheduled_time_to) ?? start + 1.35;
   95|  const safeStart = Math.max(START_HOUR, Math.min(start, END_HOUR - 0.5));
   96|  const safeEnd = Math.max(safeStart + 0.5, Math.min(end, END_HOUR + 1));
   97|  const left = ((safeStart - START_HOUR) / (END_HOUR - START_HOUR)) * 100;
   98|  const width = Math.max(((safeEnd - safeStart) / (END_HOUR - START_HOUR)) * 100, 7.5);
   99|  return {
  100|    left: Math.min(Math.max(left, 0), 100),
  101|    width: Math.min(width, 100),
  102|  };

   26|function normalizeUnassignedPayload(data: unknown): DispatchTrip[] {
   27|  if (data == null) return [];
   28|  if (Array.isArray(data)) return data as DispatchTrip[];
   29|  if (typeof data === 'object' && data !== null && 'data' in data) {
   30|    const inner = (data as { data: unknown }).data;
   31|    if (Array.isArray(inner)) return inner as DispatchTrip[];
   32|    if (inner && typeof inner === 'object' && inner !== null && 'data' in inner) {
   33|      const nested = (inner as { data: unknown }).data;
   34|      if (Array.isArray(nested)) return nested as DispatchTrip[];
   35|    }
   36|  }
   37|  return [];

   77|function vehicleBucket(vehicle: DispatchVehicle, allTrips: DispatchTrip[]): ResourceBucket {
   78|  const status = normalizeVehicleStatus(vehicle.status);
   79|  if (MAINTENANCE_VEHICLE_STATUSES.includes(status as (typeof MAINTENANCE_VEHICLE_STATUSES)[number])) {
   80|    return 'offline';
   81|  }
   82|  if (isVehicleBusyFromTrips(vehicle.id, allTrips)) {
   83|    return 'busy';
   84|  }
   85|  return 'available';
   86|}
   87|
   88|function driverBucket(driver: DispatchBoardDriver, allTrips: DispatchTrip[]): ResourceBucket {
   89|  const status = String(driver.status ?? '').toLowerCase();
   90|  if (status === 'inactive' || status === 'on_leave' || status === 'off') return 'offline';
   91|  if (isDriverBusyFromTrips(driver.id, allTrips)) return 'busy';
   92|  return 'available';

    1|import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
    2|import { Button, DatePicker, Form, Input, Modal, Select, Space, Switch } from 'antd';
    3|import type { Dayjs } from 'dayjs';
    4|import { useAppFeedback } from '@/hooks/useAppFeedback';
    5|import type { Office, WorkScheduleTemplate } from '@/types';
    6|import workScheduleService from '@/services/work-schedule.service';
    7|import { useTranslation } from '@/hooks/useTranslation';
    8|import { getErrorMessage } from '@/utils/errorHandler';
    9|
   10|const { RangePicker } = DatePicker;
   11|
   12|export interface ApplyScheduleModalProps {
   13|  open: boolean;
   14|  onClose: () => void;
   15|  offices: Office[];
   16|  companyIdForTemplates: number | null;
   17|  onSuccess?: () => void;
   18|}
   19|
   20|type FormValues = {
   21|  office_id: number;
   22|  schedule_id: number;
   23|  range: [Dayjs, Dayjs];
   24|  notes?: string;
   25|  replace_drafts: boolean;
   26|};
   27|
   28|export function ApplyScheduleModal({ open, onClose, offices, companyIdForTemplates, onSuccess }: ApplyScheduleModalProps) {
   29|  const { t } = useTranslation();
   30|  const feedback = useAppFeedback();
   31|  const [form] = Form.useForm<FormValues>();
   32|  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
   33|  const [loadingTemplates, setLoadingTemplates] = useState(false);
   34|  const [templates, setTemplates] = useState<WorkScheduleTemplate[]>([]);
   35|
   36|  const loadTemplates = useCallback(async () => {
   37|    if (companyIdForTemplates == null) {
   38|      setTemplates([]);
   39|      return;
   40|    }
   41|    setLoadingTemplates(true);
   42|    try {
   43|      const rows = await workScheduleService.listTemplates(companyIdForTemplates);
   44|      setTemplates(rows);
   45|    } catch {
   46|      feedback.error(t('drivers.applyScheduleLoadTemplatesError'));
   47|      setTemplates([]);
   48|    } finally {
   49|      setLoadingTemplates(false);
   50|    }
   51|  }, [companyIdForTemplates, t, feedback]);
   52|
   53|  useEffect(() => {
   54|    if (!open) return;
   55|    form.resetFields();
   56|    form.setFieldsValue({ replace_drafts: true });
   57|    void loadTemplates();
   58|  }, [open, loadTemplates, form]);
   59|
   60|  const submit = async () => {
   61|    try {
   62|      const values = await form.validateFields();
   63|      setLoading(true);
   64|      const payload = {
   65|        schedule_id: values.schedule_id,
   66|        start_date: values.range[0].format('YYYY-MM-DD'),
   67|        end_date: values.range[1].format('YYYY-MM-DD'),
   68|        notes: values.notes?.trim() || undefined,
   69|        replace_drafts: values.replace_drafts ?? true,
   70|      };
   71|      const data = await workScheduleService.applyToOffice(values.office_id, payload);
   72|      if (data?.success) {
   73|        if (data.data?.queued) {
   74|          feedback.success({
   75|            message: t('drivers.applyScheduleQueued', {
   76|              rows: String(data.data.estimated_rows ?? ''),
   77|            }),
   78|            duration: 8,
   79|          });
   80|        } else {
   81|          feedback.success(
   82|            t('drivers.applyScheduleSuccess', {
   83|              rows: String(data.data?.rows_created ?? 0),
   84|              drivers: String(data.data?.drivers_count ?? 0),
   85|            }),
   86|          );
   87|        }
   88|        onSuccess?.();
   89|        onClose();
   90|      } else {
   91|        feedback.error(data?.message ?? t('drivers.applyScheduleFailed'));
   92|      }
   93|    } catch (e: unknown) {
   94|      feedback.error(getErrorMessage(e) || t('drivers.applyScheduleFailed'));
   95|    } finally {
   96|      setLoading(false);
   97|    }
   98|  };
   99|
  100|  return (
  101|    <Modal
  102|      title={t('drivers.applyScheduleModalTitle')}
  103|      open={open}
  104|      onCancel={onClose}
  105|      footer={
  106|        <Space>
  107|          <Button onClick={onClose}>{t('common.cancel')}</Button>
  108|          <Button type="primary" loading={loading} onClick={() => void submit()}>
  109|            {t('drivers.applyScheduleSubmit')}
  110|          </Button>
  111|        </Space>
  112|      }
  113|      destroyOnHidden
  114|      width={560}
  115|    >
  116|      <Form name="apply-schedule-form" form={form} layout="vertical" initialValues={{ replace_drafts: true }}>
  117|        <Form.Item
  118|          name="office_id"
  119|          label={t('offices.title')}
  120|          rules={[{ required: true, message: t('drivers.applyScheduleOfficeRequired') }]}
  121|        >
  122|          <Select
  123|            showSearch
  124|            optionFilterProp="label"
  125|            placeholder={t('offices.title')}
  126|            options={offices.map((o) => ({
  127|              value: Number(o.id),
  128|              label: `${o.code ? `${o.code} — ` : ''}${o.name ?? `#${o.id}`}`,
  129|            }))}
  130|          />
  131|        </Form.Item>
  132|        <Form.Item
  133|          name="schedule_id"
  134|          label={t('drivers.applyScheduleTemplateLabel')}
  135|          rules={[{ required: true, message: t('drivers.applyScheduleTemplateRequired') }]}
  136|        >
  137|          <Select
  138|            loading={loadingTemplates}
  139|            showSearch
  140|            optionFilterProp="label"
  141|            placeholder={t('drivers.applyScheduleTemplateLabel')}
  142|            options={templates.map((row) => ({
  143|              value: row.id,
  144|              label: `${row.name} (${row.shift_code} ${String(row.start_time).slice(0, 5)}–${String(row.end_time).slice(0, 5)})`,
  145|            }))}
  146|          />
  147|        </Form.Item>
  148|        <Form.Item

   22|    submitted: 'Đã nộp',
   23|    approved: 'Đã duyệt',

   26|  };

   36|  { label: 'Ca sáng (morning)', value: 'morning' },
   37|  { label: 'Ca chiều (afternoon)', value: 'afternoon' },
   38|  { label: 'Tuỳ chỉnh (custom)', value: 'custom' },
   39|];
   40|
   41|export function toFiniteNumber(v: unknown): number | undefined {
   42|  if (v == null || v === '') return undefined;
   43|  const n = Number(v);
   44|  return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : undefined;
   45|}
   46|
   47|export function driverOfficeId(d: Driver): number | undefined {
   48|  const row = d as unknown as Record<string, unknown>;
   49|  const top = toFiniteNumber(row.office_id);
   50|  if (top != null) return top;
   51|  const emp = d.employee as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   52|  if (!emp) return undefined;
   53|  const fromFlat = toFiniteNumber(emp.office_id ?? emp.officeId);
   54|  if (fromFlat != null) return fromFlat;
   55|  const office = emp.office as { id?: unknown } | undefined;
   56|  return toFiniteNumber(office?.id);
   57|}

   27|const useLicenseCheckUnique = () => {
   28|  const timerRef = React.useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
   29|  React.useEffect(() => () => { if (timerRef.current) clearTimeout(timerRef.current); }, []);
   30|  return useCallback((licenseNo: string, currentId?: number) =>
   31|    new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => {
   32|      if (timerRef.current) clearTimeout(timerRef.current);
   33|      timerRef.current = setTimeout(async () => {
   34|        try {
   35|          const res = await api.get('/drivers', { params: { license_no: licenseNo, per_page: 5 } });
   36|          const data = (res.data?.data?.data ?? res.data?.data ?? []) as Array<{ id: number; license_no?: string }>;
   37|          const conflict = Array.isArray(data) && data.some((d) => (d.license_no ?? '').toUpperCase() === licenseNo.toUpperCase() && d.id !== currentId);
   38|          resolve(!conflict);
   39|        } catch {
   40|          resolve(true);
   41|        }
   42|      }, 400);
   43|    }), []);

   35|
   36|const urlFromDriverUploadList = (files?: UploadFile[]): string | undefined => {
   37|  if (!files?.length) {
   38|    return undefined;
   39|  }
   40|  const f = files[0];
   41|  const fromResponse = f.response as { data?: { url?: string } } | undefined;
   42|  const url = fromResponse?.data?.url ?? f.url;
   43|  return typeof url === 'string' && url.trim() ? url.trim() : undefined;
   44|};
   45|
   46|const mergeDriverUploadsIntoPayload = (
   47|  values: DriverFormSubmitValues,
   48|  isEdit: boolean,
   49|): Record<string, unknown> => {
   50|  const { id_card_front, id_card_back, insurance_doc, ...rest } = values;
   51|  const payload: Record<string, unknown> = { ...rest };
   52|
   53|  mergeVnAddressIntoPayload(payload, values as Record<string, unknown>, '', 'permanent_address');
   54|
   55|  const setUrl = (key: 'id_card_front_url' | 'id_card_back_url' | 'insurance_doc_url', files?: UploadFile[]) => {
   56|    if (files === undefined) {
   57|      return;
   58|    }

   60|    if (next !== undefined) {

   74|// ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   75|
   76|function computeDates(from: Dayjs, to: Dayjs, selectedDays: number[]): string[] {
   77|  const result: string[] = [];
   78|  const daySet = new Set(selectedDays);
   79|  let cursor = from.startOf('day');
   80|  const end = to.endOf('day');
   81|  while (!cursor.isAfter(end)) {
   82|    if (daySet.has(cursor.day())) result.push(cursor.format('YYYY-MM-DD'));
   83|    cursor = cursor.add(1, 'day');
   84|  }
   85|  return result;
   86|}

  233|    let failed  = 0;
  234|    const BATCH = 10;
  235|
  236|    for (let i = 0; i < tasks.length; i += BATCH) {
  237|      const batch = tasks.slice(i, i + BATCH);
  238|      const results = await Promise.allSettled(
  239|        batch.map((task) => workforceOpsService.createDriverSchedule(task)),
  240|      );
  241|      results.forEach((r) => (r.status === 'fulfilled' ? success++ : failed++));
  242|      setSubmitProgress(Math.min(i + BATCH, tasks.length));
  243|    }
  244|
  245|    setSubmitting(false);
  246|    setResultSummary({ success, failed });
  247|
  248|    if (failed === 0) feedback.success(`Tạo thành công ${success} lịch công tác`);
  249|    else feedback.error(`${success} thành công · ${failed} thất bại`);
  250|  }, [dateRange, dates, groups, selectedDriverCount, feedback]);
  251|
  252|  // ── Options ──
  253|  const officeOptions = useMemo(
  254|    () => offices.map((o) => ({ label: `${o.name}${o.code ? ` (${o.code})` : ''}`, value: o.id })),
  255|    [offices],
  256|  );
  257|
  258|  // ── Render ──
  259|  return (

  261|      <PageHeader

  264|        breadcrumb={[
  265|          { label: t('dashboard.title'), path: ROUTES.dashboard },
  266|          { label: t('drivers.scheduleTitle'), path: ROUTES.admin.driversSchedule },
  267|          { label: 'Tạo lịch theo lô' },
  268|        ]}
  269|      />
  270|
  271|      <Flex vertical gap={16}>
  272|        {officesError || driversError ? (
  273|          <ErrorState
  274|            title={t('common.loadError')}
  275|            description={t('common.tryAgainDescription')}
  276|            onRetry={() => {
  277|              void refetchOffices();
  278|              void refetchDrivers();
  279|            }}
  280|          />
  281|        ) : null}
  282|        {(officesLoading || driversLoading) ? (
  283|          <Card><Typography.Text type="secondary">{t('common.loading')}</Typography.Text></Card>
  284|        ) : null}
  285|
  286|        {/* ── Step 1: Time config ──────────────────────────────────── */}
  287|        <Card title="Bước 1 — Cấu hình thời gian & chi nhánh">
  288|          <Row gutter={[16, 16]}>
  289|            <Col xs={24} sm={12} lg={8}>
  290|              <Typography.Text strong style={{ display: 'block', marginBottom: 6 }}>
  291|                Chi nhánh <Typography.Text type="danger">*</Typography.Text>
  292|              </Typography.Text>
  293|              <Select
  294|                showSearch
  295|                optionFilterProp="label"
  296|                placeholder="Chọn chi nhánh"
  297|                options={officeOptions}
  298|                value={selectedOfficeId ?? undefined}
  299|                onChange={(v) => { setSelectedOfficeId(v as number); setResultSummary(null); }}
  300|                style={{ width: '100%' }}
  301|              />
  302|            </Col>
  303|
  304|            <Col xs={24} sm={12} lg={10}>
  305|              <Typography.Text strong style={{ display: 'block', marginBottom: 6 }}>
  306|                Khoảng thời gian <Typography.Text type="danger">*</Typography.Text>

  312|                style={{ width: '100%' }}

  314|            </Col>
  315|
  316|            <Col xs={24}>
  317|              <Typography.Text strong style={{ display: 'block', marginBottom: 8 }}>
  318|                Áp dụng các ngày trong tuần
  319|              </Typography.Text>
  320|              <Space wrap>
  321|                {WEEK_DAYS.map(({ label, value }) => (

  325|                    onChange={(e) => {

  328|                      );

  519|      </Flex>

   10|
   11|export function scheduleStatusColor(status: string): string {
   12|  switch (status) {
   13|    case 'approved': return 'success';
   14|    case 'rejected': return 'error';
   15|    case 'locked': return 'purple';
   16|    case 'submitted': return 'processing';
   17|    default: return 'default';
   18|  }
   19|}
   20|
   21|export function scheduleStatusLabel(status: string): string {
   22|  const map: Record<string, string> = {
   23|    draft: 'Nháp',
   24|    submitted: 'Đã gửi',
   25|    approved: 'Đã duyệt',
   26|    rejected: 'Từ chối',
   27|    locked: 'Đã khóa',
   28|  };
   29|  return map[status] ?? status;
   30|}

   24|export function InvoiceFormDialog({ open, mode, recordId, onClose, onSuccess }: InvoiceFormDialogProps = {}) {
   25|  const { t } = useTranslation();
   26|  const { form, resolvedId, hasRecordId, isViewMode, isEdit, dialogOpen, handleClose } = useFormDialogBase({
   27|    open, mode, recordId, resource: 'invoices', onClose,
   28|  });
   29|
   30|  const { data, isLoading: isLoadingData } = useOne<Invoice>({
   31|    resource: 'invoices',
   32|    id: resolvedId || '',
   33|    queryOptions: { enabled: hasRecordId },
   34|  });
   35|
   36|  const { mutate: createItem, isLoading: isCreating } = useCreate<Invoice>();
   37|  const { mutate: updateItem, isLoading: isUpdating } = useUpdate<Invoice>();
   38|  const isLoading = isCreating || isUpdating || (hasRecordId && isLoadingData);
   39|
   40|  const { requestClose, handleDialogOpenChange, unsavedChangesWarningProps } = useFormDialogCloseGuard({
   41|    form,
   42|    isViewMode,
   43|    isSubmitting: isLoading,
   44|    onClose: handleClose,
   45|  });
   46|
   47|  const amountsLocked = data?.data?.reconciliation_session?.status === 'locked';
   48|
   49|  const handleSubmit = (values: Partial<Invoice> & { trip_id?: number | null }) => {
   50|    if (amountsLocked) {
   51|      toast.error(t('invoices.r07LockedAmounts'));
   52|      return;
   53|    }
   54|    if (values.issued_at && values.due_date && values.due_date < values.issued_at) {
   55|      toast.error(t('validation.dueDateAfterIssuedAt'));
   56|      return;
   57|    }
   58|
   59|    const normalizedStatus = values.status === 'sent' ? 'issued' : values.status;
   60|    const payload = {
   61|      ...values,
   62|      status: normalizedStatus,
   63|      trip_id: values.trip_id === undefined || values.trip_id === null ? undefined : values.trip_id,
   64|    };
   65|    if (isEdit && resolvedId) {
   66|      updateItem(
   67|        { resource: 'invoices', id: resolvedId, values: payload },
   68|        {
   69|          onSuccess: () => {
   70|            toast.success(t('notifications.updateSuccess', { item: t('invoices.title') }));
   71|            onSuccess?.();
   72|            handleClose();
   73|          },
   74|          onError: (error) => {
   75|            if (!shouldShowLocalErrorToast(error)) return;
   76|            toast.error(getErrorMessage(error) || t('notifications.updateError', { item: t('invoices.title') }));
   77|          },
   78|        }
   79|      );
   80|    } else {
   81|      createItem(
   82|        { resource: 'invoices', values: payload },
   83|        {

   85|            toast.success(t('notifications.createSuccess', { item: t('invoices.title') }));
   86|            onSuccess?.();
   87|            handleClose();
   88|          },

   90|            if (!shouldShowLocalErrorToast(error)) return;

   92|          },

   16|export function CreateOvertimeModal({ open, onClose, onSuccess }: CreateOvertimeModalProps) {
   17|  const { t } = useTranslation();
   18|  const [form] = Form.useForm();
   19|
   20|  const { selectProps: driverSelectProps } = useSelect<Driver>({
   21|    resource: 'drivers',
   22|    optionLabel: (item) => item.employee?.name ?? item.name ?? `#${item.id}`,
   23|    optionValue: 'id',
   24|    onSearch: (value) => [
   25|      { field: 'name', operator: 'contains', value }
   26|    ],
   27|  });
   28|

   41|          apiErrors.map((e: any) => ({
   42|            name: e.field,
   43|            errors: [e.message],
   44|          }))
   45|        );
   46|      } else {
   47|        antdUtils.getMessage().error(getErrorMessage(err) ?? 'Tạo đơn thất bại');
   48|      }
   49|    }
   50|  }, [onClose, onSuccess, t, form]);
   51|
   52|  return (
   53|    <Modal
   54|      title={t('workforce.createOvertime')}

   48|

   54|        invalidatePayrollQueries();
   55|      } else {
   56|        message.error(res.message || t('notifications.updateError', { item: t('payrolls.title') }));
   57|      }
   58|    },
   59|    onError: () => message.error(t('notifications.updateError', { item: t('payrolls.title') })),
   60|  });
   61|
   62|  const lockMutation = useMutation({
   63|    mutationFn: () => payrollService.lock(payrollId!),
   64|    onSuccess: (res) => {
   65|      if (res.success) {
   66|        message.success(t('notifications.updateSuccess', { item: t('payrolls.title') }));
   67|        invalidatePayrollQueries();
   68|      } else {
   69|        message.error(res.message || t('notifications.updateError', { item: t('payrolls.title') }));
   70|      }
   71|    },
   72|    onError: () => message.error(t('notifications.updateError', { item: t('payrolls.title') })),
   73|  });
   74|
   75|  const markPaidMutation = useMutation({
   76|    mutationFn: () => payrollService.markPaid(payrollId!),
   77|    onSuccess: (res) => {
   78|      if (res.success) {
   79|        message.success(t('notifications.updateSuccess', { item: t('payrolls.title') }));
   80|        invalidatePayrollQueries();
   81|      } else {
   82|        message.error(res.message || t('notifications.updateError', { item: t('payrolls.title') }));
   83|      }
   84|    },
   85|    onError: () => message.error(t('notifications.updateError', { item: t('payrolls.title') })),
   86|  });
   87|
   88|  const mergedLine = useMemo(() => {

  107|        return t('payrolls.statusApproved');
  108|      case 'locked':
  109|        return t('payrolls.statusLocked');

  118|  const showLock = canManagePayroll && payrollStatusKey === 'approved';
  119|  const showMarkPaid = canManagePayroll && payrollStatusKey === 'locked';
  120|

  122|
  123|  const tripColumns: ColumnsType<PayrollTripAttribution> = [

   19|const useCompanyCodeCheckUnique = () => {
   20|  const timerRef = React.useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
   21|  React.useEffect(() => () => { if (timerRef.current) clearTimeout(timerRef.current); }, []);
   22|  return (endpoint: string, code: string, currentId?: number) =>
   23|    new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => {
   24|      if (timerRef.current) clearTimeout(timerRef.current);
   25|      timerRef.current = setTimeout(async () => {
   26|        try {
   27|          const res = await api.get(endpoint, {
   28|            params: { code, per_page: 5 },
   29|            skipErrorToast: true,
   30|          } as Parameters<typeof api.get>[1]);
   31|          const list = (res.data as { data?: { data?: Array<{ id: number; code?: string }> } }).data?.data ?? [];
   32|          const dup = list.find(
   33|            (row) => row.code?.trim().toLowerCase() === code.trim().toLowerCase() && row.id !== currentId,
   34|          );
   35|          resolve(!dup);
   36|        } catch {
   37|          resolve(true);
   38|        }
   39|      }, 350);
   40|    });
   41|};

   43|export function CompanySettingsPage() {

   51|  const { modal, message } = App.useApp();
   52|

   57|    resource: resourceName,
   58|    id: currentTenantId ?? 0,
   59|    queryOptions: { enabled: currentTenantId != null },
   60|  });
   61|
   62|  const company = data?.data;
   63|  const detailStatus = (detailError as { statusCode?: number; status?: number })?.statusCode ?? (detailError as { status?: number })?.status;
   64|
   65|  const { mutateAsync: update, isLoading: saving } = useUpdate<Company>();
   66|
   67|  useEffect(() => {
   68|    if (company && editing) {
   69|      form.setFieldsValue({
   70|        name: company.name,
   71|        code: company.code,
   72|        tax_code: company.tax_code,
   73|        address: company.address,
   74|        phone: company.phone,
   75|        email: company.email,
   76|        status: company.status,
   77|      });
   78|    }

   82|    if (!company) return;
   83|    try {
   84|      const previousStatus = company.status;
   85|      const nextStatus = (vals as { status?: string }).status;
   86|      await update({ resource: resourceName, id: company.id, values: vals });
   87|      message.success(t('companies.companyUpdated'));
   88|      if (nextStatus && nextStatus !== previousStatus) {
   89|        recordAuditIntent({
   90|          resource: 'companies',
   91|          kind: nextStatus === 'inactive' ? 'lock' : 'update',

   93|          meta: { from: previousStatus, to: nextStatus },
   94|        });
   95|      }
   96|      setEditing(false);

  108|      okText: 'Xác nhận',
  109|      cancelText: 'Hủy',

===== FILE: src/pages/settings/tabs/SimpleCategoryTab.tsx =====
    1|import { useCallback, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
    2|import { App, Button, Checkbox, Flex, Form, Input, InputNumber, Modal, Popconfirm, Result, Space, Table, TableProps, Tag } from 'antd';
    3|import { ArrowDownOutlined, ArrowUpOutlined, DeleteOutlined, EditOutlined, PlusOutlined } from '@ant-design/icons';
    4|import { useCreate, useDelete, useList, useUpdate } from '@refinedev/core';
    5|import { useTranslation } from '@/hooks/useTranslation';
    6|import { getErrorMessage, shouldShowLocalErrorToast } from '@/utils/errorHandler';
    7|import api from '@/services/api';
    8|
    9|export interface SimpleCategoryItem {
   10|  id: number;
   11|  code?: string;
   12|  name: string;
   13|  sort_order?: number;
   14|  description?: string;
   15|  is_active?: boolean;
   16|}
   17|
   18|export interface SimpleCategoryTabProps {
   19|  resource: string;
   20|  itemLabel: string;
   21|  extraFields?: { name: string; label: string; type?: 'text' | 'number'; placeholder?: string }[];
   22|  extraColumns?: TableProps<SimpleCategoryItem>['columns'];
   23|}
   24|
   25|export function SimpleCategoryTab({
   26|  resource,
   27|  itemLabel,
   28|  extraFields = [],
   29|  extraColumns = [],
   30|}: SimpleCategoryTabProps) {
   31|  const { t } = useTranslation();
   32|  const { message } = App.useApp();
   33|  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
   34|  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<SimpleCategoryItem | null>(null);
   35|  const [form] = Form.useForm();
   36|  const codeCheckTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
   37|
   38|  const { data, isLoading, error, refetch } = useList<SimpleCategoryItem>({
   39|    resource,
   40|    pagination: { current: 1, pageSize: 20 }, // Issue #5: Enable pagination
   41|    sorters: [{ field: 'sort_order', order: 'asc' }],
   42|  });
   43|  const list = data?.data ?? [];
   44|  const errorStatus = (error as { statusCode?: number; status?: number })?.statusCode ?? (error as { status?: number })?.status;
   45|
   46|  const { mutateAsync: create } = useCreate<SimpleCategoryItem>();
   47|  const { mutateAsync: update } = useUpdate<SimpleCategoryItem>({
   48|    mutationMode: 'optimistic', // Issue #6
   49|  });
   50|  const { mutateAsync: deleteOne } = useDelete<SimpleCategoryItem>();
   51|
   52|  const checkCodeUnique = useCallback(
   53|    async (code: string): Promise<boolean> => {
   54|      return new Promise((resolve) => {
   55|        if (codeCheckTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(codeCheckTimerRef.current);
   56|        codeCheckTimerRef.current = setTimeout(async () => {
   57|          try {
   58|            const res = await api.get(`/${resource}`, {
   59|              params: { code, per_page: 5 },
   60|              skipErrorToast: true,
   61|            } as Parameters<typeof api.get>[1]);
   62|            const rows = (res.data as { data?: { data?: Array<{ id: number; code?: string }> } }).data?.data ?? [];
   63|            const dup = rows.find(
   64|              (row) => row.code?.trim().toLowerCase() === code.trim().toLowerCase() && row.id !== editing?.id,
   65|            );
   66|            resolve(!dup);
   67|          } catch {
   68|            resolve(true);
   69|          }
   70|        }, 400);
   71|      });
   72|    },
   73|    [resource, editing],
   74|  );
   75|
   76|  const openCreate = useCallback(() => {
   77|    setEditing(null);
   78|    form.resetFields();
   79|    setOpen(true);
   80|  }, [form]);
   81|
   82|  const openEdit = useCallback(
   83|    (r: SimpleCategoryItem) => {
   84|      setEditing(r);
   85|      form.setFieldsValue(r);
   86|      setOpen(true);
   87|    },
   88|    [form],
   89|  );
   90|
   91|  const handleSubmit = useCallback(
   92|    async (vals: Record<string, unknown>) => {
   93|      try {
   94|        if (editing) {
   95|          await update({ resource, id: editing.id, values: vals });
   96|        } else {
   97|          const codeValue = (vals as { code?: string }).code?.trim();
   98|          if (codeValue) {
   99|            const exists = list.some((row) => row.code?.trim().toLowerCase() === codeValue.toLowerCase());
  100|            if (exists) {
  101|              message.error('Mã đã tồn tại');
  102|              return;
  103|            }
  104|          }
  105|          await create({ resource, values: vals });
  106|        }
  107|        message.success(t('messages.saveSuccess'));
  108|        setOpen(false);
  109|        void refetch();
  110|      } catch (err) {
  111|        if (!shouldShowLocalErrorToast(err)) return;
  112|        message.error(getErrorMessage(err) ?? t('messages.saveError'));
  113|      }
  114|    },
  115|    [editing, update, create, resource, list, message, t, refetch],
  116|  );
  117|
  118|  const moveSort = useCallback(
  119|    async (row: SimpleCategoryItem, direction: 'up' | 'down') => {
  120|      const sorted = [...list].sort((a, b) => (a.sort_order ?? 0) - (b.sort_order ?? 0));
  121|      const idx = sorted.findIndex((r) => r.id === row.id);
  122|      const swapWith = direction === 'up' ? sorted[idx - 1] : sorted[idx + 1];
  123|      if (!swapWith) return;
  124|      try {
  125|        await Promise.all([
  126|          update({ resource, id: row.id, values: { sort_order: swapWith.sort_order ?? idx } }),
  127|          update({ resource, id: swapWith.id, values: { sort_order: row.sort_order ?? idx } }),
  128|        ]);
  129|        void refetch();
  130|      } catch {
  131|        // silent
  132|      }
  133|    },
  134|    [list, update, resource, refetch],
  135|  );
  136|
  137|  const handleDelete = useCallback(
  138|    async (row: SimpleCategoryItem) => {
  139|      try {
  140|        await deleteOne({ resource, id: row.id });
  141|        message.success(t('messages.deleteSuccess'));
  142|      } catch (err) {
  143|        try {
  144|          await update({ resource, id: row.id, values: { is_active: false, status: 'archived' } });
  145|          message.success('Đã lưu trữ');
  146|        } catch {
  147|          if (!shouldShowLocalErrorToast(err)) return;
  148|          message.error(getErrorMessage(err) ?? t('messages.deleteError'));
  149|        }
  150|      }
  151|      void refetch();
  152|    },
  153|    [deleteOne, update, resource, t, message, refetch],
  154|  );
  155|
  156|  const columns = useMemo<TableProps<SimpleCategoryItem>['columns']>(
  157|    () => [
  158|      { key: 'code', title: 'Mã', dataIndex: 'code', width: 120, render: (v?: string) => v ?? '—' },
  159|      { key: 'name', title: `Tên ${itemLabel}`, dataIndex: 'name' },
  160|      { key: 'sort_order', title: 'Thứ tự', dataIndex: 'sort_order', width: 90, render: (v?: number) => v ?? '—' },
  161|      ...(extraColumns ?? []),
  162|      {
  163|        key: 'is_active',
  164|        title: t('common.status'),
  165|        width: 100,
  166|        render: (_, r) =>
  167|          r.is_active !== false ? (
  168|            <Tag color="success">{t('common.active')}</Tag>
  169|          ) : (
  170|            <Tag color="default">{t('common.inactive')}</Tag>
  171|          ),

   27|

   19|export function ActionConfirmModal({ state, onClose }: { state: ActionConfirmState; onClose: () => void }) {
   20|  const { t } = useTranslation();
   21|  const [reason, setReason] = useState('');

  138|const DATE_FIELDS = new Set(['from_date', 'to_date', 'work_date', 'date']);
  139|
  140|function formatDetailValue(key: string, value: unknown, colorMap?: Record<string, string>) {
  141|  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') return '-';
  142|  if (STATUS_FIELDS.has(key)) {
  143|    return colorMap ? <StatusTag value={String(value)} colorMap={colorMap} /> : <Tag>{formatStatusLabel(value)}</Tag>;
  144|  }
  145|  if (MONEY_FIELDS.has(key)) return formatMoney(value);
  146|  if (DATETIME_FIELDS.has(key)) return formatDateTime(value);
  147|  if (DATE_FIELDS.has(key)) return formatDate(value);
  148|  if (typeof value === 'object') return JSON.stringify(value);
  149|  return String(value);
  150|}
  151|
  152|export function DetailDescriptions({ kind, data }: { kind: DetailKind; data: Record<string, unknown> }) {
  153|  const { t } = useTranslation();
  154|  const labels = DETAIL_LABELS[kind];
  155|  const colorMap =
  156|    kind === 'leave'
  157|      ? LEAVE_STATUS_COLOR
  158|      : kind === 'overtime'
  159|        ? OT_STATUS_COLOR
  160|        : kind === 'violations'
  161|          ? VIOLATION_STATUS_COLOR
  162|          : ATTENDANCE_STATUS_COLOR;
  163|
  164|  const orderedKeys = Object.keys(labels).filter((k) => data[k] !== null && data[k] !== undefined && data[k] !== '');
  165|
  166|  return (
  167|    <Descriptions column={1} size="small" bordered>
  168|      {orderedKeys.map((key) => (
  169|        <Descriptions.Item key={key} label={t((labels[key] ?? key) as never)}>
  170|          {formatDetailValue(key, data[key], STATUS_FIELDS.has(key) ? colorMap : undefined)}
  171|        </Descriptions.Item>
  172|      ))}
  173|    </Descriptions>
  174|  );

===== FILE: src/pages/trips/components/StatusTimeline.tsx =====
    1|import { Tag, Timeline, Typography } from 'antd';
    2|import type { TripStatusHistory } from '@/types';
    3|import { useTranslation } from '@/hooks/useTranslation';
    4|import { formatDateTime } from '@/utils/displayFormat';
    5|import { getTripStatusDisplay } from '@/utils/tripStatus';
    6|
    7|export interface StatusTimelineProps {
    8|  histories: TripStatusHistory[] | undefined;
    9|}
   10|
   11|export function StatusTimeline({ histories }: StatusTimelineProps) {
   12|  const { t } = useTranslation();
   13|  const rows = [...(histories ?? [])].sort(
   14|    (a, b) => new Date(a.changed_at).getTime() - new Date(b.changed_at).getTime(),
   15|  );
   16|
   17|  if (rows.length === 0) {
   18|    return <Typography.Text type="secondary">Chưa có lịch sử trạng thái (trip_status_histories).</Typography.Text>;
   19|  }
   20|
   21|  return (
   22|    <Timeline
   23|      mode="left"
   24|      items={rows.map((h) => {
   25|        const fromDisplay = h.from_status ? getTripStatusDisplay(h.from_status, t) : null;
   26|        const toDisplay = getTripStatusDisplay(h.to_status, t);
   27|        return {
   28|          color: 'blue',
   29|          children: (
   30|            <div className="space-y-1">
   31|              <div className="text-xs text-slate-500">{formatDateTime(h.changed_at)}</div>
   32|              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
   33|                {fromDisplay ? (
   34|                  <Tag color={fromDisplay.color}>{fromDisplay.label}</Tag>
   35|                ) : (
   36|                  <Typography.Text type="secondary">—</Typography.Text>
   37|                )}
   38|                <span>→</span>
   39|                <Tag color={toDisplay.color}>{toDisplay.label}</Tag>
   40|              </div>
   41|              {h.note ? <Typography.Text className="text-xs">{h.note}</Typography.Text> : null}
   42|            </div>
   43|          ),
   44|        };
   45|      })}
   46|    />
   47|  );
   48|}
   49|

===== FILE: src/pages/trips/trip-revenue.ts =====
    1|import type { Trip, TripSurcharge } from '@/types';
    2|
    3|export function sumTripSurchargesAmounts(surcharges: TripSurcharge[] | undefined): number {
    4|  return (surcharges ?? []).reduce((acc, row) => acc + Number(row.amount ?? 0), 0);
    5|}
    6|
    7|/** R10: total_revenue = base_price + SUM(trip_surcharges.amount) */
    8|export function computeTripRevenueR10(
    9|  trip: Pick<Trip, 'base_price' | 'price'> & { trip_surcharges?: TripSurcharge[] },
   10|): number {
   11|  const base = Number(trip.base_price ?? trip.price ?? 0);
   12|  return base + sumTripSurchargesAmounts(trip.trip_surcharges);
   13|}

   50|  return null;
   51|};

   55|    return undefined;

   58|  return s === '' ? undefined : s;

    1|import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
    2|import { Alert, App, Button, Card, Checkbox, Empty, Flex, Space, Spin, Table, Tag, Typography } from 'antd';

    6|import api from '@/services/api';
