    8|import { getErrorMessage } from '@/utils/errorHandler';
    9|
   10|interface PermissionMatrix {
   11|  modules: Array<{ key: string; label: string }>;
   12|  actions: Array<{ key: string; label: string }>;
   13|  granted?: Record<string, string[]>;
   14|}
   15|
   16|const DEFAULT_MODULES = [
   17|  { key: 'trips', label: 'Chuyến' },
   18|  { key: 'customers', label: 'Khách hàng' },
   19|  { key: 'vehicles', label: 'Phương tiện' },
   20|  { key: 'drivers', label: 'Tài xế' },
   21|  { key: 'invoices', label: 'Hóa đơn' },
   22|  { key: 'reports', label: 'Báo cáo' },
   23|  { key: 'settings', label: 'Cấu hình' },
   24|];
   25|
   26|const DEFAULT_ACTIONS = [
   27|  { key: 'view', label: 'Xem' },
   28|  { key: 'create', label: 'Tạo' },
   29|  { key: 'update', label: 'Sửa' },
   30|  { key: 'delete', label: 'Xóa' },
   31|  { key: 'approve', label: 'Duyệt' },
   32|  { key: 'export', label: 'Xuất' },
   33|];
   34|
   35|interface UserPermissionsTabProps {
   36|  userId: number;
   37|  isAdmin?: boolean;
   38|}
   39|
   40|export function UserPermissionsTab({ userId, isAdmin = false }: UserPermissionsTabProps) {
   41|  const [granted, setGranted] = useState<Record<string, Set<string>>>({});
   42|  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
   43|  const { message } = App.useApp();
   44|
   45|  const { data, isLoading, refetch } = useQuery({
   46|    queryKey: ['users', userId, 'permissions'] as const,
   47|    queryFn: async () => {
   48|      try {
   49|        const res = await api.get<{ data: PermissionMatrix }>(ENDPOINTS.users.permissions(userId), {
   50|          skipErrorToast: true,
   51|        } as Parameters<typeof api.get>[1]);
   52|        return res.data?.data ?? null;
   53|      } catch {
   54|        return null;
   55|      }
   56|    },
   57|    enabled: !isAdmin,
   58|  });
   59|
   60|  const modules = data?.modules ?? DEFAULT_MODULES;
   61|  const actions = data?.actions ?? DEFAULT_ACTIONS;
   62|
   63|  useEffect(() => {
   64|    if (!data) return;
   65|    const map: Record<string, Set<string>> = {};
   66|    Object.entries(data.granted ?? {}).forEach(([module, list]) => {
   67|      const items = Array.isArray(list) ? (list as string[]) : [];
   68|      map[module] = new Set(items);
   69|    });
   70|    setGranted(map);
   71|  }, [data]);
   72|
   73|  const toggle = (module: string, action: string) => {
   74|    setGranted((prev) => {
   75|      const next = { ...prev };
   76|      const current = new Set(next[module] ?? []);
   77|      if (current.has(action)) current.delete(action);
   78|      else current.add(action);
   79|      next[module] = current;
   80|      return next;
   81|    });
   82|  };
   83|
   84|  const handleSave = async () => {
   85|    setSaving(true);
   86|    try {
   87|      const payload: Record<string, string[]> = {};
   88|      Object.entries(granted).forEach(([module, set]) => {
   89|        payload[module] = Array.from(set);
   90|      });
   91|      await api.put(ENDPOINTS.users.permissions(userId), { permissions: payload });
   92|      message.success('Đã cập nhật quyền');
   93|      void refetch();
   94|    } catch (err) {
   95|      message.error(getErrorMessage(err) ?? 'Cập nhật quyền thất bại');
   96|    } finally {
   97|      setSaving(false);
   98|    }
   99|  };
  100|
  101|  const columns = useMemo<ColumnsType<{ key: string; label: string }>>(() => {
  102|    const cols: ColumnsType<{ key: string; label: string }> = [
  103|      {
  104|        title: 'Module',
  105|        dataIndex: 'label',
  106|        key: 'label',
  107|        width: 180,
  108|        render: (v: string) => <Typography.Text strong>{v}</Typography.Text>,
  109|      },
  110|      ...actions.map((action: { key: string; label: string }) => ({
  111|        title: action.label,
  112|        key: action.key,
  113|        align: 'center' as const,
  114|        width: 90,
  115|        render: (_: unknown, row: { key: string; label: string }) => (
  116|          <Checkbox
  117|            checked={granted[row.key]?.has(action.key) ?? false}
  118|            onChange={() => toggle(row.key, action.key)}
  119|          />
  120|        ),
  121|      })),
  122|    ];
  123|    return cols;
  124|  }, [actions, granted]);
  125|
  126|  if (isAdmin) {
  127|    return (
  128|      <Card>
  129|        <Empty
  130|          description={
  131|            <Space direction="vertical">
  132|              <Tag color="success">Toàn quyền</Tag>
  133|              <Typography.Text type="secondary">
  134|                Tài khoản admin/super_admin có toàn quyền hệ thống. Không cần cấu hình ma trận quyền.
  135|              </Typography.Text>
  136|            </Space>
  137|          }
  138|        />
  139|      </Card>
  140|    );
  141|  }
  142|
  143|  if (isLoading) {
  144|    return (
  145|      <Card>
  146|        <Spin />
  147|      </Card>
  148|    );
  149|  }
  150|
  151|  if (!data) {
  152|    return (
  153|      <Card>
  154|        <Alert
  155|          type="warning"
  156|          message="Endpoint phân quyền chưa sẵn sàng"
  157|          description="Khi backend bật /api/users/{id}/permissions, ma trận quyền sẽ tự động hiển thị."
  158|        />
  159|      </Card>
  160|    );
  161|  }
  162|
  163|  return (
  164|    <Space direction="vertical" style={{ width: '100%' }} size={12}>
  165|      <Alert
  166|        type="info"
  167|        message="Cấu hình quyền theo module × hành động"
  168|        description="Bỏ chọn để thu hồi quyền của hành động tương ứng."
  169|      />
  170|      <Table<{ key: string; label: string }>
  171|        rowKey="key"
  172|        columns={columns}
  173|        dataSource={modules}
  174|        pagination={false}
  175|        size="small"
  176|        scroll={{ x: 'max-content' }}
  177|      />
  178|      <Flex justify="flex-end">
  179|        <Button type="primary" loading={saving} onClick={() => void handleSave()}>
  180|          Lưu phân quyền
  181|        </Button>

   17|  return leaveFrom <= ASSIGN_END_OPEN && leaveTo >= assignFrom;

   53|    const history = rows
   54|      .filter((a) => a.to_date != null && a.to_date !== '')
   55|      .sort((a, b) => new Date(b.from_date).getTime() - new Date(a.from_date).getTime());

   84|    },

   87|      message.error(getErrorMessage(error) || t('vehicles.assignDriverError'));

   89|  });

   26|  const timerRef = React.useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
   27|  React.useEffect(() => () => { if (timerRef.current) clearTimeout(timerRef.current); }, []);
   28|  return (plate: string, currentId?: number) =>
   29|    new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => {
   30|      if (timerRef.current) clearTimeout(timerRef.current);
   31|      timerRef.current = setTimeout(async () => {
   32|        try {
   33|          const res = await api.get('/vehicles', { params: { plate_number: plate, per_page: 5 } });
   34|          const data = (res.data?.data?.data ?? res.data?.data ?? []) as Array<{ id: number; plate_number?: string }>;
   35|          const conflict = Array.isArray(data) && data.some((v) => v.plate_number?.toUpperCase() === plate.toUpperCase() && v.id !== currentId);
   36|          resolve(!conflict);
   37|        } catch {
   38|          resolve(true);

   17|interface VehicleFormDialogProps {
   18|  open?: boolean;
   19|  mode?: 'create' | 'edit' | 'show';
   20|  recordId?: number;
   21|  onClose?: () => void;
   22|  onSuccess?: () => void;
   23|}
   24|
   25|type VehicleFormSubmitValues = Partial<Vehicle> & {
   26|  vehicle_photo?: UploadFile[];
   27|};
   28|
   29|const uploadDoneListForVehiclePhoto = (url: string | undefined): UploadFile[] => {
   30|  if (!url?.trim()) {
   31|    return [];
   32|  }
   33|  const name = url.trim().split('/').pop() || 'vehicle';
   34|  return [{ uid: '-vehicle-photo', name, status: 'done', url: url.trim() }];
   35|};
   36|
   37|const imageUrlFromVehiclePhotoFiles = (files?: UploadFile[]): string | null => {
   38|  if (!files?.length) {
   39|    return null;
   40|  }
   41|  const f = files[0];
   42|  const fromResponse = f.response as { data?: { url?: string } } | undefined;
   43|  const url = fromResponse?.data?.url ?? f.url;
   44|  if (typeof url === 'string' && url.trim()) {
   45|    return url.trim();
   46|  }
   47|  return null;
   48|};
   49|
   50|const buildVehiclePayload = (values: VehicleFormSubmitValues, isEdit: boolean): Record<string, unknown> => {
   51|  const { vehicle_photo, ...rest } = values;
   52|  const payload: Record<string, unknown> = { ...rest };
   53|  delete (payload as Record<string, unknown>).vehicle_photo;
   54|
   55|  const prevUrl = typeof rest.image_url === 'string' && rest.image_url.trim() ? rest.image_url.trim() : undefined;
   56|  const nextUrl = imageUrlFromVehiclePhotoFiles(vehicle_photo);
   57|
   58|  if (nextUrl !== null) {
   59|    payload.image_url = nextUrl;
   60|  } else if (isEdit && vehicle_photo !== undefined && (!vehicle_photo || vehicle_photo.length === 0)) {
   61|    payload.image_url = null;
   62|  } else if (prevUrl) {
   63|    payload.image_url = prevUrl;
   64|  } else {
   65|    delete payload.image_url;
   66|  }
   67|
   68|  return payload;
   69|};
   70|
   71|export function VehicleFormDialog({ open, mode, recordId, onClose, onSuccess }: VehicleFormDialogProps = {}) {
   72|  const { t } = useTranslation();
   73|  const feedback = useAppFeedback();
   74|  const { form, resolvedId, hasRecordId, isViewMode, isEdit, dialogOpen, handleClose } = useFormDialogBase({
   75|    open, mode, recordId, resource: 'vehicles', onClose,
   76|  });
   77|
   78|  const { data, isLoading: isLoadingData } = useOne<Vehicle>({
   79|    resource: 'vehicles',
   80|    id: resolvedId || '',
   81|    queryOptions: { enabled: hasRecordId },
   82|  });
   83|
   84|  const { mutate: createItem, isLoading: isCreating } = useCreate<Vehicle>();
   85|  const { mutate: updateItem, isLoading: isUpdating } = useUpdate<Vehicle>();
   86|
   87|  const isLoading = isCreating || isUpdating || (hasRecordId && isLoadingData);
   88|
   89|  const { requestClose, handleDialogOpenChange, unsavedChangesWarningProps } = useFormDialogCloseGuard({
   90|    form,
   91|    isViewMode,
   92|    isSubmitting: isLoading,
   93|    onClose: handleClose,
   94|  });
   95|
   96|  const handleSubmit = (values: VehicleFormSubmitValues) => {
   97|    const payload = buildVehiclePayload(values, isEdit) as Partial<Vehicle>;
   98|
   99|    if (isEdit && resolvedId) {
  100|      updateItem(
  101|        {
  102|          resource: 'vehicles',
  103|          id: resolvedId,
  104|          values: payload,
  105|        },
  106|        {
  107|          onSuccess: () => {
  108|            feedback.success(t('notifications.updateSuccess', { item: t('vehicles.title') }));
  109|            onSuccess?.();
  110|            handleClose();
  111|          },
  112|          onError: (error) => {
  113|            if (!shouldShowLocalErrorToast(error)) {
  114|              return;
  115|            }
  116|
  117|            feedback.error(
  118|              getErrorMessage(error) || t('notifications.updateError', { item: t('vehicles.title') })
  119|            );
  120|          },
  121|        }
  122|      );
  123|    } else {
  124|      createItem(
  125|        {
  126|          resource: 'vehicles',
  127|          values: payload,
  128|        },
  129|        {
  130|          onSuccess: () => {
  131|            feedback.success(t('notifications.createSuccess', { item: t('vehicles.title') }));
  132|            onSuccess?.();
  133|            handleClose();
  134|          },
  135|          onError: (error) => {
  136|            if (!shouldShowLocalErrorToast(error)) {
  137|              return;
  138|            }
  139|
  140|            feedback.error(
  141|              getErrorMessage(error) || t('notifications.createError', { item: t('vehicles.title') })
  142|            );
  143|          },
  144|        }
  145|      );
  146|    }
  147|  };
  148|
  149|  useEffect(() => {

  153|        ...v,
  154|        vehicle_photo: uploadDoneListForVehiclePhoto(v.image_url),
  155|      });
  156|    }
  157|  }, [hasRecordId, data?.data, form]);
  158|

  160|  const description = isViewMode
  161|    ? t('vehicles.editDescription')
  162|    : isEdit
  163|      ? t('vehicles.editDescription')
  164|      : t('vehicles.createDescription');
  165|

  167|    <Space style={{ width: '100%', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
  168|      <Button icon={<ArrowLeftOutlined />} onClick={requestClose}>
  169|        {t('common.back')}
  170|      </Button>
  171|      {!isViewMode ? (
  172|        <Button type="primary" onClick={() => form.submit()} loading={isLoading}>
  173|          {isEdit ? t('common.update') : t('common.create')}

    1|import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
    2|import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    3|import { App, Button, DatePicker, Form, Input, InputNumber, Modal, Select, Space, Table, Tag, Timeline, Typography } from 'antd';
    4|import type { ColumnsType } from 'antd/es/table';
    5|import { CheckCircleOutlined, PlusOutlined, ToolOutlined } from '@ant-design/icons';
    6|import dayjs from 'dayjs';
    7|import vehicleService from '@/services/vehicle.service';
    8|import { useTranslation } from '@/hooks/useTranslation';
    9|import { getErrorMessage, shouldShowLocalErrorToast } from '@/utils/errorHandler';
   10|import type { MaintenanceSchedule } from '@/types';
   11|import { formatDate } from '@/utils/displayFormat';
   12|import { formatCurrencyVND } from '@/utils/format';
   13|
   14|function scheduleNeedsAttention(
   15|  schedule: MaintenanceSchedule,
   16|  vehicleOdometer: number | null | undefined,
   17|): boolean {
   18|  const odom = vehicleOdometer != null ? Number(vehicleOdometer) : null;
   19|  const alertKm = schedule.alert_before_km ?? 0;
   20|  if (schedule.next_due_km != null && odom != null) {
   21|    const due = Number(schedule.next_due_km);
   22|    if (odom >= due) return true;
   23|    if (due - odom <= alertKm) return true;
   24|  }
   25|  if (schedule.next_due_date) {
   26|    const daysLeft = dayjs(schedule.next_due_date).diff(dayjs(), 'day');
   27|    const alertDays = schedule.alert_before_days ?? 7;
   28|    if (daysLeft <= alertDays) return true;
   29|  }
   30|  return false;
   31|}

   68|    [recordsQuery.data],

   83|    },

   95|      void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['vehicles', vehicleId, 'maintenance-schedules'] });
   96|    },

   13|  useAuthStore.getState().setUser(user);
   14|};
   15|
   16|const getApiErrorMessage = (error: unknown) => {
   17|  if (!error || typeof error !== 'object' || !('response' in error)) return undefined;
   18|  return (error as { response?: { data?: { message?: string } } })?.response?.data?.message;
   19|};

   21|export const authProvider: AuthProvider = {
   22|  login: async ({ email, password }) => {
   23|    try {
   24|      const response = await authService.login({ email, password });
   25|
   26|      if (response.success && response.data?.user) {
   27|        setCurrentUser(response.data.user);
   28|        return {
   29|          success: true,
   30|          redirectTo: ROUTES.dashboard,
   31|        };
   32|      }
   33|
   34|      return {
   35|        success: false,
   36|        error: {
   37|          message: 'Login failed',
   38|          name: 'LoginError',
   39|        },
   40|      };
   41|    } catch (error: unknown) {
   42|      return {
   43|        success: false,
   44|        error: {
   45|          message: getApiErrorMessage(error) || 'Login failed',
   46|          name: 'LoginError',
   47|        },
   48|      };
   49|    }
   50|  },
   51|
   52|  logout: async () => {
   53|    try {
   54|      await authService.logout();
   55|    } catch {
   56|      // Ignore logout errors as we clear local state anyway
   57|    } finally {
   58|      clearAuthToken();
   59|      setCurrentUser(null);
   60|    }
   61|
   62|    return {
   63|      success: true,
   64|      redirectTo: ROUTES.login,
   65|    };
   66|  },
   67|
   68|  check: async () => {
   69|    const UNAUTHENTICATED = { authenticated: false, redirectTo: ROUTES.login, logout: true } as const;
   70|    const AUTHENTICATED = { authenticated: true } as const;
   71|
   72|    const tryGetCurrentUser = async (): Promise<boolean> => {
   73|      try {
   74|        const response = await authService.getCurrentUser();
   75|        const user = authService.getUserFromMeResponse(response);
   76|        if (response.success && user) {
   77|          setCurrentUser(user);
   78|          return true;
   79|        }
   80|        return false;
   81|      } catch {
   82|        return false;
   83|      }
   84|    };
   85|
   86|    if (await tryGetCurrentUser()) return AUTHENTICATED;
   87|
   88|    setCurrentUser(null);
   89|    clearAuthToken();
   90|
   91|    return UNAUTHENTICATED;
   92|  },
   93|
   94|  onError: async (error) => {
   95|    if (error?.status === 401) {
   96|      clearAuthToken();
   97|      setCurrentUser(null);
   98|      return {
   99|        logout: true,
  100|        redirectTo: ROUTES.login,
  101|        error,
  102|      };
  103|    }
  104|    
  105|    return { error };
  106|  },
  107|
  108|  getIdentity: async () => {

  116|      const user = authService.getUserFromMeResponse(response);

   36|  current: number,
   37|  perPage: number,
   38|  filters?: CrudFilter[],
   39|  sorters?: GetListParams['sorters'],
   40|) => {
   41|  const queryParams: Record<string, unknown> = {
   42|    page: current,

   46|  if (filters && filters.length > 0) {

   51|        queryParams[key] = filter.value;

   60|      queryParams.sort_order = sorter.order === 'desc' ? 'desc' : 'asc';
   61|    }
   62|  }

   67|const parseEnvelopeList = <TData extends BaseRecord>(resource: string, body: EnvelopeLike<TData[]>): { data: TData[]; total: number } => {

   69|  const envelopeData = unwrapEnvelope<unknown>(body);
   70|
   71|  if (Array.isArray(envelopeData)) {
   72|    return {
   73|      data: envelopeData as TData[],
   74|      total: body.meta?.total ?? envelopeData.length,
   75|    };
   76|  }
   77|
   78|  if (envelopeData && typeof envelopeData === 'object' && Array.isArray((envelopeData as { data?: unknown }).data)) {
   79|    const nested = envelopeData as { data: TData[]; meta?: { total?: number } };
   80|    return {
   81|      data: nested.data,
   82|      total: nested.meta?.total ?? body.meta?.total ?? nested.data.length,
   83|    };
   84|  }
   85|
   86|  throw new Error(`Invalid list payload for resource "${resource}"`);
   87|};

   91|  ...simpleRestDataProvider(ENV.API_BASE_URL),

   93|  getList: async <TData extends BaseRecord = BaseRecord>(params: GetListParams) => {
   94|    const { resource, pagination, filters, sorters, meta } = params;
   95|    const { current = 1, pageSize = 15 } = pagination ?? {};
   96|    const perPage = Math.min(Math.max(1, pageSize), 100);
   97|
   98|    if (resource === 'trip-costs') {
   99|      const tripId = (meta as { tripId?: number } | undefined)?.tripId;
  100|      if (tripId == null) {
  101|        throw new Error('trip-costs list requires meta.tripId');
  102|      }
  103|      const { data, total } = await costService.listTripCosts(tripId, {
  104|        page: current,
  105|        per_page: perPage,
  106|      });
  107|      return { data: data as unknown as TData[], total };
  108|    }
  109|
  110|    if (resource === 'leave-requests') {
  111|      const queryParams: Record<string, unknown> = {
  112|        page: current,
  113|        per_page: perPage,
  114|      };
  115|      if (filters && filters.length > 0) {
  116|        filters.forEach((filter: CrudFilter) => {
  117|          if ('field' in filter && 'value' in filter && filter.value !== undefined && filter.value !== '') {
  118|            queryParams[filter.field as string] = filter.value;
  119|          }
  120|        });
  121|      }
  122|
  123|      try {
  124|        const response = await api.get(ENDPOINTS.leaveOps.base, { params: queryParams });
  125|        const body = response.data as EnvelopeLike<TData[]>;
  126|        throwIfEnvelopeFailed(body);
  127|        const envelopeData = unwrapEnvelope<unknown>(body);
  128|        if (Array.isArray(envelopeData)) {
  129|          return { data: envelopeData as TData[], total: body.meta?.total ?? envelopeData.length };
  130|        }
  131|        if (envelopeData && typeof envelopeData === 'object' && 'data' in envelopeData && Array.isArray((envelopeData as { data: unknown }).data)) {
  132|          const nested = envelopeData as { data: TData[]; meta?: { total?: number } };
  133|          return {
  134|            data: nested.data,
  135|            total: nested.meta?.total ?? body.meta?.total ?? nested.data.length,
  136|          };
  137|        }
  138|      } catch (error) {
  139|        const status = (error as { response?: { status?: number } })?.response?.status;
  140|        if (status !== 404) {
  141|          throw error;
  142|        }
  143|        const fallback = await api.get(ENDPOINTS.workforce.leaveRequests, { params: queryParams });
  144|        const fallbackBody = fallback.data as EnvelopeLike<TData[]>;
  145|        throwIfEnvelopeFailed(fallbackBody);
  146|        const fallbackData = unwrapEnvelope<unknown>(fallbackBody);
  147|        if (Array.isArray(fallbackData)) {
  148|          return { data: fallbackData as TData[], total: fallbackBody.meta?.total ?? fallbackData.length };
  149|        }
  150|        if (fallbackData && typeof fallbackData === 'object' && 'data' in fallbackData && Array.isArray((fallbackData as { data: unknown }).data)) {
  151|          const nested = fallbackData as { data: TData[]; meta?: { total?: number } };
  152|          return {
  153|            data: nested.data,
  154|            total: nested.meta?.total ?? fallbackBody.meta?.total ?? nested.data.length,
  155|          };
  156|        }
  157|      }
  158|
  159|      throw new Error('Invalid list payload for resource "leave-requests"');
  160|    }
  161|
  162|    const queryParams = buildListQueryParams(current, perPage, filters, sorters);
  163|
  164|    const apiResource = resolveApiResource(resource);
  165|
  166|// Silently return empty for resources not yet implemented in backend.
  167|    // Logs when a resource is returned as unavailable for better debugging.
  168|    if (NOT_IMPLEMENTED_RESOURCES.has(resource)) {
  169|      console.debug(`[DataProvider] Resource "${resource}" not implemented - returning empty list`);
  170|      return { data: [] as unknown as TData[], total: 0 };
  171|    }
  172|    // Optional runtime override for environments with partial backend route availability.
  173|    if (DISABLED_LIST_RESOURCES.has(resource)) {
  174|      return { data: [] as unknown as TData[], total: 0 };
  175|    }
  176|    // Cache unavailable resources at runtime to avoid repeated 404/403 spam on polling/re-render.
  177|    if (RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE_LIST_RESOURCES.has(resource)) {
  178|      return { data: [] as unknown as TData[], total: 0 };
  179|    }
  180|
  181|    let body: EnvelopeLike<TData[]> | undefined;
  182|    try {
  183|      const response = await api.get<EnvelopeLike<TData[]>>(`/${apiResource}`, { params: queryParams });
  184|      body = response.data;
  185|    } catch (error) {
  186|      const status = (error as ApiErrorLike)?.response?.status;
  187|      if (isUnavailableStatus(status)) {
  188|        const candidates = LEGACY_LIST_FALLBACKS[resource] ?? [];
  189|        for (const candidate of candidates) {
  190|          try {
  191|            const fallbackResponse = await api.get<EnvelopeLike<TData[]>>(`/${candidate}`, { params: queryParams });
  192|            body = fallbackResponse.data;
  193|            break;
  194|          } catch (fallbackError) {
  195|            const fallbackStatus = (fallbackError as ApiErrorLike)?.response?.status;
  196|            if (fallbackStatus !== 404) {
  197|              throw fallbackError;
  198|            }
  199|          }
  200|        }
  201|        if (!body) {
  202|          RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE_LIST_RESOURCES.add(resource);
  203|          return { data: [], total: 0 };
  204|        }
  205|      } else {
  206|        throw error;
  207|      }
  208|    }
  209|    if (!body) {
  210|      throw new Error(`Empty response body for resource "${resource}"`);
  211|    }
  212|    RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE_LIST_RESOURCES.delete(resource);
  213|    const { data: listData, total } = parseEnvelopeList<TData>(resource, body);
  214|
  215|    return {
  216|      data: listData,
  217|      total,
  218|    };
  219|  },
  220|
  221|  getOne: async <TData extends BaseRecord = BaseRecord>(params: GetOneParams) => {
  222|    const { resource, id } = params;

  232|  create: async <TData extends BaseRecord = BaseRecord, TVariables = Record<string, never>>(params: CreateParams<TVariables>) => {
  233|    const { resource, variables, meta } = params;
  234|
  235|    if (resource === 'trip-costs') {
  236|      const tripId = (meta as { tripId?: number } | undefined)?.tripId;
  237|      if (tripId == null) {
  238|        throw new Error('trip-costs create requires meta.tripId');
  239|      }
  240|      const v = variables as Record<string, unknown>;

  242|      const payload = {

  244|        amount: Number(v.amount),
  245|        incurred_date: String(v.incurred_date),
  246|        description: v.description != null ? String(v.description) : undefined,
  247|        norm_amount: v.norm_amount != null && v.norm_amount !== '' ? Number(v.norm_amount) : undefined,
  248|      };

  250|      return { data: data as unknown as TData };
  251|    }
  252|
  253|    const apiResource = resolveApiResource(resource);
  254|    const response = await api.post(`/${apiResource}`, variables);
  255|    const body = response.data as { success?: boolean; data?: unknown };
  256|    throwIfEnvelopeFailed(body);
  257|    return {
  258|      data: unwrapEnvelope<TData>(response.data),
  259|    };
  260|  },

  281|  custom: async <TData extends BaseRecord = BaseRecord>(params: CustomParams) => {
  282|    const { url, method, payload, query, headers } = params;
  283|    let body: unknown;
  284|    try {
  285|      const response = await api.request<unknown>({
  286|        url,
  287|        method: method as string,
  288|        params: query,
  289|        data: payload,
  290|        headers,
  291|      });
  292|      body = response.data;
  293|    } catch (error) {
  294|      const status = (error as ApiErrorLike)?.response?.status;
  295|      if (status === 403 || status === 404) {
  296|        return { data: {} as TData };
  297|      }
  298|      throw error;
  299|    }
  300|    throwIfEnvelopeFailed(body);
  301|    return {
  302|      data: unwrapEnvelope<TData>(body),
  303|    };
  304|  },

===== FILE: src/providers/notificationProvider.ts =====
    1|import type { NotificationProvider, OpenNotificationParams } from '@refinedev/core';
    2|import { App } from 'antd';
    3|import type { ArgsProps } from 'antd/es/notification/interface';
    4|import { createDedupedCaller } from '@/utils/dedupe';
    5|import type { AxiosError } from 'axios';
    6|
    7|const shouldShowNotification = createDedupedCaller(1500);
    8|
    9|type Translator = (key: string) => string;
   10|
   11|/**
   12| * Chuyển lỗi HTTP (AxiosError hoặc unknown) thành chuỗi thông báo phù hợp.
   13| * Ưu tiên message từ backend; fallback sang i18n theo status code.
   14| */
   15|export function resolveHttpError(err: unknown, t: Translator): string {
   16|  const axiosErr = err as AxiosError<{ message?: string }>;
   17|  const status = axiosErr?.response?.status;
   18|  const serverMsg = axiosErr?.response?.data?.message;
   19|  if (!status) return t('auth.networkError');
   20|  switch (status) {
   21|    case 400: return serverMsg || t('auth.badRequest');
   22|    case 401: return serverMsg || t('auth.invalidCredentials');
   23|    case 403: return serverMsg || t('auth.accountForbidden');
   24|    case 404: return serverMsg || t('auth.accountNotFound');
   25|    case 422: return serverMsg || t('auth.invalidCredentials');
   26|    case 429: return serverMsg || t('auth.rateLimited');
   27|    default:  return status >= 500 ? t('auth.serverError') : (serverMsg || t('auth.loginFailed'));
   28|  }
   29|}
   30|
   31|// Lọc các thông báo lỗi generic do Refine/Axios tự sinh — không có giá trị với user
   32|function isNoiseError(params: OpenNotificationParams): boolean {
   33|  const msg = params.message || '';
   34|  const desc = params.description || '';
   35|  const genericMsg =
   36|    msg === 'Error' ||
   37|    msg === 'Request failed' ||
   38|    msg.includes('status code') ||
   39|    msg.includes('Network Error') ||
   40|    msg.includes('timeout');
   41|  const genericDesc = !desc || desc.startsWith('Error when');
   42|  return genericMsg && genericDesc;
   43|}
   44|
   45|// Lọc thông báo success generic mà Refine tự thêm
   46|function isNoiseSuccess(params: OpenNotificationParams): boolean {
   47|  return !params.message || params.message === 'Successful' || params.message === 'Success';
   48|}
   49|
   50|export const useAppNotificationProvider = (): NotificationProvider => {
   51|  const { notification } = App.useApp();
   52|
   53|  return {
   54|    open: (params) => {
   55|      if (params.type === 'error' && isNoiseError(params)) return;
   56|      if (params.type === 'success' && isNoiseSuccess(params)) return;
   57|
   58|      const dedupKey = `${params.type}-${params.message}-${params.description ?? ''}`;
   59|      if (!shouldShowNotification(dedupKey)) return;
   60|
   61|      const config: ArgsProps = {
   62|        key: params.key,
   63|        message: params.message,
   64|        description: params.description,
   65|        placement: 'topRight',
   66|        duration: params.type === 'error' ? 5 : 3,
   67|      };
   68|
   69|      switch (params.type) {
   70|        case 'success':
   71|          notification.success(config);
   72|          break;
   73|        case 'error':
   74|          notification.error(config);
   75|          break;
   76|        case 'progress':
   77|          notification.info({
   78|            ...config,
   79|            duration: 0,
   80|            description: params.undoableTimeout != null
   81|              ? `${params.description ?? ''} (${params.undoableTimeout}s)`
   82|              : params.description,
   83|          });
   84|          break;
   85|      }
   86|    },
   87|
   88|    close: (key) => {
   89|      notification.destroy(key);
   90|    },
   91|  };
   92|};
   93|

   32|const ProtectedRoute = ({ children, requiredRole }: { children: ReactNode; requiredRole: string }) => {
   33|  const { isAuthenticated, isLoading, hasRole } = useAuth();
   34|  
   35|  if (isLoading) return <AppLoadingSpin variant="page" />;
   36|  if (!isAuthenticated) return <Navigate to={ROUTES.login} replace />;
   37|  if (requiredRole && !hasRole(requiredRole)) return <Navigate to={ROUTES.dashboard} replace />;
   38|  
   39|  return <>{children}</>;
   40|};

   43|  if (!role) return node;
   44|  return <ProtectedRoute requiredRole={role}>{node}</ProtectedRoute>;

  127|type ResourceAliasKey = keyof typeof RESOURCE_ALIASES;
  128|type ManagedResourceKey = keyof typeof RESOURCE_ROUTE_GROUPS;
  129|
  130|const resolveManagedResource = (resource: string): ManagedResourceKey | null => {
  131|  const normalizedResource = resource.toLowerCase() as ResourceAliasKey;
  132|  return RESOURCE_ALIASES[normalizedResource] ?? null;
  133|};
  134|

  136|  const routeKey = resolveManagedResource(resource);
  137|  return routeKey ? RESOURCE_ROUTE_GROUPS[routeKey].editById(id) : null;
  138|};

   34|export function extractFilenameFromContentDisposition(contentDisposition?: string): string | null {
   35|  if (!contentDisposition) return null;
   36|
   37|  const utf8Match = contentDisposition.match(/filename\*=UTF-8''([^;]+)/i);
   38|  if (utf8Match?.[1]) {
   39|    return decodeURIComponent(utf8Match[1]);
   40|  }
   41|
   42|  const asciiMatch = contentDisposition.match(/filename=([^;]+)/i);
   43|  if (asciiMatch?.[1]) {
   44|    return asciiMatch[1].replace(/["']/g, '').trim();
   45|  }
   46|
   47|  return null;

   71|let _cachedLocale: 'en' | 'vi' | null = null;
   72|const getUiLocale = (): 'en' | 'vi' => {
   73|  if (_cachedLocale !== null) return _cachedLocale;
   74|  try {
   75|    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.APP_STORAGE);
   76|    if (raw) _cachedLocale = (JSON.parse(raw)?.state?.locale as 'en' | 'vi') ?? 'vi';
   77|  } catch { /* ignore */ }

   82|const get409Message = (error: AxiosError): string => {
   83|  const data = error.response?.data as { conflict_type?: string; message?: string } | undefined;
   84|  const conflictType = data?.conflict_type;
   85|  const locale = getUiLocale();
   86|  if (conflictType && CONFLICT_MESSAGES[conflictType]) {
   87|    return CONFLICT_MESSAGES[conflictType][locale];
   88|  }
   89|  return data?.message || (locale === 'en' ? 'Business conflict. Please refresh and try again.' : 'Xung đột nghiệp vụ. Vui lòng làm mới và thử lại.');

   92|// ── Token refresh queue ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   93|let isRefreshing = false;
   94|let failedQueue: Array<{
   95|  resolve: (token: string) => void;
   96|  reject: (error: unknown) => void;
   97|}> = [];
   98|
   99|const processQueue = (error: unknown, token: string | null = null) => {
  100|  failedQueue.forEach((prom) => {
  101|    if (error) {
  102|      prom.reject(error);
  103|    } else {
  104|      prom.resolve(token!);
  105|    }
  106|  });
  107|  failedQueue = [];
  108|};
  109|
  110|const forceLogout = () => {
  111|  clearAuthToken();
  112|  const msg = getUiLocale() === 'en'
  113|    ? 'Session expired. Please log in again.'
  114|    : 'Phiên đăng nhập hết hạn. Vui lòng đăng nhập lại.';
  115|  showDedupedErrorToast('401-session-expired', msg);
  116|  window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('auth:force-logout'));
  117|};
  118|
  119|/** Attempt to refresh session using cookies. Returns true if successful. */
  120|const attemptRefresh = async (): Promise<boolean> => {
  121|  try {
  122|    // Use raw axios to avoid interceptor loop. 
  123|    // The browser will automatically send the refresh cookie if withCredentials is true.
  124|    const response: AxiosResponse<{
  125|      success?: boolean;
  126|    }> = await axios.post(
  127|      `${ENV.API_BASE_URL}${ENDPOINTS.auth.refresh}`,
  128|      {},
  129|      {
  130|        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Accept: 'application/json' },
  131|        withCredentials: true,
  132|      },
  133|    );
  134|
  135|    return response.data?.success === true;
  136|  } catch {
  137|    return false;
  138|  }
  139|};
  140|
  141|
  142|const api: AxiosInstance = axios.create({
  143|  baseURL: ENV.API_BASE_URL,
  144|  headers: {
  145|    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  146|    Accept: 'application/json',
  147|  },
  148|  withCredentials: true, // For HttpOnly cookies
  149|});
  150|
  151|// Request interceptor
  152|api.interceptors.request.use(
  153|  (config: InternalAxiosRequestConfig & { useApiRoot?: boolean }) => {
  154|    if (config.useApiRoot) {
  155|      config.baseURL = ENV.API_ROOT_URL;
  156|      delete config.useApiRoot;
  157|    }
  158|
  159|    // Ensure multipart/form-data works by letting the browser set the boundary
  160|    if (config.data instanceof FormData) {
  161|      delete config.headers['Content-Type'];
  162|    }
  163|
  164|    // Fix: If baseURL is absolute (starts with http), ensure the URL doesn't start with /
  165|    // to prevent axios from making it relative to the current host origin.
  166|    if (config.baseURL?.startsWith('http') && config.url?.startsWith('/')) {
  167|      config.url = config.url.substring(1);
  168|    }
  169|
  170|    const tenantId = getTenantId();
  171|    if (tenantId) {
  172|      config.headers['X-Tenant-ID'] = String(tenantId);
  173|    }
  174|    return config;
  175|  },
  176|  (error) => {
  177|    return Promise.reject(error);
  178|  }
  179|);
  180|
  181|// Response interceptor - Centralized error handling with token refresh
  182|api.interceptors.response.use(
  183|  (response) => {
  184|    return response;
  185|  },
  186|  async (error: AxiosError) => {
  187|    const config = error.config as InternalAxiosRequestConfig & {
  188|      skipToast?: boolean;
  189|      skipErrorToast?: boolean;
  190|      errorMode?: ErrorMode;
  191|      _retry?: boolean;
  192|    };
  193|    const status = getErrorStatus(error);
  194|
  195|    // ── CSRF Token Mismatch Handling (Laravel Sanctum 419) ───────────────────
  196|    // Sanctum trả về 419 khi mất session hoặc sai CSRF Token.
  197|    if (status === 419 && config && !config._retry) {
  198|      config._retry = true;
  199|      try {
  200|        // Fetch lại CSRF Cookie mới
  201|        await axios.get(
  202|          ENV.IS_DEV ? '/sanctum/csrf-cookie' : `${ENV.API_ORIGIN}/sanctum/csrf-cookie`,
  203|          { withCredentials: true }
  204|        );
  205|        return api(config); // Thử lại request gốc ngay lập tức
  206|      } catch {
  207|        forceLogout();
  208|        return Promise.reject(error);
  209|      }
  210|    }
  211|
  212|    // ── Token refresh logic (before any toast handling) ──────────────────────
  213|    // Only attempt refresh for 401 errors that haven't been retried yet,
  214|    // and NOT for auth endpoints themselves (prevent loop).
  215|    const isAuthEndpoint = config?.url?.includes('/auth/');
  216|    if (status === 401 && config && !config._retry && !isAuthEndpoint) {
  217|      const canTryRefresh = AUTH_REFRESH_ENABLED;
  218|
  219|      if (canTryRefresh) {
  220|        if (isRefreshing) {
  221|          return new Promise<AxiosResponse>((resolve, reject) => {
  222|            failedQueue.push({
  223|              resolve: () => {
  224|                resolve(api(config));
  225|              },
  226|              reject: (err: unknown) => {
  227|                reject(err);
  228|              },
  229|            });
  230|          });
  231|        }
  232|
  233|
  234|        config._retry = true;
  235|        isRefreshing = true;
  236|
  237|        try {
  238|          const success = await attemptRefresh();
  239|          if (success) {
  240|            processQueue(null, 'session-refreshed');
  241|            return api(config);
  242|          }
  243|          processQueue(error, null);
  244|          forceLogout();
  245|          return Promise.reject(error);
  246|        } catch (refreshError) {
  247|          processQueue(refreshError, null);
  248|          forceLogout();
  249|          return Promise.reject(refreshError);
  250|        } finally {
  251|
  252|          isRefreshing = false;
  253|        }
  254|      }
  255|
  256|      forceLogout();
  257|      return Promise.reject(error);
  258|    }
  259|
  260|    // ── Toast error handling ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  261|    const errorMode = config?.errorMode ?? 'global';
  262|
  263|    // Skip toast if explicitly requested or already shown
  264|    const errorWithFlag = error as AxiosError & { __toastShown?: boolean };
  265|    if (
  266|      config?.skipToast ||
  267|      config?.skipErrorToast ||
  268|      errorMode === 'silent' ||
  269|      errorWithFlag.__toastShown
  270|    ) {
  271|      return Promise.reject(error);
  272|    }
  273|
  274|    if (!shouldHandleGlobalErrorToast(error, errorMode)) {
  275|      return Promise.reject(error);
  276|    }
  277|
  278|    // Mark that toast has been shown to prevent duplicate
  279|    errorWithFlag.__toastShown = true;
  280|
  281|    if (status === 401 || status === 419) {
  282|      // If we reach here, refresh already failed or it's an auth endpoint
  283|      forceLogout();
  284|    } else if (status === 403) {
  285|      showDedupedErrorToast('403-forbidden', 'Bạn không có quyền thực hiện thao tác này.');
  286|    } else if (status === 409) {
  287|      const conflictMessage = get409Message(error);
  288|      showDedupedErrorToast('409-conflict', conflictMessage);
  289|    } else if (status === 422) {
  290|      const apiMessage =
  291|        (error.response?.data as { message?: string } | undefined)?.message || 'Dữ liệu không hợp lệ. Vui lòng kiểm tra lại.';
  292|      showDedupedErrorToast('422-validation', apiMessage);
  293|    } else if (typeof status === 'number' && status >= 500) {
  294|      showDedupedErrorToast(`5xx-${status}`, 'Lỗi hệ thống. Vui lòng thử lại sau.');
  295|    } else if (isTimeoutError(error)) {
  296|      showDedupedErrorToast('timeout', 'Yêu cầu quá thời gian. Vui lòng thử lại.');
  297|    } else if (isNetworkError(error)) {
  298|      showDedupedErrorToast('network-error', 'Lỗi mạng. Vui lòng kiểm tra kết nối.');
  299|    }
  300|
  301|    return Promise.reject(error);
  302|  }
  303|);
  304|
  305|export default api;
  306|

   39|  getUserFromMeResponse(response: ApiResponse<User | { user?: User; tenants?: import('@/types').Tenant[]; permissions?: Record<string, boolean> }>): User | null {
   40|    const payload = response.data;
   41|    if (!payload) return null;
   42|    
   43|    if ('user' in (payload as { user?: User })) {
   44|      const nested = payload as { user?: User; tenants?: import('@/types').Tenant[]; permissions?: Record<string, boolean> };

   46|      return {
   47|        ...nested.user,
   48|        tenants: nested.tenants ?? nested.user.tenants ?? [],
   49|        user_permissions: nested.permissions ?? nested.user.user_permissions,
   50|      };
   51|    }

   53|  }

    1|import api from './api';

    6|  normalizeChatMessages,
    7|  normalizeChatSessions,
    8|  normalizeSendMessageDonePayload,
    9|  normalizeSendMessagePayload,
   10|} from '@/utils/chatResponse';
   11|import { getTenantId } from '@/lib/auth-session';
   12|import { ENV } from '@/config/env';
   13|
   14|export interface SendChatMessagePayload {
   15|  content?: string;
   16|  message?: string;
   17|  task?: ChatTask;
   18|  session_id?: string;
   19|  context?: Record<string, unknown>;
   20|  model?: string;
   21|}

   23|export interface SendChatMessageResult {
   24|  session_id?: string;
   25|  session?: ChatSession;
   26|  message?: ChatMessage;
   27|  response_text?: string;
   28|  model?: string;
   29|  cached?: boolean;

   33|interface StreamMetaEvent {

   37|}

   39|interface StreamChunkEvent {
   40|  index?: number;

   52|  onMeta?: (meta: StreamMetaEvent) => void;
   53|  onChunk?: (chunk: StreamChunkEvent) => void;

   55|  onError?: (error: StreamErrorEvent) => void;

   58|class ChatService {
   59|  private toApiPayload(payload: SendChatMessagePayload) {
   60|    return {
   61|      ...payload,
   62|      content: payload.content ?? payload.message ?? '',
   63|    };
   64|  }
   65|
   66|  async getSessions(limit = 20): Promise<ApiResponse<ChatSession[]>> {
   67|    const response = await api.get(ENDPOINTS.chat.sessions, {

   87|    const response = await api.post(ENDPOINTS.chat.messages, this.toApiPayload(payload));
   88|    return {
   89|      ...response.data,
   90|      data: normalizeSendMessagePayload(response.data?.data),
   91|    };
   92|  }
   93|
   94|  async sendMessageStream(payload: SendChatMessagePayload, handlers: StreamHandlers = {}, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<StreamDoneEvent | undefined> {
   95|    const tenantId = getTenantId();
   96|    const response = await fetch(`${ENV.API_BASE_URL}${ENDPOINTS.chat.messagesStream}`, {
   97|      method: 'POST',
   98|      credentials: 'include',
   99|      headers: {
  100|        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  101|        Accept: 'text/event-stream',
  102|        ...(tenantId ? { 'X-Tenant-ID': String(tenantId) } : {}),
  103|      },
  104|      body: JSON.stringify(this.toApiPayload(payload)),
  105|      signal,
  106|    });
  107|
  108|    if (!response.ok || !response.body) {
  109|      const text = await response.text();
  110|      throw new Error(text || `HTTP ${response.status}`);
  111|    }
  112|
  113|    const reader = response.body.getReader();
  114|    const decoder = new TextDecoder('utf-8');
  115|    let buffer = '';
  116|    let donePayload: StreamDoneEvent | undefined;
  117|
  118|    const processRawEvent = (rawEvent: string) => {
  119|      const normalizedRawEvent = rawEvent.replace(/\r\n/g, '\n').replace(/\r/g, '\n');
  120|      const lines = normalizedRawEvent.split('\n');
  121|
  122|      let name = '';
  123|      const dataLines: string[] = [];
  124|
  125|      for (const line of lines) {
  126|        if (!line || line.startsWith(':')) continue;
  127|        if (line.startsWith('event:')) {
  128|          name = line.slice('event:'.length).trim();
  129|        } else if (line.startsWith('data:')) {
  130|          dataLines.push(line.slice('data:'.length).trimStart());
  131|        }
  132|      }
  133|
  134|      if (!name || dataLines.length === 0) return;
  135|
  136|      let data: unknown;
  137|      try {
  138|        data = JSON.parse(dataLines.join('\n')) as unknown;
  139|      } catch {
  140|        return;
  141|      }
  142|
  143|      if (name === 'meta' && typeof data === 'object' && data !== null) {
  144|        handlers.onMeta?.(data as StreamMetaEvent);
  145|      } else if (name === 'chunk' && typeof data === 'object' && data !== null) {
  146|        handlers.onChunk?.(data as StreamChunkEvent);
  147|      } else if (name === 'done' && typeof data === 'object' && data !== null) {
  148|        const normalizedDone = normalizeSendMessageDonePayload(data);
  149|        donePayload = normalizedDone;
  150|        handlers.onDone?.(normalizedDone);
  151|      } else if (name === 'error' && typeof data === 'object' && data !== null) {
  152|        handlers.onError?.(data as StreamErrorEvent);
  153|        throw new Error((data as StreamErrorEvent).message || 'Chat stream error');
  154|      }
  155|    };
  156|
  157|    for (;;) {
  158|      const { value, done } = await reader.read();
  159|      if (done) break;
  160|
  161|      buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
  162|      const events = buffer.split(/\r?\n\r?\n/);
  163|      buffer = events.pop() || '';
  164|
  165|      for (const rawEvent of events) {
  166|        processRawEvent(rawEvent);
  167|      }
  168|    }
  169|
  170|    buffer += decoder.decode();
  171|    if (buffer.trim()) {
  172|      processRawEvent(buffer);
  173|    }
  174|
  175|    return donePayload;
  176|  }
  177|
  178|  async deleteSession(sessionId: string): Promise<ApiResponse<null>> {
  179|    const response = await api.delete(ENDPOINTS.chat.sessionById(sessionId));
  180|    return response.data;
  181|  }

  184|export default new ChatService();

    1|import api from './api';
    2|import { ENDPOINTS } from './endpoints';
    3|import { throwIfEnvelopeFailed, unwrapEnvelope } from './http';
    4|import type { CostApprovalRequest, CostCategory, CreateTripCostPayload, TripCost } from '@/types/domain/cost';
    5|
    6|type ListParams = { page?: number; per_page?: number; status?: string };
    7|
    8|function parsePagedList<T>(body: unknown): { data: T[]; total: number } {
    9|  throwIfEnvelopeFailed(body);
   10|  const envelopeData = unwrapEnvelope<unknown>(body) as
   11|    | T[]
   12|    | { data?: T[]; meta?: { total?: number } }
   13|    | null
   14|    | undefined;
   15|
   16|  const metaTotal = (body as { meta?: { total?: number } })?.meta?.total;
   17|
   18|  if (Array.isArray(envelopeData)) {
   19|    return { data: envelopeData, total: metaTotal ?? envelopeData.length };
   20|  }
   21|  if (envelopeData && typeof envelopeData === 'object' && Array.isArray((envelopeData as { data: T[] }).data)) {
   22|    const inner = envelopeData as { data: T[]; meta?: { total?: number } };
   23|    return {
   24|      data: inner.data,
   25|      total: inner.meta?.total ?? metaTotal ?? inner.data.length,
   26|    };
   27|  }
   28|  return { data: [], total: 0 };
   29|}

===== FILE: src/services/dashboard.service.ts =====
    1|import api from './api';
    2|import axios from 'axios';
    3|import { ApiResponse } from '@/types';
    4|import type { DashboardStats } from '@/types';
    5|import { ENDPOINTS } from './endpoints';
    6|
    7|function mapLegacyDashboardPayload(raw: Record<string, unknown>): DashboardStats {
    8|  const companiesCount = Number(raw.companies_count ?? 0);
    9|  const payrollsCount = Number(raw.payrolls_count ?? 0);
   10|  const base: DashboardStats = {
   11|    companies:
   12|      raw.companies && typeof raw.companies === 'object'
   13|        ? (raw.companies as DashboardStats['companies'])
   14|        : { total: companiesCount, active: companiesCount },
   15|    employees:
   16|      raw.employees && typeof raw.employees === 'object'
   17|        ? (raw.employees as DashboardStats['employees'])
   18|        : { total: 0, active: 0 },
   19|    vehicles:
   20|      raw.vehicles && typeof raw.vehicles === 'object'
   21|        ? (raw.vehicles as DashboardStats['vehicles'])
   22|        : { total: 0, active: 0 },
   23|    trips:
   24|      raw.trips && typeof raw.trips === 'object'
   25|        ? (raw.trips as DashboardStats['trips'])
   26|        : { total: 0, pending: 0, completed: 0 },
   27|    payrolls:
   28|      raw.payrolls && typeof raw.payrolls === 'object'
   29|        ? (raw.payrolls as DashboardStats['payrolls'])
   30|        : { total: payrollsCount, pending: payrollsCount, completed: 0 },
   31|  };
   32|
   33|  const revenueCandidates = [raw.revenue_total, raw.trips_revenue, raw.trip_revenue_total, raw.sales_total];
   34|  for (const c of revenueCandidates) {
   35|    const n = typeof c === 'number' ? c : Number(c);
   36|    if (Number.isFinite(n)) {
   37|      base.revenue = { total: n };
   38|      break;
   39|    }
   40|  }
   41|  if (!base.revenue && typeof raw.revenue === 'number') {
   42|    base.revenue = { total: raw.revenue };
   43|  } else if (!base.revenue && raw.revenue && typeof raw.revenue === 'object' && raw.revenue !== null) {
   44|    const r = raw.revenue as Record<string, unknown>;
   45|    const t = r.total ?? r.amount ?? r.value;
   46|    const n = typeof t === 'number' ? t : Number(t);
   47|    if (Number.isFinite(n)) base.revenue = { total: n };
   48|  }
   49|
   50|  return base;
   51|}
   52|
   53|class DashboardService {
   54|  private overviewUnavailable = false;
   55|
   56|  async getStats(month?: number, year?: number, companyId?: number): Promise<ApiResponse<DashboardStats>> {
   57|    if (this.overviewUnavailable) {
   58|      return {
   59|        success: true,
   60|        data: mapLegacyDashboardPayload({}),
   61|      } as ApiResponse<DashboardStats>;
   62|    }
   63|
   64|    const m = month ?? new Date().getMonth() + 1;
   65|    const y = year ?? new Date().getFullYear();
   66|    try {
   67|      const response = await api.get(ENDPOINTS.reports.dashboard, {
   68|        params: {
   69|          month: m,
   70|          year: y,
   71|          ...(companyId != null ? { company_id: companyId } : {}),
   72|        },
   73|      });
   74|      const body = response.data as ApiResponse<Record<string, unknown>>;
   75|      if (body.success && body.data && typeof body.data === 'object') {
   76|        return {
   77|          success: true,
   78|          message: body.message,
   79|          data: mapLegacyDashboardPayload(body.data as Record<string, unknown>),
   80|        };
   81|      }
   82|      return body as unknown as ApiResponse<DashboardStats>;
   83|    } catch (error) {
   84|      if (axios.isAxiosError(error)) {
   85|        const status = error.response?.status;
   86|        if (status === 403 || status === 404) {
   87|          this.overviewUnavailable = true;
   88|          return {
   89|            success: true,
   90|            data: mapLegacyDashboardPayload({}),
   91|          } as ApiResponse<DashboardStats>;
   92|        }
   93|      }
   94|      throw error;
   95|    }
   96|  }
   97|}

    4|import type { ApiListPayload } from './http/types';
    5|import type { AbsenceRecord, ApiResponse, DriverSchedule, LeaveRequest, PublicHoliday } from '@/types';
    6|
    7|type ListResult<T> = { data: T[]; total: number };
    8|
    9|const NAGER_BASE = 'https://date.nager.at/api/v3/PublicHolidays';
   10|
   11|interface NagerRow {
   12|  date: string;
   13|  localName: string;
   14|  name: string;
   15|  countryCode: string;
   16|  types?: string[];
   17|  counties?: string[] | null;
   18|}
   19|
   20|function stableId(date: string, index: number): number {
   21|  let h = 0;
   22|  for (let i = 0; i < date.length; i += 1) h = (Math.imul(31, h) + date.charCodeAt(i)) | 0;
   23|  return (Math.abs(h) * 10007 + index) % 2_000_000_000 + 1;
   24|}
   25|
   26|function mapNagerRows(rows: NagerRow[]): PublicHoliday[] {
   27|  return rows.map((row, index) => {
   28|    const types = row.types ?? [];
   29|    const hasCounties = Array.isArray(row.counties) && row.counties.length > 0;
   30|    const holiday_type: PublicHoliday['holiday_type'] = hasCounties
   31|      ? 'regional'
   32|      : types.includes('Bank') || types.includes('School')
   33|        ? 'compensatory'
   34|        : 'national';
   35|    const dateKey = String(row.date).slice(0, 10);
   36|    return { id: stableId(dateKey, index), date: dateKey, name: (row.localName?.trim()) || row.name, holiday_type };
   37|  });
   38|}
   39|
   40|const getListCompat = <T>(body: unknown): ListResult<T> => {
   41|  try {
   42|    const payload = unwrapEnvelope<ApiListPayload<T>>(body);
   43|    if (!payload || !Array.isArray(payload.data)) throw new Error();
   44|    return { data: payload.data, total: payload.meta?.total ?? payload.data.length };
   45|  } catch {
   46|    const direct = body as { data?: T[]; meta?: { total?: number } } | undefined;
   47|    const rows = Array.isArray(direct?.data) ? direct.data : [];
   48|    return { data: rows, total: direct?.meta?.total ?? rows.length };
   49|  }
   50|};

  148|    try {
  149|      const res = await fetch(`${NAGER_BASE}/${params.year}/${country}`, { headers: { Accept: 'application/json' } });
  150|      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Nager HTTP ${res.status}`);
  151|      const rows = await res.json() as unknown;
  152|      if (!Array.isArray(rows)) throw new Error('invalid JSON');
  153|      return { data: mapNagerRows(rows as NagerRow[]) };
  154|    } catch {
  155|      const res = await api.get(ENDPOINTS.publicHolidays.list, { params });
  156|      const body = res.data as { data?: PublicHoliday[] };
  157|      return { data: Array.isArray(body?.data) ? body.data : [] };
  158|    }
  159|  }
  160|}
  161|
  162|export default new DriverScheduleService();

===== FILE: src/services/http/envelope.ts =====
    1|import type { ApiEnvelope, ApiListPayload, ApiPaginationMeta } from './types';
    2|
    3|export function isApiEnvelope<TData>(value: unknown): value is ApiEnvelope<TData> {
    4|  return Boolean(value && typeof value === 'object' && 'success' in value && 'data' in value);
    5|}
    6|
    7|export function throwIfEnvelopeFailed(value: unknown): void {
    8|  if (value && typeof value === 'object' && 'success' in value && (value as { success?: boolean }).success === false) {
    9|    const message = (value as { message?: string }).message || 'Request failed';
   10|    const err = new Error(message) as Error & { response?: { data: unknown } };
   11|    err.response = { data: value };
   12|    throw err;
   13|  }
   14|}
   15|
   16|/**
   17| * Trả về `data` của envelope. Nếu input không phải envelope, trả nguyên giá trị.
   18| */
   19|export function unwrapEnvelope<TData>(value: unknown): TData {
   20|  throwIfEnvelopeFailed(value);
   21|  if (isApiEnvelope<TData>(value)) {
   22|    return value.data;
   23|  }
   24|  return value as TData;
   25|}
   26|
   27|/**
   28| * Helper cho list endpoint với envelope mới (`data: []`, `meta: {...}` ở root).
   29| *
   30| * Đồng thời chấp nhận envelope cũ kiểu `data: { data: [...], meta }` để service
   31| * legacy chưa migrate vẫn chạy.
   32| */
   33|export function unwrapList<TItem>(value: unknown): ApiListPayload<TItem> {
   34|  throwIfEnvelopeFailed(value);
   35|  if (!isApiEnvelope<unknown>(value)) {
   36|    if (Array.isArray(value)) return { data: value as TItem[] };
   37|    return { data: [] };
   38|  }
   39|  const env = value as ApiEnvelope<unknown>;
   40|  // New flat shape: data is array, meta sibling
   41|  if (Array.isArray(env.data)) {
   42|    return {
   43|      data: env.data as TItem[],
   44|      meta: (env.meta ?? undefined) as ApiPaginationMeta | undefined,
   45|    };
   46|  }
   47|  // Legacy nested shape: data: { data: [...], meta }
   48|  if (env.data && typeof env.data === 'object' && Array.isArray((env.data as { data?: unknown }).data)) {
   49|    const nested = env.data as { data: TItem[]; meta?: ApiPaginationMeta };
   50|    return { data: nested.data, meta: nested.meta };
   51|  }
   52|  return { data: [] };
   53|}
   54|

===== FILE: src/services/http/errors.ts =====
    1|import type { AxiosError } from 'axios';
    2|import { getErrorStatus } from '@/utils/errorHandler';
    3|
    4|export interface NormalizedApiError {
    5|  status?: number;
    6|  message: string;
    7|}
    8|
    9|export function normalizeApiError(error: unknown, fallback = 'Something went wrong'): NormalizedApiError {
   10|  if (!error || typeof error !== 'object') {
   11|    return { message: fallback };
   12|  }
   13|
   14|  const axiosError = error as AxiosError<{ message?: string }>;
   15|  const status = getErrorStatus(axiosError);
   16|  const message = axiosError.response?.data?.message || axiosError.message || fallback;
   17|  return { status: typeof status === 'number' ? status : undefined, message };
   18|}
   19|

===== FILE: src/services/http/resourceClientFactory.ts =====
    1|import type { AxiosInstance } from 'axios';
    2|import { unwrapEnvelope, unwrapList } from './envelope';
    3|import type { ApiListPayload } from './types';
    4|
    5|export interface ResourceClientConfig {
    6|  resource: string;
    7|  http: AxiosInstance;
    8|}
    9|
   10|export function createResourceClient<TItem, TCreate = Partial<TItem>, TUpdate = Partial<TItem>>(
   11|  config: ResourceClientConfig,
   12|) {
   13|  const basePath = `/${config.resource}`;
   14|
   15|  return {
   16|    async getList(params?: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ApiListPayload<TItem>> {
   17|      const response = await config.http.get(basePath, { params });
   18|      return unwrapList<TItem>(response.data);
   19|    },
   20|    async getById(id: string | number): Promise<TItem> {
   21|      const response = await config.http.get(`${basePath}/${id}`);
   22|      return unwrapEnvelope<TItem>(response.data);
   23|    },
   24|    async create(payload: TCreate): Promise<TItem> {
   25|      const response = await config.http.post(basePath, payload);
   26|      return unwrapEnvelope<TItem>(response.data);
   27|    },
   28|    async update(id: string | number, payload: TUpdate): Promise<TItem> {
   29|      const response = await config.http.put(`${basePath}/${id}`, payload);
   30|      return unwrapEnvelope<TItem>(response.data);
   31|    },
   32|    async remove(id: string | number): Promise<void> {
   33|      const response = await config.http.delete(`${basePath}/${id}`);
   34|      unwrapEnvelope<unknown>(response.data);
   35|    },
   36|  };
   37|}
   38|

===== FILE: src/services/http/types.ts =====
    1|export interface ApiEnvelope<TData> {
    2|  success: boolean;
    3|  data: TData;
    4|  message?: string;
    5|  meta?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
    6|  errors?: Record<string, string[]> | null;
    7|  code?: string | null;
    8|}
    9|
   10|export interface ApiPaginationMeta {
   11|  total?: number;
   12|  current_page?: number;
   13|  last_page?: number;
   14|  per_page?: number;
   15|}
   16|
   17|/**
   18| * Legacy nested list payload (BE cũ trả `data: { data: [...], meta }`).
   19| * Giữ lại để các service đang đọc kiểu cũ vẫn biên dịch trong khi migrate dần.
   20| */
   21|export interface ApiListPayload<TItem> {
   22|  data: TItem[];
   23|  meta?: ApiPaginationMeta;
   24|}
   25|

===== FILE: src/services/invoice.service.ts =====
    1|import api from './api';
    2|import { ENDPOINTS } from './endpoints';
    3|import { throwIfEnvelopeFailed, unwrapEnvelope } from './http';
    4|import type { CompanyDebtOverview } from '@/types/api/invoice';
    5|import type { Invoice, InvoiceStatusHistory } from '@/types';
    6|
    7|function parsePagedList<T>(body: unknown): { data: T[]; total: number } {
    8|  throwIfEnvelopeFailed(body);
    9|  const envelopeData = unwrapEnvelope<unknown>(body) as
   10|    | T[]
   11|    | { data?: T[]; meta?: { total?: number }; total?: number }
   12|    | null
   13|    | undefined;
   14|
   15|  const metaTotal = (body as { meta?: { total?: number } })?.meta?.total;
   16|
   17|  if (Array.isArray(envelopeData)) {
   18|    return { data: envelopeData, total: metaTotal ?? envelopeData.length };
   19|  }
   20|  if (envelopeData && typeof envelopeData === 'object' && Array.isArray((envelopeData as { data: T[] }).data)) {
   21|    const inner = envelopeData as { data: T[]; meta?: { total?: number }; total?: number };
   22|    return {
   23|      data: inner.data,
   24|      total: inner.meta?.total ?? inner.total ?? metaTotal ?? inner.data.length,
   25|    };
   26|  }
   27|  return { data: [], total: 0 };
   28|}
   29|
   30|export type InvoiceListParams = {
   31|  current?: number;
   32|  pageSize?: number;
   33|  status?: string;
   34|  customer_id?: number;
   35|  date_from?: string;
   36|  date_to?: string;
   37|  search?: string;
   38|};
   39|
   40|class InvoiceService {
   41|  async getList(params?: InvoiceListParams): Promise<{ data: Invoice[]; total: number }> {
   42|    const response = await api.get(ENDPOINTS.invoices.base, {
   43|      params: {
   44|        page: params?.current,
   45|        per_page: params?.pageSize,
   46|        status: params?.status || undefined,
   47|        customer_id: params?.customer_id || undefined,
   48|        date_from: params?.date_from || undefined,
   49|        date_to: params?.date_to || undefined,
   50|        search: params?.search?.trim() || undefined,
   51|      },
   52|    });
   53|    return parsePagedList<Invoice>(response.data);
   54|  }
   55|
   56|  async getDebtOverview(): Promise<CompanyDebtOverview> {
   57|    try {
   58|      const response = await api.get(ENDPOINTS.debtOverview, {
   59|        skipErrorToast: true,
   60|      } as Parameters<typeof api.get>[1]);
   61|      throwIfEnvelopeFailed(response.data);
   62|      return unwrapEnvelope<CompanyDebtOverview>(response.data);
   63|    } catch {
   64|      return {
   65|        total_uncollected: 0,
   66|        overdue_amount: 0,
   67|        revenue_collected: 0,
   68|        unpaid_invoices: 0,
   69|        unpaid_total: 0,
   70|        overdue_invoices: 0,
   71|      };
   72|    }
   73|  }
   74|
   75|  async getStatusHistories(
   76|    invoiceId: number,
   77|    listParams?: { page?: number; per_page?: number },
   78|  ): Promise<{ data: InvoiceStatusHistory[]; total: number }> {
   79|    const response = await api.get(ENDPOINTS.invoices.statusHistories(invoiceId), {
   80|      params: listParams,
   81|    });
   82|    return parsePagedList<InvoiceStatusHistory>(response.data);
   83|  }
   84|
   85|  async issue(id: number): Promise<Invoice> {
   86|    const response = await api.patch(ENDPOINTS.invoices.issue(id));
   87|    throwIfEnvelopeFailed(response.data);
   88|    return unwrapEnvelope<Invoice>(response.data);
   89|  }
   90|
   91|  async sendCqt(id: number): Promise<Invoice> {
   92|    const response = await api.patch(ENDPOINTS.invoices.sendCqt(id));
   93|    throwIfEnvelopeFailed(response.data);
   94|    return unwrapEnvelope<Invoice>(response.data);
   95|  }
   96|
   97|  async markPaid(id: number): Promise<Invoice> {
   98|    const response = await api.patch(ENDPOINTS.invoices.markPaid(id));
   99|    throwIfEnvelopeFailed(response.data);
  100|    return unwrapEnvelope<Invoice>(response.data);

  102|
  103|  async cancel(id: number, cancel_reason: string): Promise<Invoice> {
  104|    const response = await api.patch(ENDPOINTS.invoices.cancel(id), { cancel_reason });
  105|    throwIfEnvelopeFailed(response.data);
  106|    return unwrapEnvelope<Invoice>(response.data);
  107|  }
  108|
  109|  async sendEmail(id: number): Promise<void> {
  110|    const response = await api.post(ENDPOINTS.invoices.sendEmail(id));
  111|    throwIfEnvelopeFailed(response.data);
  112|    unwrapEnvelope(response.data);
  113|  }
  114|
  115|  async downloadPdf(id: number, code?: string): Promise<void> {
  116|    const response = await api.get(ENDPOINTS.invoices.exportPdf(id), { responseType: 'blob' });
  117|    const blob = response.data as Blob;
  118|    const contentDisposition = response.headers['content-disposition'] as string | undefined;
  119|    const matched = contentDisposition?.match(/filename\*?=(?:UTF-8''|")?([^";]+)/i)?.[1];
  120|    const fileName = matched ? decodeURIComponent(matched.replace(/"/g, '')) : `invoice-${code ?? id}.pdf`;
  121|    const objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  122|    const a = document.createElement('a');
  123|    a.href = objectUrl;
  124|    a.download = fileName;
  125|    a.click();
  126|    URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl);
  127|  }
  128|}
  129|
  130|export default new InvoiceService();

    1|import api from '@/services/api';
    2|import type { Permission } from '@/types';

    4|import { unwrapEnvelope } from '@/services/http';
    5|import type { ApiListPayload } from '@/services/http/types';
    6|
    7|function unwrapList(body: unknown): Permission[] {
    8|  const payload = unwrapEnvelope<ApiListPayload<Permission>>(body);
    9|  if (!payload || !Array.isArray(payload.data)) {
   10|    throw new Error('Invalid permissions payload.');
   11|  }
   12|  return payload.data;
   13|}
   14|
   15|/** Paginated index; fetches one page (max per_page 100 on API). */
   16|export async function fetchPermissionsPage(page = 1, perPage = 100): Promise<Permission[]> {
   17|  const { data } = await api.get(ENDPOINTS.roles.permissions, { params: { page, per_page: perPage } });
   18|  return unwrapList(data);
   19|}

   22|  const { data } = await api.get(ENDPOINTS.roles.permissionById(permissionId));

   20|
   21|function sumPayrollNet(details: Payroll['details']): number {
   22|  return (details ?? []).reduce((total, detail) => total + Number(detail.net_salary ?? 0), 0);
   23|}

  120|  async getPayrollSummary(
  121|    companyId: number,
  122|    month?: number,
  123|    year?: number
  124|  ): Promise<ApiResponse<PayrollSummaryData | null>> {
  125|    const m = month ?? new Date().getMonth() + 1;
  126|    const y = year ?? new Date().getFullYear();
  127|    const response = await payrollService.getAll({
  128|      page: 1,
  129|      per_page: 25,
  130|      company_id: companyId,
  131|      month: m,
  132|      year: y,
  133|    });
  134|
  135|    if (!response.success || !response.data) {
  136|      return response as unknown as ApiResponse<PayrollSummaryData | null>;
  137|    }
  138|
  139|    const payroll =
  140|      response.data.data.find((item) => item.company_id === companyId && item.month === m && item.year === y) ??
  141|      response.data.data[0] ??
  142|      null;
  143|
  144|    if (!payroll) {
  145|      return { success: true, message: response.message, data: null };
  146|    }
  147|
  148|    let detailedPayroll = payroll;
  149|    if (!detailedPayroll.details || detailedPayroll.details.length === 0) {
  150|      const detailResponse = await payrollService.getById(detailedPayroll.id);
  151|      if (detailResponse.success && detailResponse.data) {
  152|        detailedPayroll = detailResponse.data;
  153|      }
  154|    }
  155|
  156|    const details = detailedPayroll.details ?? [];
  157|    return {
  158|      success: true,
  159|      message: response.message,
  160|      data: {
  161|        payroll: detailedPayroll,
  162|        total_net: sumPayrollNet(details),
  163|        employees_count: details.length,
  164|      },
  165|    };
  166|  }

===== FILE: src/services/salary-adjustment.service.ts =====
    1|import api from './api';
    2|import { ENDPOINTS } from './endpoints';
    3|import { throwIfEnvelopeFailed, unwrapEnvelope } from './http';
    4|import type { SalaryAdjustment, SalaryAdjustmentType } from '@/types/domain/payroll';
    5|
    6|type ListParams = {
    7|  page?: number;
    8|  per_page?: number;
    9|  month?: number;
   10|  year?: number;
   11|  payroll_id?: number;
   12|  driver_id?: number;
   13|};
   14|
   15|function parseList(body: unknown): { data: SalaryAdjustment[]; total: number } {
   16|  throwIfEnvelopeFailed(body);
   17|  const inner = unwrapEnvelope<unknown>(body) as
   18|    | SalaryAdjustment[]
   19|    | { data?: SalaryAdjustment[]; meta?: { total?: number } }
   20|    | null
   21|    | undefined;
   22|  const metaTotal = (body as { meta?: { total?: number } })?.meta?.total;
   23|  if (Array.isArray(inner)) {
   24|    return { data: inner, total: metaTotal ?? inner.length };
   25|  }
   26|  if (inner && typeof inner === 'object' && Array.isArray((inner as { data: SalaryAdjustment[] }).data)) {
   27|    const box = inner as { data: SalaryAdjustment[]; meta?: { total?: number } };
   28|    return { data: box.data, total: box.meta?.total ?? metaTotal ?? box.data.length };
   29|  }
   30|  return { data: [], total: 0 };
   31|}
   32|
   33|export interface CreateSalaryAdjustmentPayload {
   34|  type: SalaryAdjustmentType;
   35|  amount: number;
   36|  reason: string;
   37|  applied_date: string;
   38|  payroll_id?: number;
   39|  driver_id?: number;
   40|  employee_id?: number;
   41|}
   42|
   43|class SalaryAdjustmentService {
   44|  async list(params?: ListParams): Promise<{ data: SalaryAdjustment[]; total: number }> {
   45|    const response = await api.get(ENDPOINTS.salaryAdjustments.base, { params });
   46|    return parseList(response.data);
   47|  }
   48|
   49|  async create(payload: CreateSalaryAdjustmentPayload): Promise<SalaryAdjustment> {
   50|    const response = await api.post(ENDPOINTS.salaryAdjustments.base, payload);
   51|    throwIfEnvelopeFailed(response.data);
   52|    return unwrapEnvelope<SalaryAdjustment>(response.data);
   53|  }
   54|
   55|  async cancel(id: number): Promise<SalaryAdjustment> {
   56|    const response = await api.patch(ENDPOINTS.salaryAdjustments.cancel(id), {});
   57|    throwIfEnvelopeFailed(response.data);
   58|    return unwrapEnvelope<SalaryAdjustment>(response.data);
   59|  }

   22|function parsePagedList<T>(body: unknown): { data: T[]; total: number } {
   23|  throwIfEnvelopeFailed(body);
   24|  const envelopeData = unwrapEnvelope<unknown>(body) as
   25|    | T[]
   26|    | { data?: T[]; meta?: { total?: number }; total?: number }
   27|    | null
   28|    | undefined;
   29|
   30|  const metaTotal = (body as { meta?: { total?: number } })?.meta?.total;
   31|
   32|  if (Array.isArray(envelopeData)) {
   33|    return { data: envelopeData, total: metaTotal ?? envelopeData.length };
   34|  }
   35|  if (envelopeData && typeof envelopeData === 'object' && Array.isArray((envelopeData as { data: T[] }).data)) {
   36|    const inner = envelopeData as { data: T[]; meta?: { total?: number }; total?: number };
   37|    return {
   38|      data: inner.data,
   39|      total: inner.meta?.total ?? inner.total ?? metaTotal ?? inner.data.length,
   40|    };
   41|  }
   42|  return { data: [], total: 0 };
   43|}

===== FILE: src/services/workforce-ops.service.ts =====
    1|/**
    2| * WorkforceOpsService — Facade for workforce-related operations.
    3| * 
    4| * **Architecture Pattern: Convenience Wrapper**
    5| * This service intentionally duplicates and wraps methods from specialized services:
    6| * - LeaveService (leave requests, approvals)
    7| * - OvertimeService (overtime requests, approvals)
    8| * - DriverScheduleService (driver schedules, approvals)
    9| * - Plus additional workforce-specific endpoints
   10| * 
   11| * **Why Duplication?**
   12| * Many UI components (workforce dashboard, dashboards) need to orchestrate multiple
   13| * resource types (leaves, overtimes, schedules) from a single facade.
   14| * This prevents verbose multi-service imports in component files.
   15| * 
   16| * **Trade-off:**
   17| * - Pros: Simpler component imports, single entry point
   18| * - Cons: Logic duplication if individual service changes
   19| * 
   20| * **Migration Path (Future):**
   21| * If service consolidation needed, could refactor to use composition:
   22| * `​``typescript
   23| * class WorkforceOpsService {
   24| *   constructor(
   25| *     private leaveService: LeaveService,
   26| *     private overtimeService: OvertimeService,
   27| *   ) {}
   28| *   
   29| *   async approveLeave(id: number) {
   30| *     return this.leaveService.approve(id);
   31| *   }
   32| * }
   33| * `​``
   34| * 
   35| * Keep duplication as-is for now (simpler, no DI needed), revisit in Q3 2026.
   36| */
   37|
   38|import api from './api';

   53|type ListResult<T> = { data: T[]; total: number };
   54|
   55|/** Open API: https://date.nager.at — Public Holidays, không cần API key. */
   56|const NAGER_PUBLIC_HOLIDAYS_BASE = 'https://date.nager.at/api/v3/PublicHolidays';
   57|
   58|interface NagerPublicHolidayRow {
   59|  date: string;
   60|  localName: string;
   61|  name: string;
   62|  countryCode: string;
   63|  types?: string[];
   64|  counties?: string[] | null;
   65|}
   66|
   67|function stableHolidayId(date: string, index: number): number {
   68|  let h = 0;
   69|  for (let i = 0; i < date.length; i += 1) {
   70|    h = (Math.imul(31, h) + date.charCodeAt(i)) | 0;
   71|  }
   72|  return (Math.abs(h) * 10007 + index) % 2_000_000_000 + 1;
   73|}
   74|
   75|function mapNagerRowsToPublicHolidays(rows: NagerPublicHolidayRow[]): PublicHoliday[] {
   76|  return rows.map((row, index) => {
   77|    const types = row.types ?? [];
   78|    const hasCounties = Array.isArray(row.counties) && row.counties.length > 0;
   79|    const holiday_type: PublicHoliday['holiday_type'] = hasCounties
   80|      ? 'regional'
   81|      : types.includes('Bank') || types.includes('School')
   82|        ? 'compensatory'
   83|        : 'national';
   84|    const dateKey = String(row.date).slice(0, 10);
   85|    return {
   86|      id: stableHolidayId(dateKey, index),
   87|      date: dateKey,
   88|      name: (row.localName && row.localName.trim()) || row.name,
   89|      holiday_type,
   90|    };
   91|  });
   92|}
   93|
   94|const getListData = <T>(body: unknown): ListResult<T> => {
   95|  const payload = unwrapEnvelope<ApiListPayload<T>>(body);
   96|  if (!payload || !Array.isArray(payload.data)) {
   97|    throw new Error('Invalid API list payload.');
   98|  }
   99|  return { data: payload.data, total: payload.meta?.total ?? payload.data.length };
  100|};
  101|
  102|const getListDataCompat = <T>(body: unknown): ListResult<T> => {
  103|  try {
  104|    return getListData<T>(body);
  105|  } catch {
  106|    const direct = body as { data?: T[]; meta?: { total?: number } } | undefined;
  107|    const rows = Array.isArray(direct?.data) ? direct.data : [];
  108|    return { data: rows, total: direct?.meta?.total ?? rows.length };
  109|  }
  110|};

  193|  /**
  194|   * Danh sách ngày lễ theo năm — ưu tiên [Nager.Date](https://date.nager.at) (miễn phí, VN mặc định),
  195|   * fallback backend `/public-holidays` nếu gọi Nager thất bại.
  196|   */
  197|  async listPublicHolidays(params: { year: number; country_code?: string }): Promise<{ data: PublicHoliday[] }> {
  198|    const country = (params.country_code ?? 'VN').toUpperCase();
  199|    try {
  200|      const url = `${NAGER_PUBLIC_HOLIDAYS_BASE}/${params.year}/${country}`;
  201|      const res = await fetch(url, { method: 'GET', headers: { Accept: 'application/json' } });
  202|      if (!res.ok) {
  203|        throw new Error(`Nager.Date HTTP ${res.status}`);
  204|      }
  205|      const rows = (await res.json()) as unknown;
  206|      if (!Array.isArray(rows)) {
  207|        throw new Error('Nager.Date: invalid JSON');
  208|      }
  209|      return { data: mapNagerRowsToPublicHolidays(rows as NagerPublicHolidayRow[]) };
  210|    } catch {
  211|      const response = await api.get(ENDPOINTS.publicHolidays.list, { params });
  212|      const body = response.data as { data?: PublicHoliday[] };
  213|      return { data: Array.isArray(body?.data) ? body.data : [] };
  214|    }
  215|  }

    2|  return {
    3|    all: [resource] as const,
    4|    lists: () => [resource, 'list'] as const,
    5|    list: (params?: Record<string, unknown>) => [resource, 'list', params ?? {}] as const,
    6|    details: () => [resource, 'detail'] as const,

    8|  };

    6|
    7|interface AppState {
    8|  theme: 'light' | 'dark';
    9|  sidebarOpen: boolean;
   10|  locale: Locale;
   11|  compactMode: boolean;
   12|  notifyEmail: boolean;
   13|  notifyPush: boolean;
   14|  notifySound: boolean;
   15|  toggleTheme: () => void;
   16|  toggleSidebar: () => void;
   17|  setSidebarOpen: (open: boolean) => void;
   18|  setLocale: (locale: Locale) => void;
   19|  setCompactMode: (value: boolean) => void;
   20|  setNotifyEmail: (value: boolean) => void;
   21|  setNotifyPush: (value: boolean) => void;
   22|  setNotifySound: (value: boolean) => void;
   23|  resetUiPreferences: () => void;
   24|}
   25|
   26|export const useAppStore = create<AppState>()(
   27|  persist(
   28|    (set) => ({
   29|      theme: 'light',
   30|      sidebarOpen: true,
   31|      locale: 'vi' as Locale,
   32|      compactMode: false,
   33|      notifyEmail: true,
   34|      notifyPush: true,
   35|      notifySound: false,
   36|
   37|      toggleTheme: () => {
   38|        set((state) => ({
   39|          theme: state.theme === 'light' ? 'dark' : 'light',
   40|        }));
   41|      },
   42|
   43|      toggleSidebar: () => {

   45|      },

   48|        set({ sidebarOpen: open });
   49|      },
