===== FILE: src/stores/auth.store.ts =====
    1|import { create } from 'zustand';
    2|import { persist } from 'zustand/middleware';
    3|import { createSafeStorage } from '@/lib/safe-storage';
    4|import { queryClient } from '@/lib/query-client';
    5|import { Tenant, User } from '@/types';
    6|import authService from '@/services/auth.service';
    7|import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
    8|import { STORAGE_KEYS } from '@/utils/constants';
    9|import {
   10|  clearAuthToken,
   11|  clearTenantId,
   12|  getTenantId,
   13|  setTenantId,
   14|} from '@/lib/auth-session';
   15|
   16|interface AuthState {
   17|  user: User | null;
   18|  isAuthenticated: boolean;
   19|  isLoading: boolean;
   20|  /** ID tenant đang active trong session này. null = chưa chọn (chỉ xảy ra khi user thuộc nhiều tenant). */
   21|  currentTenantId: number | null;
   22|  /** Danh sách tenant chờ user chọn sau khi login (chỉ có khi user thuộc ≥ 2 tenant). */
   23|  pendingTenants: Tenant[];
   24|  login: (email: string, password: string, rememberMe?: boolean) => Promise<void>;
   25|  socialLogin: (credentials: { provider: 'google' | 'facebook' | 'apple'; access_token?: string; id_token?: string }) => Promise<void>;
   26|  logout: () => Promise<void>;
   27|  checkAuth: () => Promise<void>;
   28|  setUser: (user: User | null) => void;
   29|  /** Lưu token + user khi hoàn tất luồng ngoài form email/password (nếu có). */
   30|  setSession: (user: User, token?: string) => void;
   31|  /** Chọn tenant sau khi login — ghi vào localStorage và cập nhật state. */
   32|  selectTenant: (tenantId: number) => void;
   33|  /** Xoá tenant hiện tại để switch sang tenant khác (đưa user về /select-tenant). */
   34|  switchTenant: () => void;
   35|}
   36|
   37|const resolveTenantAfterAuth = (
   38|  user: User,
   39|  storedTenantId: number | null,
   40|): { currentTenantId: number | null; pendingTenants: Tenant[] } => {
   41|  const tenants = user.tenants ?? [];
   42|
   43|  if (tenants.length === 0) {
   44|    // Backend chưa trả tenants (single-tenant legacy) — không block truy cập
   45|    return { currentTenantId: null, pendingTenants: [] };
   46|  }
   47|
   48|  const storedIsValid = storedTenantId != null && tenants.some((t) => t.id === storedTenantId);
   49|  if (storedIsValid) {
   50|    setTenantId(storedTenantId!);
   51|    return { currentTenantId: storedTenantId, pendingTenants: [] };
   52|  }
   53|
   54|  if (tenants.length === 1) {
   55|    setTenantId(tenants[0].id);
   56|    return { currentTenantId: tenants[0].id, pendingTenants: [] };
   57|  }
   58|
   59|  // Nhiều tenant — cần user chọn
   60|  clearTenantId();
   61|  return { currentTenantId: null, pendingTenants: tenants };
   62|};
   63|
   64|export const useAuthStore = create<AuthState>()(
   65|  persist(
   66|    (set) => ({
   67|      user: null,
   68|      isAuthenticated: false,
   69|      isLoading: false,
   70|      currentTenantId: null,
   71|      pendingTenants: [],
   72|
   73|      login: async (email: string, password: string) => {
   74|        try {
   75|          set({ isLoading: true });
   76|          
   77|          const response = await authService.login({ email, password });
   78|          if (response.success && response.data?.user) {
   79|            const user: User = { 
   80|              ...response.data.user, 
   81|              tenants: (response.data as any).tenants ?? response.data.user.tenants ?? [] 
   82|            };
   83|            const { currentTenantId, pendingTenants } = resolveTenantAfterAuth(user, null);
   84|
   85|            set({ user, isAuthenticated: true, isLoading: false, currentTenantId, pendingTenants });
   86|            toast.success('Login successful');
   87|          }
   88|        } catch (error) {
   89|          set({ isLoading: false });
   90|          throw error;
   91|        }
   92|      },
   93|
   94|      socialLogin: async (credentials: { provider: 'google' | 'facebook' | 'apple'; access_token?: string; id_token?: string }) => {
   95|        try {
   96|          set({ isLoading: true });
   97|
   98|          const response = await authService.socialLogin(credentials);
   99|          if (response.success && response.data?.user) {
  100|            const user: User = { 
  101|              ...response.data.user, 
  102|              tenants: (response.data as any).tenants ?? response.data.user.tenants ?? [] 
  103|            };
  104|            const { currentTenantId, pendingTenants } = resolveTenantAfterAuth(user, null);
  105|
  106|            set({ user, isAuthenticated: true, isLoading: false, currentTenantId, pendingTenants });
  107|            toast.success('Login successful');
  108|          }
  109|        } catch (error) {
  110|          set({ isLoading: false });
  111|          throw error;
  112|        }
  113|      },
  114|
  115|      logout: async () => {
  116|        try {
  117|          await authService.logout();
  118|        } catch {
  119|          // no-op
  120|        } finally {
  121|          clearAuthToken();
  122|          set({ user: null, isAuthenticated: false, currentTenantId: null, pendingTenants: [] });
  123|          toast.success('Logged out successfully');
  124|        }
  125|      },
  126|
  127|      checkAuth: async () => {
  128|        try {
  129|          set({ isLoading: true });
  130|          const response = await authService.getCurrentUser();
  131|
  132|          const user = authService.getUserFromMeResponse(response);
  133|          if (response.success && user) {
  134|            const storedTenantId = getTenantId();
  135|            const { currentTenantId, pendingTenants } = resolveTenantAfterAuth(user, storedTenantId);
  136|            set({ user, isAuthenticated: true, isLoading: false, currentTenantId, pendingTenants });
  137|          } else {
  138|            set({ user: null, isAuthenticated: false, isLoading: false, currentTenantId: null, pendingTenants: [] });
  139|          }
  140|        } catch {
  141|          clearAuthToken();
  142|          set({ user: null, isAuthenticated: false, isLoading: false, currentTenantId: null, pendingTenants: [] });
  143|        }
  144|      },
  145|
  146|      setUser: (user: User | null) => {
  147|        set({ user, isAuthenticated: !!user });
  148|      },
  149|
  150|      setSession: (user: User) => {
  151|        const storedTenantId = getTenantId();
  152|        const { currentTenantId, pendingTenants } = resolveTenantAfterAuth(user, storedTenantId);
  153|        set({ user, isAuthenticated: true, isLoading: false, currentTenantId, pendingTenants });
  154|      },
  155|
  156|      selectTenant: (tenantId: number) => {
  157|        setTenantId(tenantId);
  158|        // Clear all cached queries so the new tenant's data loads fresh
  159|        queryClient.clear();
  160|        set({ currentTenantId: tenantId, pendingTenants: [] });
  161|      },
  162|
  163|      switchTenant: () => {
  164|        clearTenantId();
  165|        // Clear cache — user is leaving this tenant's data context
  166|        queryClient.clear();
  167|        set((state) => ({
  168|          currentTenantId: null,
  169|          pendingTenants: state.user?.tenants ?? [],
  170|        }));
  171|      },
  172|    }),
  173|    {
  174|      name: STORAGE_KEYS.AUTH_STORAGE,
  175|      storage: createSafeStorage(),
  176|      partialize: (state) => ({
  177|        user: state.user,
  178|        isAuthenticated: state.isAuthenticated,
  179|        currentTenantId: state.currentTenantId,
  180|      }),
  181|    }
  182|  )
  183|);
  184|

===== FILE: src/utils/authPermissions.ts =====
    1|import type { User, UserPermissionGrant } from '@/types';
    2|
    3|const normalize = (r: string) => r.trim().toLowerCase();
    4|
    5|type PermissionGrant = UserPermissionGrant | string;
    6|
    7|const matchesPermissionGrant = (grant: PermissionGrant, permission: string): boolean => {
    8|  const expected = normalize(permission);
    9|
   10|  if (typeof grant === 'string') {
   11|    return normalize(grant) === expected;
   12|  }
   13|
   14|  if (grant && typeof grant === 'object') {
   15|    const record = grant as {
   16|      code?: string;
   17|      name?: string;
   18|      module?: string;
   19|      action?: string;
   20|    };
   21|
   22|    if (record.code && normalize(record.code) === expected) return true;
   23|    if (record.name && normalize(record.name) === expected) return true;
   24|    if (record.module && record.action && `${normalize(record.module)}.${normalize(record.action)}` === expected) return true;
   25|
   26|    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(record, permission)) {
   27|      return Boolean((record as Record<string, unknown>)[permission]);
   28|    }
   29|  }
   30|
   31|  return false;
   32|};
   33|
   34|const hasUserPermissions = (user: User | null, permission: string): boolean => {
   35|  const grants = user?.user_permissions;
   36|  if (!grants) return false;
   37|
   38|  if (Array.isArray(grants)) {
   39|    const match = (grants as PermissionGrant[]).some((grant) => matchesPermissionGrant(grant, permission));
   40|    if (!match && user && user.email) {
   41|      console.debug(`[Permission] User ${user.email} lacks '${permission}'`, {
   42|        roles: user.roles?.map(r => r.name),
   43|        permissionMatrixSize: grants.length,
   44|      });
   45|    }
   46|    return match;
   47|  }
   48|
   49|  // If `user_permissions` is a record (module -> actions), support nested checks
   50|  const normalized = normalize(permission);
   51|  if (permission.includes('.')) {
   52|    const [moduleKey, actionKey] = permission.split('.', 2);
   53|    const module = (grants as Record<string, unknown>)[moduleKey] ?? (grants as Record<string, unknown>)[normalize(moduleKey)];
   54|    if (module == null) {
   55|      console.debug(`[Permission] Module '${moduleKey}' not in permission matrix for ${user?.email}`);
   56|      return false;
   57|    }
   58|    if (typeof module === 'object') {
   59|      const m = module as Record<string, unknown>;
   60|      return Boolean(m[actionKey] ?? m[normalize(actionKey)]);
   61|    }
   62|    // module is a boolean flag granting all actions
   63|    return Boolean(module);
   64|  }
   65|
   66|  const v = (grants as Record<string, unknown>)[permission] ?? (grants as Record<string, unknown>)[normalized];
   67|  if (v == null) return false;
   68|  if (typeof v === 'object') {
   69|    // module object: return true if any action granted
   70|    return Object.values(v).some((x) => Boolean(x));
   71|  }
   72|  return Boolean(v);
   73|};
   74|
   75|export const userHasRole = (user: User | null, role: string): boolean => {
   76|  const expected = normalize(role);
   77|  return Boolean(user?.roles?.some((r) => {
   78|    const roleCode = (r as { code?: string }).code ?? r.name;
   79|    return normalize(roleCode) === expected || normalize(r.name) === expected;
   80|  }));
   81|};
   82|
   83|export const userHasPermission = (user: User | null, permission: string): boolean => {
   84|  if (userHasRole(user, 'admin') || userHasRole(user, 'super_admin') || userHasRole(user, 'admin_company')) {
   85|    return true;
   86|  }
   87|
   88|  return hasUserPermissions(user, permission);
   89|};
   90|

   19|  id: z.union([z.string(), z.number()]).optional(),
   20|  session_id: z.union([z.string(), z.number()]).optional(),
   21|  role: z.string().optional(),

   36|const isRecord = (value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> =>
   37|  typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
   38|
   39|const getString = (obj: Record<string, unknown>, key: string): string | undefined => {
   40|  const value = obj[key];
   41|  if (typeof value === 'string' && value.trim()) return value;
   42|  if (typeof value === 'number' || typeof value === 'boolean') return String(value);
   43|  return undefined;
   44|};
   45|
   46|const getBoolean = (obj: Record<string, unknown>, key: string): boolean | undefined => {
   47|  const value = obj[key];
   48|  return typeof value === 'boolean' ? value : undefined;
   49|};
   50|
   51|const getObject = (obj: Record<string, unknown>, key: string): Record<string, unknown> | undefined => {
   52|  const value = obj[key];
   53|  return isRecord(value) ? value : undefined;
   54|};
   55|
   56|const parseChatMessage = (value: unknown): ChatMessage | undefined => {
   57|  const parsed = messageSchema.safeParse(value);
   58|  return parsed.success ? (parsed.data as ChatMessage) : undefined;
   59|};
   60|
   61|const parseChatSession = (value: unknown): ChatSession | undefined => {
   62|  const parsed = sessionSchema.safeParse(value);
   63|  return parsed.success ? (parsed.data as ChatSession) : undefined;
   64|};
   65|
   66|const resolveSessionId = (data: Record<string, unknown>, session?: ChatSession): string | undefined =>
   67|  getString(data, 'session_id') ||
   68|  (session
   69|    ? typeof session.session_id === 'string'
   70|      ? session.session_id
   71|      : typeof session.session_id === 'number'
   72|        ? String(session.session_id)
   73|        : typeof session.id === 'string'
   74|          ? session.id
   75|          : typeof session.id === 'number'
   76|            ? String(session.id)
   77|            : undefined
   78|    : undefined);
   79|
   80|const toArrayLike = (payload: unknown): unknown[] => {
   81|  if (Array.isArray(payload)) return payload;
   82|  if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object') return [];
   83|
   84|  const data = payload as Record<string, unknown>;
   85|  const candidates = [data.data, data.messages, data.sessions, data.items, data.list, data.results];
   86|
   87|  for (const candidate of candidates) {
   88|    if (Array.isArray(candidate)) return candidate;
   89|    if (candidate && typeof candidate === 'object') {
   90|      const nested = toArrayLike(candidate);
   91|      if (nested.length > 0) return nested;
   92|    }
   93|  }
   94|
   95|  return [];
   96|};
   97|
   98|export const normalizeChatSessions = (payload: unknown): ChatSession[] =>
   99|  toArrayLike(payload)
  100|    .map((item) => sessionSchema.safeParse(item))
  101|    .filter((item) => item.success)
  102|    .map((item) => item.data as ChatSession);
  103|
  104|export const normalizeChatMessages = (payload: unknown): ChatMessage[] =>
  105|  toArrayLike(payload)

  107|    .filter((item) => item.success)
  108|    .map((item) => item.data as ChatMessage);

  110|export const normalizeSendMessagePayload = (payload: unknown): {
  111|  session_id?: string;
  112|  session?: ChatSession;
  113|  message?: ChatMessage;
  114|  response_text?: string;
  115|  model?: string;
  116|  cached?: boolean;
  117|  guarded?: boolean;
  118|} => {
  119|  if (!isRecord(payload)) return {};
  120|
  121|  const data = payload;
  122|  const sessionRaw = data.session;
  123|  const messageRaw = data.message;
  124|
  125|  const sessionParsed = parseChatSession(sessionRaw);
  126|  const messageParsed = parseChatMessage(messageRaw);
  127|
  128|  const responseText = getString(data, 'response_text') ||
  129|    (isRecord(messageRaw)
  130|      ? getString(messageRaw, 'response') || getString(messageRaw, 'response_text')
  131|      : undefined);
  132|
  133|  const model =
  134|    (messageParsed?.model && String(messageParsed.model)) ||
  135|    getString(data, 'model');
  136|
  137|  const sessionId = resolveSessionId(data, sessionParsed);
  138|
  139|  return {
  140|    session_id: sessionId,
  141|    session: sessionParsed,
  142|    message: messageParsed,
  143|    response_text: responseText,
  144|    model,
  145|    cached: typeof data.cached === 'boolean' ? data.cached : undefined,
  146|    guarded: typeof data.guarded === 'boolean' ? data.guarded : undefined,
  147|  };
  148|};

  150|export const normalizeSendMessageDonePayload = (payload: unknown): {
  151|  session_id?: string;
  152|  session?: ChatSession;
  153|  message?: ChatMessage;
  154|  response_text?: string;
  155|  model?: string;
  156|  cached?: boolean;
  157|  guarded?: boolean;
  158|} => {
  159|  if (!isRecord(payload)) return {};
  160|
  161|  const result = getObject(payload, 'result');
  162|  const resultData = result ? getObject(result, 'data') : undefined;
  163|  const data = getObject(payload, 'data');
  164|
  165|  const base = normalizeSendMessagePayload(resultData ?? data ?? payload);
  166|
  167|  const responseText =
  168|    getString(payload, 'response_text') ||
  169|    (resultData ? getString(resultData, 'response_text') : undefined) ||
  170|    (data ? getString(data, 'response_text') : undefined) ||
  171|    (resultData && getObject(resultData, 'message') ? getString(getObject(resultData, 'message')!, 'response') : undefined) ||
  172|    (data && getObject(data, 'message') ? getString(getObject(data, 'message')!, 'response') : undefined) ||
  173|    base.response_text;
  174|
  175|  const message =
  176|    base.message ||
  177|    (resultData ? parseChatMessage(resultData.message) : undefined) ||
  178|    (data ? parseChatMessage(data.message) : undefined) ||
  179|    parseChatMessage(payload.message);
  180|
  181|  const model =
  182|    (message?.model && String(message.model)) ||
  183|    base.model ||
  184|    getString(payload, 'model') ||
  185|    (resultData ? getString(resultData, 'model') : undefined) ||
  186|    (data ? getString(data, 'model') : undefined);
  187|
  188|  const session =
  189|    base.session ||
  190|    (resultData ? parseChatSession(resultData.session) : undefined) ||
  191|    (data ? parseChatSession(data.session) : undefined) ||
  192|    parseChatSession(payload.session);
  193|
  194|  const sessionId =
  195|    base.session_id ||
  196|    getString(payload, 'session_id') ||
  197|    (resultData ? getString(resultData, 'session_id') : undefined) ||
  198|    (data ? getString(data, 'session_id') : undefined) ||
  199|    (session
  200|      ? typeof session.session_id === 'string'
  201|        ? session.session_id
  202|        : typeof session.session_id === 'number'
  203|          ? String(session.session_id)
  204|          : typeof session.id === 'string'
  205|            ? session.id
  206|            : typeof session.id === 'number'
  207|              ? String(session.id)
  208|              : undefined
  209|      : undefined);
  210|
  211|  return {
  212|    session_id: sessionId,
  213|    session,
  214|    message,
  215|    response_text: responseText,
  216|    model,
  217|    cached:
  218|      getBoolean(payload, 'cached') ??
  219|      (resultData ? getBoolean(resultData, 'cached') : undefined) ??
  220|      (data ? getBoolean(data, 'cached') : undefined) ??
  221|      base.cached,
  222|    guarded:
  223|      getBoolean(payload, 'guarded') ??
  224|      (resultData ? getBoolean(resultData, 'guarded') : undefined) ??
  225|      (data ? getBoolean(data, 'guarded') : undefined) ??
  226|      base.guarded,
  227|  };
  228|};

  230|/** Prefer `response_text`, then nested `message.response` — matches stream `done` handling in FRONTEND_CHAT_HANDOFF. */
  231|export const resolveStreamDoneAssistantText = (rawDone: unknown): string => {
  232|  const normalized = normalizeSendMessageDonePayload(rawDone);
  233|  const direct = normalized.response_text?.trim();
  234|  if (direct) return direct;

===== FILE: src/utils/csvDownload.ts =====
    1|/** UTF-8 BOM để Excel mở đúng tiếng Việt. */
    2|
    3|export function escapeCsvCell(value: string | number | null | undefined): string {
    4|  if (value === null || value === undefined) return '';
    5|  const s = String(value);
    6|  if (/[",\r\n]/.test(s)) {
    7|    return `"${s.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
    8|  }
    9|  return s;
   10|}
   11|
   12|export function downloadCsvRows(filename: string, rows: (string | number | null | undefined)[][]): void {
   13|  const BOM = '\uFEFF';
   14|  const text = rows.map((row) => row.map(escapeCsvCell).join(',')).join('\r\n');
   15|  const blob = new Blob([BOM + text], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
   16|  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
   17|  const a = document.createElement('a');
   18|  a.href = url;
   19|  a.download = filename;
   20|  a.click();
   21|  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
   22|}

===== FILE: src/utils/dedupe.ts =====
    1|const MAX_ENTRIES = 50;
    2|
    3|/**
    4| * Returns a shouldShow(key) function that returns true at most once per windowMs per key.
    5| * Bounded at MAX_ENTRIES to prevent unbounded memory growth.
    6| */
    7|export function createDedupedCaller(windowMs: number) {
    8|  const timestamps = new Map<string, number>();
    9|
   10|  return function shouldShow(key: string): boolean {
   11|    const now = Date.now();
   12|    const last = timestamps.get(key);
   13|    if (last !== undefined && now - last < windowMs) return false;
   14|
   15|    if (timestamps.size >= MAX_ENTRIES) {
   16|      let oldestKey = '';
   17|      let oldestTime = Infinity;
   18|      timestamps.forEach((t, k) => { if (t < oldestTime) { oldestTime = t; oldestKey = k; } });
   19|      if (oldestKey) timestamps.delete(oldestKey);
   20|    }
   21|
   22|    timestamps.set(key, now);
   23|    return true;
   24|  };
   25|}
   26|

    1|/**
    2| * Centralized error handling utilities
    3| * 
    4| * This module provides utilities for consistent error handling
    5| * across the application. Toast notifications are handled by
    6| * the Axios interceptor in services/api.ts
    7| */
    8|
    9|import { AxiosError } from 'axios';
   10|
   11|export type ErrorMode = 'global' | 'local' | 'silent';
   12|
   13|/** Laravel-style + spec-style `{ error: { code, message, details } }`. */
   14|export interface ApiErrorResponse {
   15|  message?: string;
   16|  code?: string;
   17|  errors?: Record<string, string[]>;
   18|  error?: {
   19|    code?: string;
   20|    message?: string;
   21|    details?: Record<string, string[] | string> | string;
   22|  };
   23|}
   24|
   25|const GLOBAL_TECHNICAL_STATUSES = new Set([401, 403]);
   26|const GLOBAL_POLICY_STATUSES = new Set([409, 422]);
   27|
   28|/**
   29| * Check if toast has already been shown for this error
   30| */
   31|export const isToastShown = (error: unknown): boolean => {
   32|  if (error && typeof error === 'object') {
   33|    const errorWithFlag = error as { __toastShown?: boolean };
   34|    return !!errorWithFlag.__toastShown;
   35|  }
   36|  return false;
   37|};
   38|
   39|/**
   40| * Extract error message from Axios error
   41| */
   42|export const getErrorMessage = (error: unknown): string => {
   43|  if (error && typeof error === 'object' && 'response' in error) {
   44|    const axiosError = error as AxiosError<ApiErrorResponse>;
   45|    const data = axiosError.response?.data;
   46|    const nested = data?.error && typeof data.error === 'object' ? data.error.message : undefined;
   47|    return nested || data?.message || 'An error occurred';
   48|  }
   49|
   50|  if (error instanceof Error && error.message) {
   51|    return error.message;
   52|  }
   53|
   54|  return 'An error occurred';
   55|};
   56|
   57|/**
   58| * Extract HTTP status from Axios error
   59| */
   60|export const getErrorStatus = (error: unknown): number | undefined => {
   61|  if (error && typeof error === 'object' && 'response' in error) {
   62|    const axiosError = error as AxiosError<ApiErrorResponse>;
   63|    return axiosError.response?.status;
   64|  }
   65|
   66|  return undefined;
   67|};
   68|
   69|/**
   70| * Extract backend/business error code from response
   71| */
   72|export const getErrorCode = (error: unknown): string | undefined => {
   73|  if (error && typeof error === 'object' && 'response' in error) {
   74|    const axiosError = error as AxiosError<ApiErrorResponse>;
   75|    const data = axiosError.response?.data;
   76|    return data?.error?.code ?? data?.code;
   77|  }
   78|
   79|  return undefined;
   80|};
   81|
   82|/**
   83| * Extract validation errors from Axios error
   84| */
   85|function flattenDetails(details: Record<string, string[] | string>): Record<string, string> {
   86|  const out: Record<string, string> = {};
   87|  Object.entries(details).forEach(([key, value]) => {
   88|    out[key] = Array.isArray(value) ? (value[0] ?? '') : String(value);
   89|  });
   90|  return out;
   91|}
   92|
   93|export const getValidationErrors = (error: unknown): Record<string, string> => {
   94|  if (error && typeof error === 'object' && 'response' in error) {
   95|    const axiosError = error as AxiosError<ApiErrorResponse>;
   96|    const data = axiosError.response?.data;
   97|    const errors = data?.errors;
   98|    if (errors) {
   99|      const formattedErrors: Record<string, string> = {};
  100|      Object.entries(errors).forEach(([key, value]) => {
  101|        formattedErrors[key] = Array.isArray(value) ? value[0] : String(value);
  102|      });
  103|      return formattedErrors;
  104|    }
  105|    const details = data?.error?.details;
  106|    if (details && typeof details === 'object' && !Array.isArray(details)) {
  107|      return flattenDetails(details as Record<string, string[] | string>);
  108|    }
  109|  }
  110|  return {};
  111|};
  112|
  113|/**
  114| * Check if error is a validation error (422)
  115| */
  116|export const isValidationError = (error: unknown): boolean => {
  117|  return getErrorStatus(error) === 422;
  118|};
  119|
  120|/**
  121| * Check if error is a network error
  122| */
  123|export const isNetworkError = (error: unknown): boolean => {
  124|  if (error && typeof error === 'object' && 'request' in error) {
  125|    const axiosError = error as AxiosError;
  126|    return !axiosError.response && !!axiosError.request;
  127|  }
  128|  return false;
  129|};
  130|
  131|/**
  132| * Check if error is a timeout error
  133| */
  134|export const isTimeoutError = (error: unknown): boolean => {
  135|  if (error && typeof error === 'object' && 'code' in error) {
  136|    const axiosError = error as AxiosError;
  137|    return axiosError.code === 'ECONNABORTED';
  138|  }
  139|
  140|  return false;
  141|};
  142|
  143|/**
  144| * True for technical/global errors that should be handled by interceptor.
  145| */
  146|export const isGlobalTechnicalError = (error: unknown): boolean => {
  147|  const status = getErrorStatus(error);
  148|
  149|  if (typeof status === 'number') {
  150|    return GLOBAL_TECHNICAL_STATUSES.has(status) || status >= 500;
  151|  }
  152|
  153|  return isNetworkError(error) || isTimeoutError(error);
  154|};
  155|
  156|/**
  157| * Decide whether interceptor should show a global toast.
  158| */
  159|export const shouldHandleGlobalErrorToast = (
  160|  error: unknown,
  161|  errorMode: ErrorMode = 'global'
  162|): boolean => {
  163|  if (errorMode !== 'global') {
  164|    return false;
  165|  }
  166|  const status = getErrorStatus(error);
  167|  if (typeof status === 'number' && GLOBAL_POLICY_STATUSES.has(status)) {
  168|    return true;
  169|  }
  170|  return isGlobalTechnicalError(error);
  171|};
  172|
  173|/**
  174| * Decide whether local screen-level code should show a toast.
  175| */
  176|export const shouldShowLocalErrorToast = (error: unknown): boolean => {
  177|  return !isToastShown(error) && !isGlobalTechnicalError(error);
  178|};
  179|
  180|/**
  181| * Check if error should skip toast (already handled by interceptor)
  182| */
  183|export const shouldSkipToast = (error: unknown): boolean => {
  184|  return !shouldShowLocalErrorToast(error);
  185|};

   21|function parseDateInput(value: string): Date | null {
   22|  if (!value) return null;
   23|
   24|  const dateOnlyMatch = value.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/);
   25|  if (dateOnlyMatch) {
   26|    const [, year, month, day] = dateOnlyMatch;
   27|    const localDate = new Date(Number(year), Number(month) - 1, Number(day));
   28|    return Number.isNaN(localDate.getTime()) ? null : localDate;
   29|  }
   30|
   31|  const date = new Date(value);
   32|  return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? null : date;
   33|}

   37|  const amount = typeof value === 'number' ? value : Number(value);
   38|  if (!Number.isFinite(amount)) return '—';
   39|  return CURRENCY_FORMATTER_VND.format(amount);

===== FILE: src/utils/lazyWithMinDelay.ts =====
    1|import { lazy, type ComponentType, type LazyExoticComponent } from 'react';
    2|
    3|/** Thời gian tối thiểu hiển thị spinner Suspense (ms), song song với import. */
    4|export const LAZY_ROUTE_SPIN_MIN_MS = 300;
    5|
    6|const delay = (ms: number) => new Promise<void>((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
    7|
    8|/**
    9| * Giống `React.lazy` nhưng đợi tối thiểu `minMs` (mặc định 1s) để tránh spinner nháy quá nhanh.
   10| *
   11| * `ComponentType<any>` khớp cách `React.lazy` gõ kiểu upstream: route chunk có default export với props khác nhau.
   12| */
   13|// eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any -- heterogeneous default exports (pages, charts); stricter bound breaks inference (e.g. Dashboard chart).
   14|export function lazyWithMinDelay<T extends ComponentType<any>>(
   15|  load: () => Promise<{ default: T }>,
   16|  minMs: number = LAZY_ROUTE_SPIN_MIN_MS,
   17|): LazyExoticComponent<T> {
   18|  return lazy(() => Promise.all([load(), delay(minMs)]).then(([mod]) => mod));
   19|}

===== FILE: src/utils/publicFileUpload.ts =====
    1|import type { UploadRequestOption } from 'rc-upload/lib/interface';
    2|import api from '@/services/api';
    3|import { ENDPOINTS } from '@/services/endpoints';
    4|import { getErrorMessage } from '@/utils/errorHandler';
    5|
    6|/**
    7| * POST file tới `ENDPOINTS.public.upload`, gọi `onSuccess` với `{ data: { url } }` (chuẩn Ant Upload).
    8| */
    9|export async function publicFileUploadToUrl(options: UploadRequestOption): Promise<void> {
   10|  const { file, onSuccess, onError, onProgress } = options;
   11|  const formData = new FormData();
   12|  formData.append('file', file as File);
   13|
   14|  try {
   15|    const response = await api.post(ENDPOINTS.public.upload, formData, {
   16|      headers: {
   17|        'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data',
   18|      },
   19|      onUploadProgress: (progressEvent) => {
   20|        if (progressEvent.total && onProgress) {
   21|          onProgress({ percent: (progressEvent.loaded / progressEvent.total) * 100 });
   22|        }
   23|      },
   24|    });
   25|
   26|    const payload = response.data as { data?: { url?: string }; url?: string };
   27|    const uploadedUrl = payload?.data?.url ?? payload?.url;
   28|    if (typeof uploadedUrl !== 'string' || !uploadedUrl.trim()) {
   29|      throw new Error('No URL returned from upload API');
   30|    }
   31|
   32|    onSuccess?.({ data: { url: uploadedUrl.trim() } });
   33|  } catch (err) {
   34|    onError?.(err instanceof Error ? err : new Error(getErrorMessage(err)));
   35|  }
   36|}

   53|export function normalizeTripStatusKey(status?: string): TripStatus | '' {
   54|  if (status == null || status === '') return '';

   56|  if (u in UPPERCASE_ALIAS) return UPPERCASE_ALIAS[u];

  170|/** CONVENTION §3.3 — six list badges (NEW / ASSIGNED / IN_TRANSIT / DELIVERED / COMPLETED / CANCELLED). */
  171|export function getConventionOrderListBucket(status: string): ConventionOrderListBucket {
  172|  const key = normalizeTripStatusKey(status);
  173|  if (!key || key === 'pending') return 'new';
  174|  if (key === 'assigned' || key === 'driver_accepted') return 'assigned';
  175|  if (key === 'completed') return 'completed';
  176|  if (key === 'cancelled' || key === 'emergency') return 'cancelled';
  177|  if (key === 'arrived' || key === 'delivered') return 'delivered';
  178|  return 'in_transit';

  181|export function getConventionOrderListTagProps(status: string): {

   10|export const nonNegativeNumberRule = (label?: string): Rule => ({
   11|  validator: async (_, value: number | undefined) => {
   12|    if (value == null) return;
   13|    if (Number(value) < 0) {
   14|      throw new Error(`${toLabel(label)} must be greater than or equal to 0`);
   15|    }
   16|  },
   17|});
   18|
   19|export const afterOrEqualDateRule = (
   20|  getStartValue: () => unknown,
   21|  startLabel: string,
   22|  endLabel: string,
   23|): Rule => ({
   24|  validator: async (_, endValue: { isBefore?: (input: unknown, unit?: string) => boolean } | undefined) => {
   25|    const startValue = getStartValue();
   26|    if (!startValue || !endValue?.isBefore) return;
   27|    if (endValue.isBefore(startValue, 'day')) {
   28|      throw new Error(`${endLabel} must be after or equal to ${startLabel}`);
   29|    }
   30|  },
   31|});

   33|export const afterTimeRule = (
   34|  getStartValue: () => unknown,

   36|  endLabel: string,

===== FILE: src/utils/vnAddressForm.ts =====
    1|/**
    2| * Helpers for Vietnam admin address fields on Ant Design forms (provinces.open-api.vn).
    3| * Field names: `${prefix}addr_province_code`, … with `prefix` '' or `'start_'` / `'end_'`.
    4| */
    5|
    6|export const vnAddressFormFieldNames = (fieldPrefix: string): readonly string[] => {
    7|  const p = fieldPrefix;
    8|  return [
    9|    `${p}addr_province_code`,
   10|    `${p}addr_province_name`,
   11|    `${p}addr_district_code`,
   12|    `${p}addr_district_name`,
   13|    `${p}addr_ward_code`,
   14|    `${p}addr_ward_name`,
   15|    `${p}addr_street_detail`,
   16|  ] as const;
   17|};
   18|
   19|export const composeVnAddressLine = (
   20|  values: Record<string, unknown>,
   21|  fieldPrefix: string,
   22|): string | undefined => {
   23|  const p = fieldPrefix;
   24|  const street = String(values[`${p}addr_street_detail`] ?? '').trim();
   25|  const ward = String(values[`${p}addr_ward_name`] ?? '').trim();
   26|  const district = String(values[`${p}addr_district_name`] ?? '').trim();
   27|  const province = String(values[`${p}addr_province_name`] ?? '').trim();
   28|  if (!street || !ward || !district || !province) {
   29|    return undefined;
   30|  }
   31|  return [street, ward, district, province].join(', ');
   32|};
   33|
   34|export const stripVnAddressFormKeys = (payload: Record<string, unknown>, fieldPrefix: string): void => {
   35|  for (const k of vnAddressFormFieldNames(fieldPrefix)) {
   36|    delete payload[k];
   37|  }
   38|};
   39|
   40|/**
   41| * Writes composed line to `outputKey`, removes helper keys from `payload`.
   42| */
   43|export const mergeVnAddressIntoPayload = (
   44|  payload: Record<string, unknown>,
   45|  rawValues: Record<string, unknown>,
   46|  fieldPrefix: string,
   47|  outputKey: string,
   48|): void => {
   49|  const composed = composeVnAddressLine(rawValues, fieldPrefix);
   50|  stripVnAddressFormKeys(payload, fieldPrefix);
   51|  if (composed) {
   52|    payload[outputKey] = composed;
   53|  }
   54|};

===== FILE: src/utils/vnPayrollCalc.ts =====
    1|/**
    2| * Tính toán lương theo quy định pháp luật VN 2024.
    3| *
    4| * Tỷ lệ BHXH/BHYT/BHTN áp dụng từ 01/01/2024:
    5| *   - NLĐ:   BHXH 8% + BHYT 1.5% + BHTN 1%       = 10.5%
    6| *   - NSDLĐ: BHXH 17.5% + BHYT 3% + BHTN 1% + BHTNLĐ-BNN 0.5% = 22%
    7| *
    8| * Lương cơ sở từ 01/07/2024: 2,340,000 VND/tháng
    9| * Trần đóng BHXH: 20 × lương cơ sở = 46,800,000 VND/tháng
   10| * Trần đóng BHYT: 20 × lương cơ sở (giống BHXH)
   11| * Trần đóng BHTN: 20 × lương tối thiểu vùng (vùng I: 4,960,000 → 99,200,000, không thực tế cap ở mức thông thường)
   12| *
   13| * Giảm trừ gia cảnh PIT (Điều 9 Luật Thuế TNCN):
   14| *   - Bản thân: 11,000,000 VND/tháng
   15| *   - Người phụ thuộc: 4,400,000 VND/người/tháng
   16| *
   17| * Biểu thuế TNCN lũy tiến từng phần (Bảng 2 Phụ lục II TT111/2013):
   18| *   Bậc 1: ≤ 5,000,000          → 5%
   19| *   Bậc 2: 5,000,001 – 10,000,000  → 10%
   20| *   Bậc 3: 10,000,001 – 18,000,000 → 15%
   21| *   Bậc 4: 18,000,001 – 32,000,000 → 20%
   22| *   Bậc 5: 32,000,001 – 52,000,000 → 25%
   23| *   Bậc 6: 52,000,001 – 80,000,000 → 30%
   24| *   Bậc 7: > 80,000,000            → 35%
   25| */
   26|
   27|/** Tỷ lệ đóng BHXH/BHYT/BHTN (phần trăm). */
   28|export const VN_SI_RATES = {
   29|  employee: {
   30|    bhxh: 0.08,
   31|    bhyt: 0.015,
   32|    bhtn: 0.01,
   33|    total: 0.105,
   34|  },
   35|  employer: {
   36|    bhxh: 0.175,
   37|    bhyt: 0.03,
   38|    bhtn: 0.01,
   39|    bhtnld_bnn: 0.005,
   40|    total: 0.22,
   41|  },
   42|} as const;
   43|
   44|/** Lương cơ sở từ 01/07/2024 (đồng/tháng). */
   45|export const BASE_SALARY_2024 = 2_340_000;
   46|
   47|/** Trần đóng BHXH/BHYT = 20 × lương cơ sở. */
   48|export const SI_SALARY_CAP = 20 * BASE_SALARY_2024; // 46,800,000
   49|
   50|/** Giảm trừ gia cảnh bản thân (đồng/tháng). */
   51|export const PERSONAL_DEDUCTION = 11_000_000;
   52|
   53|/** Giảm trừ mỗi người phụ thuộc (đồng/tháng). */
   54|export const DEPENDANT_DEDUCTION = 4_400_000;
   55|
   56|/** Biểu thuế TNCN lũy tiến [upper_limit, rate]. upper_limit = Infinity cho bậc 7. */
   57|const PIT_BRACKETS: [number, number][] = [
   58|  [5_000_000,   0.05],
   59|  [10_000_000,  0.10],
   60|  [18_000_000,  0.15],
   61|  [32_000_000,  0.20],
   62|  [52_000_000,  0.25],
   63|  [80_000_000,  0.30],
   64|  [Infinity,    0.35],
   65|];
   66|
   67|export interface SIBreakdown {
   68|  /** Lương làm căn cứ đóng BHXH (tối đa = SI_SALARY_CAP). */
   69|  siSalaryBase: number;
   70|  /** BHXH phần NLĐ đóng. */
   71|  bhxhEmployee: number;
   72|  /** BHYT phần NLĐ đóng. */
   73|  bhytEmployee: number;
   74|  /** BHTN phần NLĐ đóng. */
   75|  bhtnEmployee: number;
   76|  /** Tổng BHXH+BHYT+BHTN phần NLĐ. */
   77|  totalSIEmployee: number;
   78|  /** BHXH phần NSDLĐ đóng (không trừ vào lương NV). */
   79|  bhxhEmployer: number;
   80|  /** BHYT phần NSDLĐ đóng. */
   81|  bhytEmployer: number;
   82|  /** BHTN phần NSDLĐ đóng. */
   83|  bhtnEmployer: number;
   84|  /** BHTNLĐ-BNN phần NSDLĐ đóng. */
   85|  bhtnldBnnEmployer: number;
   86|  /** Tổng chi phí BHXH phần NSDLĐ. */
   87|  totalSIEmployer: number;
   88|}
   89|
   90|export interface PITBreakdown {
   91|  /** Thu nhập chịu thuế (gross - SI employee - giảm trừ gia cảnh). */
   92|  taxableIncome: number;
   93|  /** Giảm trừ bản thân. */
   94|  personalDeduction: number;
   95|  /** Giảm trừ người phụ thuộc. */
   96|  dependantDeductionTotal: number;
   97|  /** Số người phụ thuộc. */
   98|  dependants: number;
   99|  /** Thu nhập tính thuế (sau giảm trừ gia cảnh). */
  100|  assessableIncome: number;
  101|  /** Thuế TNCN từng bậc: [bậc, thu_nhập_bậc, thuế]. */
  102|  brackets: { level: number; incomeInBracket: number; rate: number; tax: number }[];
  103|  /** Tổng thuế TNCN (làm tròn). */
  104|  totalPIT: number;
  105|}
  106|
  107|export interface PayrollCalcResult {
  108|  grossSalary: number;
  109|  si: SIBreakdown;
  110|  pit: PITBreakdown;
  111|  /** Lương net = gross - SI employee - PIT. */
  112|  netSalary: number;
  113|  /** Tổng chi phí thực tế công ty = gross + SI employer. */
  114|  totalEmployerCost: number;
  115|}
  116|
  117|/** Tính phân tách BHXH/BHYT/BHTN cho một nhân viên trong một tháng. */
  118|export function calcSI(grossSalary: number): SIBreakdown {
  119|  const siBase = Math.min(grossSalary, SI_SALARY_CAP);
  120|
  121|  const bhxhEmployee   = Math.round(siBase * VN_SI_RATES.employee.bhxh);
  122|  const bhytEmployee   = Math.round(siBase * VN_SI_RATES.employee.bhyt);
  123|  const bhtnEmployee   = Math.round(siBase * VN_SI_RATES.employee.bhtn);
  124|  const totalSIEmployee = bhxhEmployee + bhytEmployee + bhtnEmployee;
  125|
  126|  const bhxhEmployer      = Math.round(siBase * VN_SI_RATES.employer.bhxh);
  127|  const bhytEmployer      = Math.round(siBase * VN_SI_RATES.employer.bhyt);
  128|  const bhtnEmployer      = Math.round(siBase * VN_SI_RATES.employer.bhtn);
  129|  const bhtnldBnnEmployer = Math.round(siBase * VN_SI_RATES.employer.bhtnld_bnn);
  130|  const totalSIEmployer   = bhxhEmployer + bhytEmployer + bhtnEmployer + bhtnldBnnEmployer;
  131|
  132|  return {
  133|    siSalaryBase: siBase,
  134|    bhxhEmployee, bhytEmployee, bhtnEmployee, totalSIEmployee,
  135|    bhxhEmployer, bhytEmployer, bhtnEmployer, bhtnldBnnEmployer, totalSIEmployer,
  136|  };
  137|}
  138|
  139|/** Tính thuế TNCN theo phương pháp lũy tiến từng phần. */
  140|export function calcPIT(grossSalary: number, siEmployee: number, dependants = 0): PITBreakdown {
  141|  const personalDeduction        = PERSONAL_DEDUCTION;
  142|  const dependantDeductionTotal  = dependants * DEPENDANT_DEDUCTION;
  143|  const taxableIncome            = Math.max(0, grossSalary - siEmployee);
  144|  const assessableIncome         = Math.max(0, taxableIncome - personalDeduction - dependantDeductionTotal);
  145|
  146|  let remaining = assessableIncome;
  147|  let prevLimit = 0;
  148|  let totalPIT  = 0;
  149|  const brackets: PITBreakdown['brackets'] = [];
  150|
  151|  PIT_BRACKETS.forEach(([upperLimit, rate], index) => {
  152|    const bracketWidth = upperLimit === Infinity ? remaining : upperLimit - prevLimit;
  153|    const incomeInBracket = Math.min(remaining, bracketWidth);
  154|    const tax = Math.round(incomeInBracket * rate);
  155|    brackets.push({ level: index + 1, incomeInBracket, rate, tax });
  156|    totalPIT += tax;
  157|    remaining -= incomeInBracket;
  158|    prevLimit = upperLimit === Infinity ? prevLimit : upperLimit;
  159|    if (remaining <= 0) return;
  160|  });
  161|
  162|  return {
  163|    taxableIncome,
  164|    personalDeduction,
  165|    dependantDeductionTotal,
  166|    dependants,
  167|    assessableIncome,
  168|    brackets,
  169|    totalPIT,
  170|  };
  171|}
  172|
  173|/** Tính đầy đủ lương từ gross. */
  174|export function calcPayroll(grossSalary: number, dependants = 0): PayrollCalcResult {
  175|  const si  = calcSI(grossSalary);
  176|  const pit = calcPIT(grossSalary, si.totalSIEmployee, dependants);
  177|  const netSalary        = Math.max(0, grossSalary - si.totalSIEmployee - pit.totalPIT);
  178|  const totalEmployerCost = grossSalary + si.totalSIEmployer;
  179|
  180|  return { grossSalary, si, pit, netSalary, totalEmployerCost };
  181|}
  182|
  183|/** Tính gross từ net (xấp xỉ bằng binary search). Dùng cho reverse lookup. */
  184|export function grossFromNet(targetNet: number, dependants = 0, iterations = 50): number {
  185|  let lo = targetNet;
  186|  let hi = targetNet * 2;
  187|  for (let i = 0; i < iterations; i++) {
  188|    const mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
  189|    const { netSalary } = calcPayroll(mid, dependants);
  190|    if (netSalary < targetNet) lo = mid;
  191|    else hi = mid;
  192|  }
  193|  return Math.round((lo + hi) / 2);
  194|}
  195|
  196|/** Format số tiền VND (không dùng i18n — pure util). */
  197|export function fmtVND(amount: number): string {
  198|  return new Intl.NumberFormat('vi-VN', { style: 'currency', currency: 'VND' }).format(amount);

    1|/**

    9|const canUseRemoteCatalog = (): boolean => {
   10|  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return true;
   11|  const isLocal = window.location.hostname === 'localhost' || window.location.hostname === '127.0.0.1';

   45|/**
   46| * Lists all provinces / centrally governed cities (shallow; districts omitted or empty).
   47| */
   48|export async function fetchVnProvinceList(): Promise<VnProvinceSummary[]> {
   49|  if (!canUseRemoteCatalog()) {
   50|    return [];
   51|  }
   52|  const res = await fetch(`${BASE}/p/`, { redirect: 'follow' });
   53|  if (!res.ok) {
   54|    throw new Error(`provinces.open-api.vn: ${res.status}`);
   55|  }
   56|  const data = (await res.json()) as unknown;
   57|  if (!Array.isArray(data)) {
   58|    throw new Error('provinces.open-api.vn: invalid province list');
   59|  }
   60|  return data as VnProvinceSummary[];
   61|}

   63|/**

   65| */

   68|    return { code, name: String(code), districts: [] };

   71|  if (!res.ok) {

===== FILE: src/utils/vpicNhtsa.ts =====
    1|/**
    2| * Client helpers for the US NHTSA vPIC public API (vehicle makes and models).
    3| *
    4| * @see https://vpic.nhtsa.dot.gov/api/
    5| */
    6|
    7|export interface VpicMakeRow {
    8|  readonly Make_ID?: number;
    9|  readonly Make_Name: string;
   10|}
   11|
   12|export interface VpicModelRow {
   13|  readonly Make_Name?: string;
   14|  readonly Model_Name: string;
   15|}
   16|
   17|interface VpicEnvelope<T> {
   18|  readonly Results?: T[];
   19|}
   20|
   21|/**
   22| * Resolves the API origin used by the browser.
   23| * In development, defaults to `/vpic` so Vite can proxy and avoid CORS issues.
   24| */
   25|export function getVpicBaseUrl(): string {
   26|  const fromEnv = import.meta.env.VITE_VPIC_BASE_URL?.trim();
   27|  if (fromEnv) {
   28|    return fromEnv.replace(/\/$/, '');
   29|  }
   30|  if (import.meta.env.DEV) {
   31|    return '/vpic';
   32|  }
   33|  return 'https://vpic.nhtsa.dot.gov';
   34|}
   35|
   36|function joinVpicPath(path: string): string {
   37|  const base = getVpicBaseUrl();
   38|  const p = path.startsWith('/') ? path : `/${path}`;
   39|  return `${base}${p}`;
   40|}
   41|
   42|/**
   43| * Fetches the full list of vehicle makes from vPIC.
   44| */
   45|export async function fetchVpicAllMakes(): Promise<VpicMakeRow[]> {
   46|  const res = await fetch(joinVpicPath('/api/vehicles/getallmakes?format=json'));
   47|  if (!res.ok) {
   48|    throw new Error(`VPIC getallmakes failed: ${res.status}`);
   49|  }
   50|  const body = (await res.json()) as VpicEnvelope<VpicMakeRow>;
   51|  return Array.isArray(body.Results) ? body.Results : [];
   52|}
   53|
   54|/**
   55| * Fetches model names for a given make (e.g. `Toyota`).
   56| */
   57|export async function fetchVpicModelsForMake(makeName: string): Promise<string[]> {
   58|  const q = makeName.trim();
   59|  if (!q) {
   60|    return [];
   61|  }
   62|  const segment = encodeURIComponent(q);
   63|  const res = await fetch(joinVpicPath(`/api/vehicles/getmodelsformake/${segment}?format=json`));
   64|  if (!res.ok) {
   65|    throw new Error(`VPIC getmodelsformake failed: ${res.status}`);
   66|  }
   67|  const body = (await res.json()) as VpicEnvelope<VpicModelRow>;
   68|  const rows = Array.isArray(body.Results) ? body.Results : [];
   69|  const names = rows
   70|    .map((r) => r.Model_Name?.trim())
   71|    .filter((n): n is string => Boolean(n));
   72|  return [...new Set(names)].sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));
   73|}
